v19073.originalDescription:
The village of Hoori lies deep in the middle of the mountains, inaccessible by rail. Since there isn’t much interaction with its surroundings, the town seems like it is stuck in the past. However, it is because of this exact olden feel and subsequent development that it has turned into a nice hot-springs town for tourists.

One of the popular sightseeing spots is the legendary katana Murasamemaru, embedded in stone. No one has been able to pull it out… until Masaomi somehow broke it in half. He has to take responsibility for his actions: “Marriage” with ‘shrine maiden princess’ Yoshino!? He was perplexed at the unexpected turn of events, but this is only just the beginning. What lies ahead for him is a much more peculiar and mysterious life, including his new fiancée, a mysterious girl who only he could touch, and the secret behind the curse that remains on the town.

What will become of Masaomi’s love amidst his rapidly changing life? The answer lies within the Murasamemaru in his hands.

v83.title: ExE
v83.originalDescription: There was a big fire at a hospital which inflicted serious damage. Touya's mother, Suzuno, fell victim to its flames. After ten years he still can't overcome his sadness. But he somehow enjoys his life with Makina, his younger sister, and Saya. One day he sees a girl who looks quite like Suzuno. He can't forget her, and goes after her. He finally talks to her and thinks she is definitely Suzuno. All of a sudden, she attacks him with smile, and he almost loses his life. But a girl with a sword appears in front of them and saves him. He doesn't know what's going on, but he thinks, "Is she still alive?" He starts to search for the truth...
v83.description:
发生了火灾。
在八坂综合医院发生的那场火灾，是一个将附近卷入并给其造成巨大损害的大火灾。
在那之中，也包括为了某个研究而在医院工作的伏見籐矢的母亲，伏見鈴乃………

从火灾起的10年，籐矢在幸福与不幸福的普通的事情中前进着，极为普通地成长着。
可是，他的心至今仍被深深地刻上了失去了母亲的那场事故的回忆。
燃烧得旺盛的火焰，什么都不能做的还是孩子的自己，和失去了母亲的这样的过去。
一边怀抱着那样的悲伤，一边与妹妹真姫奈和像姐姐一样的白峰沙耶快乐地生活着。

那样的某日——

一如往常的籐矢看见了一个曾经见过其面容的女性。
那怎么看都是除了伏見鈴乃以外就没见过的女性。
籐矢无论如何也在意着那个女性的事，追赶着那个身姿。

而且，见到了面的女性，没错，是自己的母亲。
与那个母亲对话着的籐矢，在哪里感觉到了不协调感。
对那样的籐矢，鈴乃边笑边袭击而来。
被自己的母亲突然袭击，无法反抗，生命岌岌可危。
突然出现在那里的拿着日本刀的女性救了籐矢一命。

应该死了的母亲活着的理由，目的和那个行动。
而且，与母亲有关联的所说的研究……
全部都不知道且困惑的同时，在籐矢的胸中某种心情正在沸腾。

如果妈妈活着……要是现在还……

——与怀抱着的悲伤和过去对峙的伏見籐矢，为了寻求真实而迈出了脚步。

v179.title: 春天的足音
aliases: Deliver Spring to your heart... as soon!
v179.originalDescription: The game is set in a small town in the fictional Mebukino, Japan, to which the protagonist returns after his experiences in Tokyo. The story is about his experiences on the following days.
v179.description:
明明持有资格，却在学生时代起一直居住的城市里当不上教师，而且还失恋了的主人公・樹。他针对自己这样的境遇，以及优柔寡断的自己本身所采取的行动，是“回到故乡的街道”这种也可以说是“逃避”的做法。

自然丰富的乡下小镇・芽吹野町。

樹在那个故乡里继续消沉度日。然而，从微小的契机开始的新日子，以及在那之中相遇的，与自己有着不同生活方式的人们。至今为止的自己，与崭新的自己。

那与其说是充满希望的变化，不如说可能是抱进了许多新的不安。樹依然，这么认为。是的。这个时候依然。

无论是谁总是会在心中一直怀有的，漠然的不安与对自己的焦躁，以及向前迈进的恐惧。

仅凭身处那个漩涡正中央的主人公，围绕在他身边的人，以及包容这一切的自然这一要素，本作静静地，却又扎实地描绘出“人类”。

aliases: ぶらばん!～The bonds of melody～
v532.originalDescription: You play as part of the brass section of the school band. However, they have closed your school due to low student population and have redistricted all who went there to another school. That school's brass band has already been well established there, and your new school cannot have two brass bands. Not only that, but they ridicule you and your classmates and consider the lot of you untalented. To remedy this situation, the two bands have been issued a contest--judged by the student body--to see who is truly better and who will be the formal brass band. You only have a month to practice and be the best.

v632.originalDescription: Where Masato arrives is a secret village. The village is surrounded by mountains, woods, rivers and fields..., good old scenery. He was a teacher. He lost confidence between ideal and reality, and got away from it all. On his way to his hometown, his car fell down the valley. When he wakes up, he isn't in heaven nor hell. He is at the secret village, a little bit apart from this world. What will he see, feel and find there...?
v632.description:
以非人之身居住的、令人感到些许怀念的隐秘村落为舞台的纯爱故事。
——误入的是隐秘村落。
仿佛曾在何时何地见过一般。被山与森林、河流与田野环绕的那个村庄，被怀念的色彩、声音与空气所包围。
日下部真人是一名学校教师。在理想与现实的夹缝中失去自信，从职场与日常中逃离出来的他所前往的，是度过幼年时光的、自然丰富的故乡。然而，在前往那里的途中，他驾驶汽车失误，坠落到了谷底。
然后，当他下一次醒来时，那里既不是天国也不是地狱……
误入的是隐秘村落。
非人之身居住的，与“现世”稍有偏离之地。在那里真人会遇见什么，感受到什么，想到什么，又找到什么呢……

v701.title: 夏空彼方
v701.description:
日本唯一的常夏之岛——『塔弦岛』。
这是一座神奇的岛屿，虽然与冲绳处于相同纬度，却全年保持着接近盛夏的气温。
为何会发生如此不可思议的现象？
据说是因为受到海底火山形成的海流影响等等，但这一切都只是传言，停留在猜测阶段，无人知晓真相……

－茅羽耶之章－

趁着寒假，主人公朝仓壮太来到在岛上经营民宿的姑妈家。他在民宿打工的同时，与表姐妹以及青梅竹马的少年一起度过了愉快的时光。在这样的日子里，壮太在一家偶然进入的咖啡馆遇到了一位少女。
这位名叫『上坂茅羽耶』的少女性格开朗随和。
虽然初次见面，两人却相谈甚欢。随着交流的深入，少年与少女如同命运安排般相互吸引。
不知不觉间，两人变得亲密无间，丝毫不像是才相识数日。
然后，在夕阳西下的海边，他们如同命运的引导般拥吻。
然而，这却是悲剧的开端。
第二天，壮太为了见茅羽耶而前往咖啡馆。
在那里重逢的上坂茅羽耶，与昨日之前相比没有任何变化。她依然是个充满魅力的少女。
除了一点——她唯独失去了关于少年朝仓壮太的所有记忆……
塔弦岛的“秘密”与少女们的“秘密”。
两个“秘密”交织出的神秘岛屿物语，现在揭开序幕。
v701.originalDescription:
There is a small island. Souta visits his aunt's house located on the island. She runs a hotel and he starts working part-time there. One day, he meets a girl, Chihaya, at the coffee shop. They become friends soon and gradually fall in love... 

However, this is just a beginning of a tragedy. A while later, he meets Chihaya at the coffee shop. There is nothing wrong with her, but she doesn't remember him...

v893.title: SNOW
v893.originalDescription: The story of Snow starts when the main protagonist Izumo Kanata visits a small village called Ryujinmura (village of the dragon god) to help his cousin Tsugumi manage a local hotel with hot springs. In the village there is an old legend: In ancient times, the village is protected by the dragon goddess. However, one day the dragon goddesses fell in love with a human, which is strictly forbidden, and this incident finally caused the village to be always covered by snow after that. The game then tells the daily life of the protagonist in the village, and finally links the story to the legend of dragon goddess.
v893.description:
最早的PC版于2003年1月31日推出。随后Dreamcast版和PS2版于2003年9月和2004年2月相继推出。原先的PC版没有角色配音，但第二款包含完整角色配音的全新PC版于2004年9月发售。另外一款续接的PC版《SNOW P・E》（P・E是英文Plus Edition（附加版）的缩写）于2006年9月发售。PSP携带版原定于2006年12月发售，后来被推迟到2007年夏天的8月16日发售。
　　故事以主角出云彼方到一座名叫“龙神村”的小村落帮助他亲戚经营温泉旅馆为开端。村子里有一个古老的传说：在古时候村庄被一位龙神守护着。但是有一天龙神打破禁忌爱上了一个凡人。经过这次事件之后村子就一直被雪覆盖著。游戏讲述了男主角在村子里的日常生活以及最后将故事联系到龙神。

v1322.title: 天神乱漫 LUCKY or UNLUCKY!?
v1322.original: 天神乱漫 LUCKY or UNLUCKY!?
aliases: 天神乱漫 LUCKY or UNLUCKY!?
v1322.originalDescription:
Chitose Haruki's life was anything but ordinary. 
His phone took a swim every time he dropped it, his wallet seemed to have a disappearing act of its own, bike accidents were a regular occurrence, and even a simple walk down the street could turn into a confrontation.

While others might consider these events heartbreaking, for Haruki, they were just another Tuesday. He had made peace with his perpetually bad luck and found a strange sense of harmony within the chaos.

Then, one day, his life took a bizarre turn. 
A mysterious package landed on his doorstep – no sender, no address, just a label that said "living thing." Talk about a head-scratcher, even for someone like Haruki. And what was inside? A girl, believe it or not.

This unexpected arrival wasn't another misfortune, but rather, his first stroke of luck, albeit a chaotic one. The girl claimed to be a "god" sent to eliminate Haruki's bad luck, and she promptly decided to move in, much to his surprise.

However, her presence was like adding gasoline to a fire. Minor mishaps snowballed into full-blown fiascos, pulling everyone around them into the mayhem.

So, what will this "lucky break" bring to Haruki's chaotic world?
What's the deal with this self-proclaimed deity?
And will Haruki finally ditch his bad luck streak?

Buckle up, because the answers lie ahead in the wild ride that's about to unfold!

v1337.title: 祝福的钟声
v1337.originalDescription: The story takes place in Ert'Aria. The city is called "the city of treasures" and people are now busy preparing for a harvest festival. There is a mysterious power called Ale. If you gather Ale and crystallize it, it turns into a jewel. Once in every seven years, the harvest of Ale increases. The main character is Leicester. He is an item engineer and belongs to an adventurer group called Oasis. He also looks forward to the festival. A group of shooting stars fill in the sky in the year when the harvest of Ale increases. Yes, today is the day. Carina, Leicester's old friend, can't wait for it, so she takes him out into the town. At night, when Leicester and his friends have a party, a shooting star comes towards them! It passes them and falls down nearby. They rush to the venue and find a secret room. The room is filled with mysterious atmosphere and a girl sleeps in the bed. When Leicester looks at her face, she wakes up and says, "Oh, you're my father!" Her name is Minette and she leads Leicester and his friends to an adventure...
v1337.description:
故事以被称作“世界的宝物库”的都市エルタリア为舞台拉开帷幕。
这个城市现在正进行着“收获祭”的准备。
今年是7年1度的 “エール” 满盈之年，更有来自世界的许多商人、观光客、以及冒险者聚集在此，比往年更加热闹。
居住在这个エルタリア的青年レスター是冒险者团队『Oasis』的道具技师。
他也期待着“收获祭”的到来。
在“エール”满盈之年，定会出现夜空被流星群充满的奇观，这在城里的人们间已经形成了话题。
此外，杂志、新闻已预报说今晚就是“流星群“之日。
レスター的青梅竹马、エルタリア的首相之女カリーナ等不及夜晚来临就把他邀到正忙于准备祭典的街道。
在那里，他们和在中央广场卖艺的自称世界第一的人偶师アニエス及从神都远道而来的神殿骑士チェルシー成为了朋友，于是大家决定一起去观赏流星群。

那个夜晚。
朝着在エルタリア的大圣堂屋顶参加派对的レスター等人，一颗流星正飞了过来！
一行人慌张地躲闪，那颗流星从他们的头顶飞过，落在了大圣堂的塔上。
急忙奔向塔的レスター等人，在那里发现了隐藏房间。
那是被神秘氛围所围绕的房间，中央的床上，一位可人的少女沉睡着。
レスター安静地接近之时，那位少女慢慢地睁开了双眼……
「你一定就是、我的爸爸吧！」
带着仿佛能让世上所有人都变得幸福的笑容如是说。

——在无数群星落下的夜晚的不可思议的房间里邂逅的少女。
和少女ミネット的邂逅，将把レスター等人引向与至今为止不同的热闹日常、以及想象不到的冒险故事。

v1618.originalDescription: Landlord asks main character to help about the cafe on the first floor of the building. It turns out to be a maid cafe where two cute twins are working already. It's confusing to be called "onii-chan", but promise needs to be fulfilled.
v1618.description:
暑假开始前，
照顾我的房东拜托了我一件不得了的事。
“这个月有各种各样忙乱的事。和彦，能拜托你帮忙照看女仆咖啡店吗？”
指的是我住的公寓一楼的那家『Cafe Twins』。
“女儿们也会一起帮忙的，就拜托你了哦”
“……哎？”
“哥哥。我会加油的哦”
“我也会加油的哦，哥哥！”
“欸！？”
房东留下愣住的我离开了。
然后，和一直像妹妹一样看待的双胞胎女孩，
开始一起经营女仆咖啡店了……

The protagonist, Itou Seigo, son of famous scientists, due to his parents' circumstances and the construction of Kamina Bridge, moved from Tokyo to Kamina Island and transferred to Kamina Academy. He reunited with his childhood friend and stepsister. Moreover, in peculiar circumstances, he also met a cold beauty, wielding a Japanese sword; a member of the Disciple Committee with blond hair, who has an aura of seduciness around her; and the daughter of a rich family, who is also the head of the student council. And so his rich school life truly began, filled with hassles from the Disciple Committee, dreadful guards of school discipline, led by the severe and ruthless teacher Serizawa.

...But good things never last long. Following the arrival of the mysterious person on the island, cruel events began to occur one by one. At the beginning, Seigo was rather indifferent, since he had not much attachment to his new environment, yet the distress developed and involved the whole island. Not even his friends were left untouched...

Seigo felt fury against unreasonable adults and made a decision to fight for the academy and the whole island, which were precious to his dear friends.

v1950.title: 友達以上恋人未満
aliases: It is under a sweetheart more than a friend
v1950.originalDescription: Shohei took a trip to Ryuujin-mura to heal his broken heart. He visited a historic shrine and freed a spirit who was sealed in a pot. She was Kukuri, a spirit who brought love to lonely people. The shrine’s miko Meiko makes him take responsibility for releasing Kukuri and the town is locked down, so he couldn’t return home. Will he be able to settle Kukuri’s disturbance and be freed from Meiko and return home?
v1950.description:
游戏介绍
描写在被万年积雪封闭的村庄，自古以来悲伤不断的恋爱物语而得到好评的作品『SNOW』。
而作为其续篇诞生，以不为爱情所动的副角色・橘芽依子为主线的『友達以上恋人未満』！
作为『HD Plus Edition』的追加要素， 加入HD（1280*720）宽屏高分辨率，新角色和故事，背景演出和系统的全面改善也一并献上。
在原版不能攻略的角色也变成可攻略角色，已经玩过的各位也请注目！
 
故事情节
经过千年时间，“罪之枷锁”现在已被解开——

主人公・翔平为了治愈失恋受伤的心灵儿想要离开自己的日常生活，参加旅行团来到龙神村。
（伤心旅行竟然是团游，谁让他手头上的资金只剩下这个选择了！）

来到有历史的神社的一行人。
离开欢闹的团游旅客们，独自一人的主人公竟碰上了被封印在壶内的妖怪解封的场面。
那是依附在在寂寞人类身上让其恋爱的妖怪……恋爱妖精“久克里(くくり)”。
按情况的发展，神社的巫女芽依子（被硬推上）要负上解放“久克里”的责任， 而主人公是被逼帮手回收。
在事情不断演变期间，由“久克里”引起的骚动被当成是神秘奇病而使得村子要封锁。主人公也就这样不能回去了。

旅馆里的女孩子出云樱(さくら)和其同班同学・四方山睦月(むつき)、巴士导游小姐还有诊所的护士小姐……
最终，主人公能顺利解决这场骚动（应该是，能否从芽依子手上得到解放）吗？
而在前作『SNOW』里并没得到满足就冻结了的恋爱之心被“久克里” 所动摇的芽依子将会……

注：朋友以上恋人未满，一般指感情在普通朋友以上但还没有达到成为恋人的条件。

v2352.originalDescription:
Kuzuha Ryuuga is an average student with a girlfriend. He's kind and helpful to others. Suddenly he starts having desires and keeps seeing visions of himself brutally raping the girls around him. Afraid of himself he checks himself in to the nurses office where he meets Mizuchi a demon girl. v4806.title: NOBLE☆WORKS
v4806.originalDescription: Takumi is a normal guy who barely gets by with part-time jobs. One day, he was asked to attend the prestigious private school Rokuroku Gakuen while impersonating a rich student that looks just like him. Although he was hesitant to accept this strange request, circumstances (mainly financial) compelled him to agree to do it. However, he knows nothing about the celeb world. Will he be able to keep his cover?
v4806.description:
——我想请你当替身！

家境有些贫寒的苦学生主人公——藤岛匠被委托的工作，是一件相当乱来的事情。

其内容是“希望你能成为与自己外貌一模一样的富家子弟的替身，
去上超级名流云集的名门‘私立六麓学院’”。

对身为普通人的他来说，这是一份让人不禁感到不安的可疑工作，但由于难以抗拒（主要是金钱上的）原因，他最终还是接下了这份奇怪的工作。

当然，替身生活不可能平安无事地度过。
面对平民常识根本行不通的名流生活，主人公只有困惑的份！
他究竟能否在不讲常识的世界里出色地完成替身的工作呢？
在其中与少女们交织的恋爱，又将走向何方！

现在，那华丽（？）的学生生活拉开帷幕。

v8213.description:
构造改革特别区 海上都市「阿库亚·伊甸」
某位学生带着巨大的目的造访了这座岛。主人公六连佑斗也是他的朋友，在对此等巨大目的毫不知情的情况下，为了享受与朋友间的单纯旅行而造访了海上都市。

在这座城市里，佑斗目击了绑架事件！
觉得不能视而不见的佑斗插手了这起绑架事件——竟然变成了“吸血鬼”！！
成为吸血鬼的佑斗无法返回本土，只能在海上都市生活……
然而这只不过是即将开始的故事的入口而已。

在午夜进行授课的学园里，在月夜下阔步的同学们（※吸血鬼）。
他对这前所未有的超常识大骚动感到心潮澎湃。

就这样，在吸血鬼与人类共生的海上都市，甜蜜而令人感伤的夜晚故事拉开了帷幕——

The story begins with Mutsura Yuuto accompanying his friend on a holiday to Aqua Eden, an artificial island city where gambling and the sex industry are legal.

However, his holiday plans are laid to waste after he gets involved in a kidnapping; to make matters worse, he ends up getting turned into a vampire.

As a vampire, he can no longer leave Aqua Eden; so with nowhere else to go, he decides to enroll in a special school for vampires on the island — and thus, his new night life begins!

v8438.originalDescription:
One of two Windmill and Windmill Oasis' 10th anniversary project that utilizes the E-mote sprite animation system. 

Yousuke came to the bustling tourist city of Kazashiro to attend the school there. The Western-style houses lining the streets and the townspeople’s attire give the city an exotic charm. To top it off, a ‘witch’ named Ayari will be living with him at the boarding house Oasis, which is owned by his aunt Yuuko. Later, he meets two other ‘witches’ Suzuno and Misumi, and reunites with his older sister-like childhood friend Ririko, who is a ‘knight’. Every day is full of exciting events and before long, they are brought again into a different world. Surely this is the world of love.
v8438.description:
——“城墙”的另一边，是另一个世界。

真的，确实如此。
统一采用西洋建筑的街景。
充满异国情调的居民们的服装。

“嗯。我啊，是‘魔女’哦”

而且，寄宿处的同居人竟然就是“魔女”。

如同游行般快乐的每一天开始了。

今年春天，入学风城学园的主人公・有马洋辅。
迎接他的，是每天因游客而热闹非凡的主题公园都市。
他遇见的，是三位“魔女”与一位“骑士”。

充满各种活动、令人心潮澎湃的每一天，不久后将少年少女们带往了另一个世界。

是的。
这份心情的另一边，一定就是名为恋爱的另一个世界——

v16044.description:
保科柊史拥有一种不可思议的能力——
他可以感知别人的心情。
这件事一直以来都是他的秘密。

而他的同班同学一一绫地宁宁，
也同样有着一个不可告人的秘密。

他们俩本来只是普通同学。
然而某一天，阴差阳错之下，

令人震惊的事件迅速拉近了两个人的距离，
也让他们相互坦白了各自的秘密。

这时柊史才终于知道，
“魔女”究竟是怎样的存在..…….

学妹、学姐、转校生也接连不断地来到他们身边。
原本风平浪静的校园生活突然变得忙碌起来，
这让柊史开始有了一丝期待。

v16044.originalDescription:
Hoshina Shuuji has a secret: He has a mysterious power that allows him to perceive the emotions of others.

One of Shuuji’s classmates, Ayachi Nene, likewise has her own grave secret: She will randomly experience periods of strong arousal, something which she has no control over. The two of them had nothing to do with one another beyond just being classmates, until one day, when Shuuji stumbled upon a scene that defied his wildest imaginations. Ayachi Nene, THAT Ayachi Nene is pressing her crotch against the corner of a library table… using it to MASTURBATE?!

Following that one accident, two strangers became friends. They bonded with one another through their shared secrets, and from this, Shuuji came to learn about certain things. That is, not only about the reason for Nene’s random ‘fits’ where she gets uncontrollably aroused, but also about the existence of people called ‘witches’—-Nene’s secret actions as a ‘witch’, and the ‘fits’ she goes through because of that serving as the magnet, a junior, an upperclassman, and a transfer student all congregate together.

Shuuji’s once normal life is thrown into chaos, and with that, a certain faint hope wells up inside of him:

“Maybe this will be the start of something new.”

v22230.title: Riddle Joker
v22230.description:
曾经被称为“超能力”的不可思议之力。
其神秘也因20世纪末期发现的粒子而得到解明，
如今超能力改称为“Astral能力”，超能力者也改称为“Astral使”。

在原晓(在原暁)便是在这样的世间，过着平稳日常的平庸普通人。

但这只是伪装。
不瞒你说，在原晓是使用Astral能力进行活动的隐秘组织特工！

这样的他接到了新的指令。

潜入Astral使聚集的学院，作为学生！

与妹妹在原七海(在原七海)一起，成功潜入学院，
顺利融入班级的他，
与三司绫濑(三司あやせ)及二条院羽月(二条院羽月)等同班同学，以及学姐式部茉优(式部茉優)加深了关系。

没有被怀疑，任务一帆风顺。

——本以为如此，却卷入意料之外的事态，被三司绫濑识破了真面目！
同时得知了她所怀有的巨大秘密。

互相握住了谁也不能说的秘密的少年与少女。
那场相遇，将大大左右两人的命运——
v22230.originalDescription:
People used to call such unfathomable abilities "superpowers".
Through the discovery of a certain particle during the end of the 20th century, however, the mystery surrounding these powers was solved, with them and their users now being referred to as "Astral abilities" and "Astral users", respectively.

Arihara Satoru is an ordinary person living in this extraordinary world.

However, that is but a facade.
Hidden beneath the surface, Arihara Satoru is actually an Astral user working as an agent under a secret organization!

His newest mission:

"Infiltrate this school geared towards Astral users as one of its students!"

Along with his little sister, Arihara Nanami, he succeeds in the infiltration and blends in with the students there without a hitch, building a rapport with fellow classmates Mitsukasa Ayase and Nijouin Hazuki as well as upperclassman Shikibe Mayu along the way.

Having not drawn even the tiniest bit of suspicion, his mission continues according to plan.

--Or so he had hoped. Due to an unforeseen event, his true identity was revealed to Mitsukasa Ayase!
But the revelations didn't stop there; Ayase's own big secret was also revealed:

What do you know! Her chest was padded!

The two now held each other's unspeakable secrets within them.
And with that one encounter, their fate would be forever changed--

v26414.title: 星光咖啡馆与死神之蝶
v26414.original: 喫茶ステラと死神の蝶
aliases: 星光咖啡馆与死神之蝶
喫茶ステラと死神の蝶
Café Stella to Shinigami no Chou
Café Stella and the Reapers' Butterflies
星光咖啡館與死神之蝶

v26414.description:
主人公高岭昂晴过着平淡无奇的学生生活。
然而有一天，他因意外事故丧命。
这时发生了意想不到的事。
本该死去的高岭昂晴，睁开了双眼。

而且那是——死去的当天的早晨。
在不明所以的情况下，他再次度过了同样的一天。
这并非预知梦或既视感，一天的流程完全相同。
尽管对这异常的事态感到恐惧，他还是来到了发生致死事故的地点。
然后在事故发生的瞬间——
他遇见了“死神”和“会说人话的猫”。

接着被告知了这样的话语。

“死亡尚未回避”

为了逃离死亡的命运，高岭昂晴决定帮助死神工作。
其方法，不知为何是开一家咖啡馆。
v26414.originalDescription:
Takamine Kousei was living a carefree college life until, one day, he tragically died in an accident. But then, the bizarre happened: Takamine Kousei opened his eyes again. And what's more, when he woke up, it was the morning of the very day he had died. He proceeded to relive the same day, unable to grasp the reality of his situation. Kousei soon realized that his previous experience was not some prophetic dream, nor was he experiencing deja vu; everything was taking place the exact same way. 

Overwhelmed by fear due to the unbelievable situation he has found himself in, he came back to the place where he had died. Then, at the moment of the accident, Kousei met a death goddess accompanied by a talking cat. The death goddess informed him that he has not yet avoided his death. In order to escape his grisly fate, Kousei must assist the death goddess with her work. And naturally, this means the opening of a café together. 

By rewinding the world, Kousei may have overcome his fate for now, but can he overcome the certain death his future holds for him? This is the story of one man's love and his defiance of the world and his own fate... maybe?

v31807.title: PARQUET
v31807.originalDescription:
In the near future, a technology called Brain-Machine Interface connects the brain and machines. This technology brings about a new paradigm and opens the gates to the digitization of human memory itself.

From these new discoveries, "he" is born. An illegal experiment mixes thousands of memories into a single vessel, creating a wholly new being.

Having only the memories of others, doubts about who he truly is start arising in his mind, until he gathers the courage to go out into the world in search of his true self.

As he steps into the real world, he meets two girls, Kido Tsubasa and Ibaraki Rino. Both kind souls whose lives have been touched by unscrupulous BMI experiments, just like him. Learning to live together with their secrets, "he" and "they" will bring about big changes...
v31807.description:
Brain-machine Interface，简称BMI，是一种连接大脑和机器的技术。
这项技术让人类的记忆得以数据化，为世界发展做出了显著贡献。

同时，也创造出了“他”。

他诞生于一次非法“造人”实验。他的人格由许许多多的记忆拼凑而成。

但他从未拥有过属于自己的记忆。在求知欲的驱使下，他决定踏上寻找自我之旅。
在外面的世界，他遇见了她和“她”。

不温不火的猫系女子『茨木梨乃』
活泼开朗的犬系女子『城门翼』

她们的存在同样与非法BMI实验有着密不可分的关联。

怀揣着各自的秘密，伴随着种种变数，“他”和“她们”的同居生活正式拉开序幕——

----------------------------------------------------------------------

Brain-machine Interface とは、脳と機械を繋ぐ技術である。
BMIによって、人の記憶はデータ化が可能となり、世界に発展をもたらした。

そして、彼は造り出された。

複数の人間の記憶を混ぜ合わせ、新たな人間を造る非合法な実験によって。

他人の記憶しか持たない彼は“自分”に興味を抱き、“自分”を探して街に出る。
そうして訪れた街で出会った２人。

猫を思わせる涼やかな『茨木リノ』
犬を思わせる朗らかな『城門ツバサ』

彼女たちもまた、BMIの非合法な実験によって生まれた存在だった。

秘密を抱えた３人、“彼”と“彼女たち”の同居生活が、大きな変化をもたらしていく——

v34192.originalDescription: Dark version of SNOW featuring the protagonist of the Aoi Kajitsu no Sanka series.
v34192.description:
主人公被在常年积雪环绕的村庄里经营老字号温泉旅馆的表姐拜托去旅馆打工。
那是过去只去过一次，残留在记忆角落的雪之村。
然而，刚一抵达那个村庄，就遭遇了落石事故，身受濒死的重伤。
再次醒来时，已经身处表姐经营的温泉旅馆“龙神天守阁”之中。
明明受了重伤，不知为何却平安无事地活了下来。
从那一天起，主人公便被看不见的命运所捉弄。

v40520.title: 天使☆嚣嚣 RE-BOOT!
v40520.description:
像往常一样起床，像往常一样上学，像往常一样上课
今天也一如既往，平稳的日常流逝着——
本是这么想的……

“从天而降被赋予使命的‘天使’。那就是我”

突然，不知从何处降临在眼前的，自称天使的女孩子
展开纯白巨大双翼的美丽身姿，她说道

“谷风李空(谷風李空)——我是来见你的
　身为‘魔王’转世的你”

前世是异世界的魔王
还没来得及理解这一点，接二连三的骚动便蜂拥而至

前世觉醒
来自异世界的来访者
然后——

“为什么？诶？为什么？不，因为……诶诶……？”

失去了往常的日常，也一同失去了重要之物的谷风李空
他崭新的日子，现在开始……？
v40520.originalDescription:
It began as a day just like any other.
A dull morning, an uneventful trip to school, an afternoon of tedious lectures...
And then I met her.

"I'm an angel, sent here from Heaven on a very important mission."

She appeared suddenly, and without warning―a beautiful girl who called herself an angel.
Spreading her large, snow-white wings, she made a declaration that would forever change my life.

"I come in search of the Demon Lord's reincarnation."
"That being you, Tanikaze Riku."

That's right, apparently I was a Demon Lord in my previous life. From some other world to boot.

Unfortunately for me, the anarchy wouldn't stop there.
Memories from a previous life, visitors from another world... It was just one crazy, chaotic event after the other.

"Wait, what? But that doesn't― Huh?!"

Thus began the story of Tanikaze Riku, a tale marked by the loss of his normal life, along with so many other precious things.
Aside from even more anarchy, what else does the future have in store for him?

v56650.title: 聚光灯下的青柠恋曲
v56650.original: ライムライト・レモネードジャム
aliases: ライムライト・レモネードジャム
v56650.description:
“要一起组乐队吗？”

音乐、伙伴、还有恋爱。从与她相遇的那天起世界便闪耀光芒——

贝斯弹得很好，却没有所属特定乐队的冲浪雪鹰(沖浪雪鷹)。
没有目标，但也没有其他想做的事。
在漫无目的继续音乐活动的过程中看到的街头演出，改变了冲浪雪鹰一成不变的日常。

用近乎外行人的吉他，独自一人挑战自弹自唱的少女阳见惠凪(陽見恵凪)。

看到她的街头演出的瞬间起，冲浪雪鹰的日常再次开始闪耀。
v56650.originalDescription:
Music, friends, and love.
From the day he met her, the world began to shine—

Okinami Yukitaka was skilled at bass but had never belonged to a specific band.
He had no goals, yet nothing else he wanted to do.
Amidst his aimless musical pursuits, he stumbled upon a street performance that would completely transform his monotonous daily life.

There stood a girl, Harumi Ena, challenging herself with a solo performance of singing and guitar playing, with her complete amateur skill.

The moment Yukitaka witnessed her street performance, his ordinary world began to sparkle once again.

v25.title: AYAKASHI アヤカシ
v25.originalDescription: Kusaka Yuu is a student that lost his will to live after the death of a dear childhood friend, until the day a mysterious girl, named Yoake Eimu, appears. From that moment on, his life would never be the same again. Hunted by Ayakashi and their hosts, the power within Yuu awakens and a never ending battle begins.
v25.description:
主人公・久坂悠，是在幼年时掌握了某种特殊力量的学生。对任何事物都提不起干劲、漠不关心的他，被周围人认为是毫无价值的人。每天用自身的“力量”做着无聊的坏事。当一位自称「夜明艾姆(夜明エイム)」的谜之少女出现在这样的他面前时，悠的生活为之一变。

觊觎悠的被称为「AYAKASHI 妖」的诡异生物，以及操纵AYAKASHI 妖的人们的来袭。悠也觉醒了隐藏在自身之中的作为「AYAKASHI 妖使い」的真正能力……。现在，壮烈的战斗拉开帷幕！

v263.title: Ayakashi H
v263.originalDescription:
This is a fandisc for Ayakashi taking place one month after the ending of the original.

Somewhere in a forest, three people -- one man and two girls -- arrive to the Akino residence. They ask to meet her but are denied so by the guards, for it is late at night and they weren't noticed of any visitors. Trying to chase them away, one guard summons his Ayakashi but it gets defeated easily by the girl who seems to be the leader of this group.

Meanwhile, inside her mansion, Akino is talking with Kajiwara Heima and Maekawa Akio. They're suddenly interrupted by one of their guards who, though injured, warns them about the intruders. At their arrival, Heima promptly conjures Nurikabe and charges them but his Ayakashi's attack is cancelled easily by the same girl...
v263.description:
与“他”的死斗过去1个月后——悠正与夜明艾姆(夜明エイム)、药师寺阳爱(薬師寺 陽愛)、帕姆·韦尔努·朝仓(パム・ウェルヌ・アサクラ)、织江等熟悉的《AYAKASHI》女主角们过着色色的每一天，此时自称“皇灵会”的神秘三人组出现在了他面前。

“皇灵会”是一个监视AYAKASHI使用者，并在必要时将其打倒的组织。作为“皇灵会”御三家之一白神家的当家，白神菊理与她的随从咲守八重，以及菊理的护卫刑部克己这3人，告知悠等人，他们是来查明悠等人是否是“危险的存在”的。

不想失去色色又快乐的每一天——！
不，说错了。是想守护好不容易得到的与同伴们一起的和平生活——！

这么想的悠，为了证明AYAKASHI使用者不是“危险的存在”，开始挑战菊理给出的试炼。
话虽如此，毕竟是色情喜剧，做什么事不知为何都会朝着色色的方向发展……。对悠抱有爱意的女主角们也不甘示弱地向菊理发起更色色的诱惑，充满了乱七八糟的展开！

v775.title: Coming×Humming!!
v775.originalDescription:
Sophomore student of Suzaku high school, Kirigaya Haruto stayed at a small country inn along with his childhood friend. Although he was worried about the monetary support from his parents that stopped and the accumulating rent, he lived a laid back life beneath the spring warmth.

While wondering one night, Haruto meets a beautiful girl called Yoshino-Hime. Since that day, something changed within him. Preparing for the biggest festival of the year in 2 weeks, the quiet rural town started to become active...
v775.description:
寄宿在青梅竹马居住的旅馆中的朱雀学園2年级学生桐谷阳斗(桐ヶ谷陽斗)，做了一个不可思议的梦。
在神社的境内，与美丽少女相遇的梦……少女说道。
　“吾将实现汝之愿望”
从那天起，阳斗的内心，开始发生了什么变化。
在熟悉的校舍里，与熟悉的朋友，还有同班少女们一起度过的日子。
宁静的乡下小镇，为了迎接两周后即将到来的镇上最大的庆典而变得忙碌起来——。
春天，又来了。
与去年相同的景色，却散落着不同樱花的季节。

在远离都市喧嚣的乡下氛围中，与个性十足的女孩子们，开始了一段快乐、温柔又有点不可思议的生活。

『——会坠入爱河的。因为这是春天嘛！』

v1021.title: 英雄×魔王
v1021.originalDescription:
You are Felser, lord of the demons. For a long time, your race lived in peace with the humans. One day, your seneschal Galef announced you the dire news: Humans have started to attack your lands!

While fighting them, you learned that the humans decided to eradicate your race just because they saw it as a threat. Amused by that, you decided that if that is how they see you, you should as well just go back to your old ways and conquer them all!
v1021.description:
那是一个人类与魔族存在的奇幻世界。
长久以来保持着均衡的两者关系，随着岁月流逝，
逐渐变成了魔族占据优势的局面。

菲利斯城的城主，菲尔泽(フェルザー)也是那魔族中的一员。
讨厌人类的他，时而破坏周边的城镇，时而拔掉侧近老仆的头发，
过着随心所欲的每一天。

然而有一天，为了发泄郁闷而去大闹一场的城镇里，
他遭到了人类自作聪明的妨碍。
菲尔泽对至今仍不理解抵抗也是徒劳的人类感到愤怒，
为了将他们完全置于自己的支配之下，终于挺身而出！

首先作为开端，他计划向所有人类植入真正的恐惧，
但手下的士兵却完全派不上用场，甚至落得输给人类的悲催下场。
菲尔泽被迫陷入了只能以极少数人进行战斗的境地。

而且由于孩子强烈继承了母亲的特征，
但统治其他地区的魔族和人类不可能对此坐视不管，
接二连三地发起了攻击。

菲尔泽究竟能否打倒挡在面前的魔族与人类，
将世界推入恐惧的深渊呢？

v1129.title: メタモルファンタジー
v1129.original: メタモルファンタジー
aliases: メタモルファンタジー
v1129.originalDescription:
In this world; fairies, witches and all kinds of strange creatures live in a peaceful coexistence. Protagonist is Hatayama, he is a kind of monster that looks exactly like a small plush bear. 

He enrolled in the magic academy to study magic but lately his interest switched more towards the girls in the school than the magic studies. His magic allows him to transform himself to any monster he previously met. But to learn the magic to transform himself to a real human, he first has to master that divine magic called "love".



Metamor Fantasy is a branching adventure game with card battle minigames.
v1129.description:
IMG1 エスクード制作的《变身幻想》焕然一新回归了！

这是一部略带奇幻色彩的小魔女学园题材作品，主人公是为了成为使魔而学习的、外形像可爱的布偶一般的生物。游戏的最终目标是"成为人类"。为此不仅要提升能力值，还必须在女孩子们之间萌生出"爱"。

此外，要让女孩子们之间萌生出爱，有时需要采取温柔的行动，并提升每个女孩子各自设定的好感度。根据主人公做了多少坏事、女孩子们的好感度有多高，结局会发生变化。

这里是魔女、妖精和奇妙生物们共存的魔法世界，安戈尔诺亚——
话虽如此，其实和我们居住的世界并没有太大的不同，
孩子们照样去学校上学，
大人们除了周日、盂兰盆节和正月以外也都在勤恳工作。
而且，能使用魔法的只是一部分人类，
"奇幻"的生物们如今也面临着灭绝的危机。
并且，"真正的魔法"正在逐渐被遗忘的世界——
在这样的魔法界安戈尔诺亚中，排名第一的憧憬职业是职业
"小魔女"和"使魔"！
用魔法之力帮助人们的小魔女及其使魔们，对于大多数不能使用魔法的人来说，是憧憬的对象。当然，这个世界也有实现这些人们憧憬的学校。私立圣泉恩格尔魔法学院。这是一所培养职业小魔女和使魔的专门学校。——就在这时，一名（？）转学生到来了。他的名字叫畑山芳纪（ハタヤマ・ヨシノリ）。不是人类。
外表看起来只是个布偶，自称只是个普通转学生。这样的畑山君根本没有成为职业使魔的打算，他的目标是掌握"变成人类的魔法"。……然后，当这样的他遇到了能变身为任何生物的禁断暗魔法"变身魔法"的时候……
但是，要成为人类需要真正的魔法"爱"……没问题吗？而且谜之秘密结社"暗魔法学会"也出现了，简直乱七八糟！到底会变成什么样呢……
"变身幻想"——那是，小魔女与布偶与变身与魔法与乱七八糟与……还有，爱的故事……吗？

v1545.originalDescription:
The protagonist Tsukioka Akira is a normal guy living his usual life, except for one thing. His twin sister is sickly and is in the hospital and can’t go to school. Problem is that she’s been sick for too long and she may have to repeat the year, or worse drop out of school.

So their parents being the most clever people in the world, decided to send him, the splitting image of his sister, over to the all-girls prestigious school to go undercover as his sister, and live her life for a while so that when she comes back, she can take his place without dropping out of school or repeating. Of course it’s a stupid idea and he resisted, but him, being someone who is easily swept away, gave in.

So thereon starts his incredible life in an all girls school.
v1545.description:

然而，事与愿违，不知为何他被学校里首屈一指的超级大小姐看中，
成为了卷入整个学园的闹剧的中心！

主人公究竟能否顺利完成妹妹的替身任务呢？！

v3240.originalDescription:
Who said that first?

Hino, the captain of the student council, always writes a big circle on the paper when she approves. Hino writes Maru (circle). That's why it is called "Hinomaru" order!

Shuuhei, the main character, has started working as a director of the student council just recently...
v3240.description:
～大宇宙の誇り》实现震撼出道的WHEEL的第2部作品，是尝试了完全转变方向的“TV动画风学园轻松ADV”！
大量的事件CG与语音，以及为了享受搞笑与萌而删减了多余日常场景的故事展开，宛如TV动画般高节奏＆高张力！！
各路线剧本也变成了轻松却充满浓密搞笑与萌的短篇剧本。
让生活在忙碌现代的玩家能够轻松愉快地游玩，请关注这部新感觉的恋爱喜剧！

究竟是谁说出口的？
听说会长鹰城日乃在下达裁决时，会在文件上画个大大的圆圈。
因为日乃画了“○”，所以是日之丸(ひのまる)命令！
町子：“料理研究部似乎发生了问题”
日乃：“有投诉信来了吧？”
学生会长鹰城日乃前辈，将视线落在收到的投诉信上。
学生会设置的意见箱，似乎时常会收到这类咨询。
不过，我实际看到投诉信还是第一次。
我·大友修平作为学生会的干事，开始打杂干活，还是最近的事。

v3329.originalDescription: On a cold and mysterious night, five precious stones fell from the sky, each unintentionally discovered by five innocent girls. Unbeknownst to them, chaotic forces seek to retrieve these jewels, for they are the Demon Stones: apocalyptic artifacts capable of imbuing great power, yet at the cost of one’s sanity and soul. But all is not lost, for there is an individual who seeks to protect these gems and their bearers from these antagonists, regardless of the cost.
v3329.description:
──现代，璀璨辉耀的夜之街
在大楼间如装饰蛋糕般的峡谷中
一架直升机疾驰而过。
……仿佛在逃避着什么。

那是突如其来的事。
与近代街景形成对照的黑龙出现了──

直升机坠落了。
连同它的货物一起……

翌日，花月洸手中握着一枚不可思议的吊坠。
那颗仿佛将黑色彩虹封入石中的宝石
竟是昨夜从天而降的。

那颗宝石──魔石，丘比特佩德罗斯
将本以为不可能实现的愿望
接连化为现实，令洸惊叹不已。

然而，与此同时出现的
两个奇妙的男人──

魔石的原主人，珠宝辛迪加"我等卡特尔"──
以及，卡特尔的叛徒，丛神八寻及其一派──

各自派遣的、以消灭彼此为目的的刺客
洸不由分说地被卷入了二人的战斗
以及，同样获得了魔石的少女们──

丘比特佩德罗斯───＞花月洸
奥格斯宝石───＞八坂野琉璃(八坂野 るり)
孔雀之泪───＞琴代绮罗(琴代 キラ)
特诺奇蒂特兰之骷髅──＞武原琥珀(武原 こはく)
无铭之华───＞草壁真珠

五颗魔石，五位少女的命运
将交由你的手中……

v4966.description:
“你，寒假有什么安排吗？”
寒假前的结业式结束后，主人公收到了同班同学神薙夕凪
莫名其妙的邀请。
怀着些许私心跟着她走，最终到达的地方是
考古学部的部室。
考古学部为了将遗迹内部拍摄下来，
需要身为摄影部员的主人公的力量。
而且，这次的探索，并非只是普通的遗迹探索。
如果在遗迹中没有发现什么了不起的东西，
修建水坝的公共计划就会推进，夕凪的故乡就会被水淹没。
虽然不太情愿，但结果主人公还是
被半强制地参加了进来。
当然，这个时候的主人公，
并没有余力去思考为什么自己这个幽灵摄影部员会摊上这么重大的任务。
探索遗迹，能够拯救村庄吗？
在此期间会有怎样的相遇，又会结下怎样的羁绊？
说起来，究竟是谁提出要邀请主人公的呢？
在古代遗迹的深处，存在着那个答案……

v6820.title: なでしこドリップ
v6820.originalDescription: At his cousin's request, Takumi returns to the countryside during summer vacation to work at a cafe with her and several other girls.
v6820.description:
■□■故事■□■
时隔3年回来的乡下小镇——
被表妹美羽邀请，暑假期间，决定在咖啡店打工了。
即便如此，对咖啡还是有些讲究的。
以极其轻松的心情接受了，那里是奶奶以前经营的老旧店铺
充满复古感，营造出了很好的氛围。
……这么说是不是太好听了一点。
总之就是完全没有修缮和打扫！
是一间破破烂烂、荒废已久的店铺！！
一般来说，这种乡下会有客人来吗？
而且什么？美羽是店长！？
“嘿嘿，哥哥。开店准备，来帮忙吧！”
把偶然（？）重逢的青梅竹马，以及双胞胎姐妹都卷了进来，渐渐地变得骑虎难下了。
听说连附近的神社巫女，都很期待店铺的开张。
既然如此，只能干了吧！
既然要干，就把它做成一家极其时髦、能泡出好喝咖啡的店吧。
打造出符合我们喜好的属于我们的店！
菜单也好，内饰也好，女仆装也好，全部亲手制作。
复古的古董咖啡店里，身着和风哥特风格服装的少女们——
我们这一夏天的体验，现在，拉开帷幕。

■□■登场角色■□■
●水城 美羽　（CV：小倉結衣）
身高：154cm
三围：B87/W61/H85
咖啡店的临时店长，小两岁的表妹。
开朗积极向上的性格。
非常喜欢巧巳，希望能早日被认可为成熟女性。
小时候，曾请求过“想成为哥哥的新娘”，
那时被告知“等你长大了”，至今仍记忆犹新。
“从今天起就和哥哥在同一屋檐下了呢？小心别被妹妹袭击了哦！”

●高千穂 柚希　（CV：藤森ゆき奈）
身高：160cm
三围：B81/W59/H83
在城里巧巳家隔壁的邻居，也是青梅竹马，就读于大小姐女子学校的才女。
不管做什么通常都比别人做得好，
但有样样通样样松的地方，经常在差一步的地方失败。
巧巳总是若无其事地帮她打圆场，但她无法坦率地道谢。
“只是碰巧，目的地一样而已啦，真、真的哦？”

●小樱胡桃(小桜 くるみ)　（CV：手塚りょうこ）
身高：151cm
三围：B75/W56/H79
比巧巳小三岁的美羽的朋友。
和雏是双胞胎姐妹，胡桃是姐姐。
沉默寡言，表情变化很少。
观察力很优秀，但不擅长自己主动行动。
因为不擅长表达感情，加上总是顾及周围人的性格，容易引起误解，
但也有总是挂念着雏的温柔一面。
“别用色色的眼神看我的妹妹……妹控”

●小樱雏(小桜 ひな)　（CV：shizuku）
身高：151cm
三围：B77/W57/H80
比巧巳小三岁的美羽的朋友。
和胡桃是双胞胎姐妹，雏是妹妹。
天真烂漫，表情丰富。
对什么都感兴趣，也很快就和巧巳亲近起来。
性格稍微有些孩子气，有点让人提心吊胆的冒失鬼属性。
咖啡店的女仆装是雏和胡桃制作的。
主要是雏擅长制作衣服，胡桃擅长制作小物件。
“关于巧前辈是个怎样的人，我一直都很感兴趣呢！”

●姬石穗香(姫石 穂香)　（CV：楠鈴音）
身高：165cm
三围：B92/W61/H88
在附近神社担任巫女，年长的大和抚子。
作为这片土地上驱除妖怪的第一人，也有凛然的一面。
虽然一本正经，但不知哪里少根筋。
是咖啡店的第一位常客，休息日和休息时间会来看书，
但也会各种帮忙。
“哎呀哎呀，如果有能帮忙的地方，请尽管说哦。”

●椿　（CV：吉野裕夏）
身高：145cm
三围：B72/W54/H74
不知何时来到咖啡店并赖着不走的少女。
其真面目竟然是……！？
外表娇小，但性格却非常自大，一旦相信了某件事就很难改变意见。
说是唯我独尊也就到此为止，但也有该妥协时好好妥协的地方。
只要给她茶和仙贝，暂且就会安静下来。
“嗯，作为家臣今天的茶相当不错，赐予你褒奖”

v7143.originalDescription: Main character is an executive of a secret evil society that manages to capture the justice idol heroine. His job is to train her into an obedient slave. But there is another justice heroine still fighting the organization. It would be perfect to catch her and train into pet as well.
v7143.description:
★故事

普林斯·加兰德(プリンス・ガーランド)（默认名/可自定义）是秘密结社"马克·杰内"的年轻干部。
然而，他之所以能获得现在的地位，很大程度上是因为他的哥哥——在组织内拥有压倒性支持的杰内西斯将军(ジェネシス将軍)的影响，他一直为对伟大哥哥的强烈自卑感所困扰。
在这样的情况下，成功捕获了站在地上人类一方、与组织为敌的圣天使普莉玛贝璐。
加兰德进言将捕获的普莉玛贝璐进行实验分析，将圣天使的力量为组织所用，并出色地被委以这一重任。
★登场角色

●若草纯菜
就读于圣樱草女子学园的女学生。
然而她的真实身份是守护人们和平的爱与正义的女主角圣天使"普莉玛贝璐"。
开朗活泼、正义感强的女孩。性格踏实可靠又爱照顾人，是周围人依赖的类型，在老师中评价也很高。此外自尊心很强，认为自己正确的事情绝不妥协。
纯真无邪，尚不知恋爱为何物。●皋月乃翼(皐月乃つばさ)
就读于圣樱草女子学园○等部的女学生。
然而她的真实身份与纯菜相同，也是爱与正义的女主角圣天使"普莉玛贝璐"。
充满活力，比起用脑子思考更倾向于先行动的类型。纯粹且非常坚强。
但是，她也容易固执己见，一旦决定就勇往直前，即使那是鲁莽的也会一往无前。
她称呼前辈纯菜为"姐姐大人"，似乎怀有超越憧憬的感情。

●千佳酱(チカちゃん)
乍一看像是○学生风格的女孩子，但其实是杰内西斯将军为被委任此次计划的主人公准备的秘书。自称"二十岁"。
与外表一样，天真幼稚。但被当成小孩子的话会生气。
笨手笨脚总是失败的她，为了对主人公的好意而努力着，同时也成为了敏感易受伤的主人公的"治愈"存在。

●千春(ちはる)
秘密结社"马克·杰内"超科学研究开发部的开发主任，同时也是主人公的青梅竹马。
不喜欢与人交往且阴沉的性格，使她在组织内显得格格不入。
但她的技术和智力都很优秀，是组织不可或缺的存在。
加入组织的理由是能让她自由进行喜欢的实验和发明。
虽然一直和主人公在一起，但两人水火不容。
旁人看来她给人冷淡的印象，但和适龄女孩一样，似乎也怀有各种烦恼。

●女将穆恩格拉姆(ムーングラム)
秘密结社"马克·杰内"的皇帝马卡斯·杰内尔(マルカス・ジェネイル)直属的干部。
马克·杰内三将军（她、杰内西斯将军、以及主人公）之一。
杰内西斯将军的妻子，对主人公来说是义姐。
●杰内西斯将军
秘密结社"马克·杰内"的干部。
在组织内获得压倒性支持的豪杰。
虽然很珍惜、疼爱身为弟弟的主人公，但也经常严厉对待他，希望他成为出色的男人。

v7666.original: ラブリー・ラブドール

v7666.originalDescription: A huge box is delivered to main character's house. Insides is a sleeping girl. She is the latest model of love doll. It is protagonist's duty to test the product and help it develop.
v7666.description:
寄到就读于某所二流大学的主人公·翔平处的“巨大快递”。
看到寄件人的名字是猿股博士，虽然感到诧异但还是打开了箱子，从里面出现了——

“床”和装在抽屉里的“少女·爱丽丝(アイリ)”。

爱丽丝是猿股博士开发的最新型爱情人偶，
凭借独立开发的AI功能拥有思考能力和感情，
却是几乎没有运动能力的“人偶”。
翔平半被强迫地，为了将这个人偶商品化，
被迫陪同进行“各种测试”，
但他渐渐对爱丽丝展现出的感情色彩感到困惑。
此外，主人公的表妹·樱 弓音(桜 弓音)，以及猿股的侄女、在主人公的大学担任讲师的
AI研究者·菱形 绿子(菱形 緑子)也被卷入其中而展开的
闹剧，以及略带一丝感伤（？）的故事。
其结局究竟会——

v8231.originalDescription: This is the fandisk for Taiyou no Promia, taking place a few months after the closure of the original. Kodama gets to spend his summer with the ‘six flowers’ (and Promia) at Reno-Leno’s suggestion.
v8231.description:
袭击米尔桑特的骚动过去数月后，季节迎来了夏天。
然而，今年的夏天是前所未有的酷暑。
从前些天的事件起一直连续工作的六花们，已经显露出疲态。
就在这时，六花长莉诺·雷诺(リノ＝レノ)提议给一直努力的六花们放个暑假作为奖励。
在各自的六花们定好暑假日程后，
最后轮到木灵(コダマ)决定暑假的日程了。
木灵究竟会和谁一起度过这耀眼的暑假呢？
与此同时，倾泻在米尔桑特的流星群，究竟意味着什么？
盛夏的太阳之下，繁花盛开的日子——
现在，开始了。

v11726.title: お嬢様はご機嫌ナナメ
v11726.original: お嬢様はご機嫌ナナメ
aliases: お嬢様はご機嫌ナナメ
v11726.originalDescription: Hajime had been Nanami’s loyal servant ever since her family took him and his younger sister Hana in after their parents passed away. Every day, he fends off the succession of men from noble families who come to propose to her. One day, Nanami came to their run-down apartment and asked him to teach her the life of the common people. At the same time, a fellow student at Tenshouin Academy, Otoha, asked for his advice in becoming an idol, and Nanami’s cool friend Touka also started acting weird. Then the daughter of the Naname group’s rival corporation, Shiaya, proposed to him all of a sudden. What will happen to him?
v11726.description:
你总是态度别扭！？
多年来，我作为大小姐的贴身侍从侍奉着她，但说实话是不是差不多到极限了？
大小姐——七枷七波(ななめ ななみ)，是一位令人有些惊讶的美少女，但就连我也时常搞不懂她在想什么，是个不可思议系。
把接二连三向她求婚的哪里的富家公子们砍倒一片也是执事的职责，曾有一段时间每天都被迫进行决斗。
不仅如此。
前些日子，她突然造访了对我来说唯一的治愈之所、我和最爱的妹妹樱咲花(さくらざき はな)两人租住的破旧公寓，并说了这样的话。
“樱咲，能教教我平民的生活吗？”
大财阀的大小姐，究竟为什么？
而我感到极限的理由是——！
除了大小姐之外，在同一所天照院学园上学的响木音羽(ひびき おとは)也突然找我商量说她想成为偶像。
与此同时，酷酷的女性朋友一峰透夏(いちみね とうか)也不知为何变得怪怪的。
最过分的是，七枷财阀的竞争对手雪小路财阀的大小姐雪小路诗绫(ゆきのこうじ しあや)。这位看起来文静的深闺千金，握住我的手突然告白？
七波大小姐，总觉得心情很糟糕！
今后我究竟会变成怎样？

v14838.title: どうして、そんなに黒い髪が好きなの？
v14838.original: どうして、そんなに黒い髪が好きなの？
aliases: どうして、そんなに黒い髪が好きなの？
Doushite, Sonna ni Kuroi Kami ga Suki na no?
Why Do You Like Black Hair So Much?
v14838.originalDescription:
This is the first title by FIRE WORKS. Why does the protagonist like black hair so much? Well, there’s no need to have a reason, but it might have had something to do with his surroundings during childhood. As the heir to a shrine, he had been surrounded by black-haired women for as long as he could remember. You could say it was in his blood.

Thus, it’s only natural that a beautiful black-haired girl would appear before him when he was about to freeze to death. He was captivated by her beauty and thought to himself that if he was going to die, he would marry a black-haired bishoujo like her. So, he proposed to her on the spot.

Many months later after he had miraculously survived, the girl Ichou, who was one of the gods of marriage, returned to become his bride. His miko osananajimi Urara would not accept their relationship, but he could not turn down a request from a black-haired lady, especially one who had saved his life. Afterwards, they were joined by Ichou’s imouto Sakuya and the self-proclaimed shinigami-possessed (chuuni) Mizuha. Surrounded by black-haired girls, the odds of his wish being fulfilled look bright.
v14838.description:
为什么，会那么喜欢黑发呢？
喜欢不需要理由吧。 尽管如此，成长环境或许也是无法忽视的。
毕竟，我是神社的继承人。 从懂事起，周围就全是黑长发的女性。
一定是从血统上就本来就喜欢黑发。
所以，在陷入冻死边缘的现在―― 就算看到了黑发美女的幻影，那也是理所当然的吧。
“喂，起来吧。 凡人之躯睡在这种地方可是会冻死的哦”
为了消除烦恼而造访的永久冻土灵山上，她向遇难的我说出了这句话。
即便如此也是一位超乎想象的美女。 从那黑发中，又传来了好闻的香味。
“啊，反正都要死，真想和这样的黑发美女结婚啊！”
我忍不住向她求婚了。
――几个月后，奇迹般保住一命的我，被青梅竹马的巫女凤月 丽（鳳月 うらら）踩着脚，被她用冰冷的视线瞪着。
“你的新娘到底是怎么回事？ 居然想跟我以外的人结婚，梦话还是睡着说去吧”
老实说，比起被踩的疼痛，丽的黑发轻柔摇曳更让我在意，不过现在确实顾不上那些了。
“妾身是岩长之银杏媛（岩長ノ銀杏媛）。 作为结缘神的一柱来实现主公的愿望，是来……来当你的新娘的。 你总不会，有、有意见吧？”
原来如此！ 是神明的话那就没办法了。 而且作为救命之恩的回报，我作为从神，要帮忙实现银杏小姐的神托。
话虽如此，丽似乎并不认同，但我本来就是无法拒绝黑发女性请求的体质。
此外，还有银杏小姐的妹神，咲耶小姐。
在神社进行奇怪仪式的，自称被死神附体的系女子、中二病患者水叶同学也加入了进来。
全员都是神明与头发!? 甜蜜恋爱吗？

v16103.title: 鲸神的Tearstilla
v16103.original: 鯨神のティアスティラ
aliases: 鯨神のティアスティラ
v16103.originalDescription:
The water capital, Amanoshima Island, brings in many tourists with its network of canals. It became prosperous due to its ‘energy water’ industry which can be used for everything from consumption to energy, and a school was built to do further research on it. It is on this mysterious island that there is a folklore about a water god who can grant wishes.

One day, Yuuma drifted ashore in a suitcase. He met a young girl Riru, who was the kujiragami (whale god) in the legend. However, for some reason she had lost her ability to grant wishes. She asked for his help to regain her powers and thus, he became her messenger. This is the beginning of the story about the return of the legend of the water of wishes.
v16103.description:
“如果任何愿望都能实现，你会许下什么愿望？”

四面环海的水之都“天洲岛”。
城市各处遍布水路是其特色，吸引了许多游客来访。
得益于从饮用到电力转换皆可的万能资源“能量水”的产业，城市繁荣发展，还建立了用于研究它的学园。
在这座不可思议的岛上，自古以来就流传着“司水之神会实现人的愿望”的传说。

某天，主人公成海悠真不知为何被塞在皮箱里漂流到了海岸上。
在这座毫无记忆的岛上徘徊时，他遇到了一位少女，她竟然自称是传说中提到的“鲸神”。
然而本该拥有的“实现愿望的力量”却因某种原因失去了，她是为了取回力量而前来求助的。

就这样，阴差阳错之下悠真成为了鲸神的使者，与在岛上遇到的伙伴们一起，再次唤醒“愿望水”传说的故事开始了。

他们最后会实现怎样的愿望呢——？

v17632.title: 千层恋心
v17632.original: 恋する気持ちのかさねかた
aliases: 恋する気持ちのかさねかた
v17632.originalDescription:
Starting next spring, adjacent schools Seiou Gakuen and Shiraba Gakuen will merge at the same time of the marriage between their respective chairmen. One day, Seiou student Ren and the student council leader Saori were asked by the chairman Rin to find out any worries that the students have about the merger. They immediately enlisted the help of the Shiraba student council leader Yukie and began to ask the students of both schools.

They each had their own worries: the closure of the student dormitory, the elimination of smaller clubs, an emotional attachment to their school, no longer able to chase after their dreams, family matters, and much more. Ren offers his hand in helping the girls with their worries and they happen to end up living together as ‘lovers’.
v17632.description:
传统校之间的结婚——
清桜学園与其相邻的白羽学園，以两校理事长之间的结婚为契机，决定在下年度的春天合并。

某天，就读于清桜学園的主人公・皇城蓮与学生会长・月島沙織，被学園的理事长同时也是蓮的哥哥的皇城凛叫去，
被拜托“在学園统合之际，希望你们能梳理出学生们的烦恼、不安与问题点。”

蓮与沙織立刻向白羽学園的学生会长・鏑木由希江请求协助，开始对两校的学生们进行听取调查。

因学生宿舍的废除而被迫搬家的孩子。因社团活动的合并而被淘汰的少数人社团。
其他还有对学園抱有感情、未来的梦想被封闭、抱有家庭情况的……

向怀有此类烦恼的“她们”伸出援手的蓮。
然后，机缘巧合之下，“恋人们两人”的同居生活开始了。

恋人们两人在寻常的日常中感到幸福，加深爱意，不知不觉间描绘起在那前方的相同未来——

v18842.title: 花之天使的夏日恋歌
v18842.original: フローラル・フローラブ
aliases: フローラル・フローラブ
v18842.originalDescription:
On that day, I saw an angel.
"If you become a lover with a person who is like an angel, you will definitely enjoy your daily life like you were in heaven."

Originally, Saisu Masataka did not believe in things like angels or fate.
But, he got locked on completely by one of the "angels".

Mihato Kano is his childhood friend, and one of the top ojousamas at their school.
Even though he gets showered by her love every day, it still feels like they're on a completely different level.

Kano's best friend, Tokisaka Nanao, is a black-haired girl with a model's appearance.
Because of her indifferent and feisty personality, she is called a tsundere angel.

Adelheid von Bergstrasse is an actual princess.
Her singing voice is so good that it's compared to an angel's, but she needs to be taken care of and is naturally a sleepyhead.
Tsubaki Kohane is a Christian, and is called an angel because of her kind personality.

"Hmm... on a second thought, don't I have some kind of a relationship with them all?"
But it seems to be fate, that he has a small secret.

By looking at a person, he can see wings on them.
When they are good, an angel's wings will show, and when they are bad, a devil's will show.

That had started in his childhood
When he saw the wings of angel for the first time ever.
v18842.description:
——那一天，我看见了天使。

如果能和天使一样的她们成为恋人，一定会迎来天国般的每一天！

不过他，齐须柾鹰（斉須 柾鷹），一直认为自己与天国无缘。
却被其中一位天使完全锁定了。

虽然确实和美鸠夏乃（美鳩 夏乃）是青梅竹马，但她可是学园第一的大小姐！
就算每天被她发射喜欢光束，也是遥不可及的高岭之花。

她的朋友，朱鹭坂七绪（朱鷺坂 七緒）是模特级别的黑发美女，冷淡到被称为傲娇天使。

阿德尔海特·冯·贝格施特拉瑟（アーデルハイト・フォン・ベルクシュトラーセ）是真正的公主大人！
独唱被赞赏为天使的歌声，但总是无精打采的，让人操心。

椿姬恋羽（椿姫 こはね）是虔诚的基督徒。
是名副其实被称为天使的性格美人，柾鹰对她抬不起头。

……嗯？
回过神来，不是和所有人都扯上关系了吗？

但那或许也是宿命。他有一个微小的秘密。

仔细看的话，能看见天使的翅膀。
当那颗心向善时能看见天使，向恶时则会看见恶魔的羽翼。

那是年幼时——
从第一次看见天使开始，就已经注定了。

v21530.title: あぶのーまるらば～ず
v21530.originalDescription:
Hinata lives with his mother Mayoi and his older sister Akeno, while training as a cook at the family’s Café Carroll. Even though his childhood friend Mimi causes a ruckus every day, he leads a peaceful and happy life while aiming to become a full-fledged cook.

However, his mother got in an accident one day and he had to take over running the family business until she recovered. The popular grade A student Seri, childhood friend Mimi and quiet classmate Yukana all came to live and work at the coffee shop for varying reasons. He was wondering if everything will turn out alright when the three girls, along with his older sister Akeno, made advances on him starting from that very first night. Moreover, it was an abnormal type of love!
v21530.description:
在老家的咖啡馆Carol里，作为厨师进行修行的主人公，与身为母亲也是师傅的真宵、姐姐小野寺晓乃(暁乃)三人一起生活。
虽然青梅竹马的嶋宫姫兔每天都在惹出骚动，但主人公依然过着快乐的学园生活，为了实现自己成为独当一面的厨师的梦想，日子过得十分和平。

然而，有一天，母亲遭遇事故，无法再站进厨房了。但是，
“为了客人，店还是要开的哦。这就是所谓的咖啡馆！”
在母亲的一声令下，主人公作为厨师，决定在母亲回归之前经营咖啡馆，但是人手不足。
就在这时，

濑莉：因为我没有工作过，所以想借此机会好好进行社会学习♪
姫兔：如果咪咪和飞君结了婚，就必须接手这家店对吧？所以，新娘的修行还是早点进行比较好哦♪
结奏：想着每天都能吃到美味的员工餐
晓乃：靠这些人真的没问题吗……？

就这样，在学园里很受欢迎的朝比奈濑莉、青梅竹马的嶋宫姫兔、沉默寡言的同班同学镝城结奏作为住店打工的帮手来到了这里。

本以为这样总该有办法了吧？结果从第一天晚上开始，包括姐姐晓乃在内的四个人就向他求爱了。
然而，所有人的爱意都沉重得偏离了方向！？
咖啡馆能顺利开张吗？还有，来自异常的她们那沉重的爱将走向何方？

v23501.title: 玉响未来
v23501.originalDescription:
There is a girl, searching for something she lost...

In the town of Fukano, the air smells otherworldly. Long ago, humans and other spirits—the sorts of creatures we called youkai—lived together on this enchanted soil. Even now Fukano is still full of strange stories, of mystical entities and mysterious forces.

Kamikake Yukina has come back to this town with a friend in tow.

In Fukano she meets a boy who calls himself a sorcerer. That's me!

My name is Yohane Mutsuki, and I've inherited the bloodline of the sorcerers who long ago moved to Fukano from far away—but I'm not the only person of interest in town.

Suishouseki Midari is something other than human.
She's caught the worst thing that can afflict a succubus: a case of love...

Nekotenguu Hanako was once a servant of a higher water spirit.
Now she's an urban legend at the local school, where she knows every piece of gossip that goes down!

Kohaku Shiro is always on my side.
She doesn't know a thing about magic or monsters, but she's like an older sister to me.

A sorcerer's job is to understand the inexplicable incidents non-human creatures cause, and help them live in harmony with their human neighbors.

But Kamikake Yukina has more magic than me, and was born with the power to see the spirit world.

And she's looking for something she lost.

The time I spend dealing with her will lead me back to the incident that got me involved in all of this.

It's a short summer and a long one too; a story of humans, spirits, and sorcerers... A fairytale.
v23501.description:
她正在寻找失物。

弥漫着异乡气息的城镇，深野市——
那里曾是人与非人之物、
妖异们共同生活的幽玄之地。
因此，深野充满了不可思议之人的不可思议的故事。

神掛 由岐奈，
与朋友一起，再次造访了此地。
相遇的，是自称魔法使的少年，也就是我。

在很久很久以前的大古时代，似乎有从外之国来的魔法使，
夜羽 睦季，自称是其末裔。

米兰达·琉斯特(水晶石みだり)，是非人之物。
对于淫魔而言是致死之病，坠入了爱河。

猫天宮 花子，是曾经侍奉水神的御使。
也就是所谓的厕所里的花子，只要是学园内的传闻她什么都知道。

小伯 白，无论何时都会站在我这边。
虽然对魔法和妖异一无所知，但对我来说是如同姐姐一般的存在。

魔法使的职责，就是解决那些妖异们引起的不可思议的事件，
为人与妖异之间带来和谐。

但是，神掛 由岐奈拥有在我之上的灵力，
甚至拥有天生就能看见妖异之姿的鬼见之力。

那样的她，正在寻找失物。

通过与她产生关联，
最终连成为我自身与魔法结下契机的那个事件
也被挖掘了出来。

那是人与妖异与魔法使交织而成的，
漫长而又短暂的，一夏的童话——

v28286.title: 绽放★青春全力向前冲！
v28286.original: かけぬけ★青春スパーキング！
aliases: かけぬけ★青春スパーキング！
v28286.originalDescription:
Toono Yuu, a Kazami Academy sophomore, eschews typical teen life for work――

"Youth? No time. I've got jobs."

Yuu's all about practicality, choosing part-time jobs over typical teenage fun. He manages his studies well and spends most of his time working for money. His childhood friend Hibiki and classmate Riri, who looks up to Yu, think he needs a change. They each try to get him to join a club.

Hibiki champions the "Action Club," nicknamed "Acti-Club"―― lively girls promoting "more youthful fun at school!"
Riri advocates the "Volunteer Club," nicknamed "Negati-Club"―― serious girls dedicated to "using youth to better the world."

Both relentlessly recruit Yuu――

"Not interested. Don't need youth."

Yet Yuu finds himself drawn into their world, despite his protests――
His predictable routine gives way to unexpected experiences.
How did this happen?

"Isn't it obvious?" his peers suggest.
"Brace yourself, senpai. Time to embrace your youth!"

What adventures await this reluctant teen!?
v28286.description:
主人公远野优是风间学园的二年级学生，本该正值青春期的鼎盛时期。

他享受着幸福的生活，然而——

"年轻人？这是什么？没听说过吗？请不要阻止我工作赚钱。"

以现实主义为信条的主人公，将青春奉献给了工作，每天只想着赚钱度日。

看不下去这样的优的青梅竹马恋人·响，以及将优视为恩师的同班同学理理，将他拉入某个部门，试图让他开启新的人生。

响推荐的是以"在学校更年轻、更快乐地行动吧！"为口号、由热血女生组成的"动作部"，通称"活动部"。

部长推荐的是以"为了改善这个世界，奉献你宝贵的青春"为口号、由认真的女性组成的"志愿者部"，通称"消极部"。

无论去哪个学部，都会被男主人公的同班同学纠缠着劝诱，但男主人公说："这个雉鸡科是从哪里来的？可恶，我才不需要什么青春。"

但是，出乎意料的是，男主人公每天都被两人折腾——为什么会变成这样呢？

"这不是必要的吗？~~"

"请做好准备，前辈们马上就要休息的时间了！"

远野优会有怎样的青春在等待着他呢？

v29402.originalDescription:
Royal Cendrillon Academy.

To fulfill a promise, the protagonist Takita Shunsuke enrolled in the attendant department.
There, they are tasked to serve a student from the royal department as part of their extracurricular activities, attending to all kinds of princesses.

"Or, that was how it was supposed to be---"

Committing a blunder on the day of the entrance ceremony, Shunsuke now faces the threat of repeating a year halfway into the school year.
The girl he exchanged a childhood promise with, Bernadette Henrietta Eiselston
The son of a royal prince with a secret, Anri Francis La Bernard
The young lady of a large corporation with an eccentric tongue, Sasara Orihime
The mild-mannered classmate, Shirokama Naomi

Obtaining the aid of various people, Shunsuke traces the path toward becoming a full-fledged attendant.

All for the sake of the "promise" he once made.
v29402.description:
王立桑德利昂学园。

主人公“泷田骏介(瀧田駿介)”为了履行某个约定，进入了那里的从士科就读。
从士科有一项陪同并照顾王侯科学生的课外活动，因此他要去照顾各种各样的公主大人……。

“哎，本来应该是这样的呢～～～”

在开学典礼当天惹出问题的骏介，仅仅半年就面临了留级的危机。
曾经交换过约定的，“贝尔纳黛特·亨丽埃塔·艾泽尔斯顿(ベルナデッド・ヘンリエッタ・アイゼルストン)”
怀抱秘密的王弟之子，“亨利＝弗朗西斯·拉·贝尔纳尔德(アンリ＝フランシス・ラ・ベルナールド)”
用神秘语言说话的大企业千金，“佐佐良织姬(佐々良織姫)”
低调的同班同学，“城釜奈绪美(城釜奈緒美)”

在许多人的帮助下，骏介以成为独当一面的从者为目标。

那只是为了“约定”。

v30233.original: コイ×ミツ ～千葉静玖とサボテンの手紙～
aliases: コイ×ミツ ～千葉静玖とサボテンの手紙～
Koi x Mitsu ~Senba Shizuku to Saboten no Tegami~
v30233.description:
仿佛在热巧克力里加了超多砂糖一般，梦想着甜蜜青涩恋爱的主人公——桐生千寻。

然而，他只是因为眼神凶恶和态度问题让女孩子感到害怕，别说女朋友了……连一个女性朋友都没有交到。

在度过着如此寂寞的青春的某一天，他看到了同班同学、现充女孩八重练纱祈的诗集笔记本。

被看到的纱祈慌了神，不小心说漏嘴坦白自己其实是伪现充。

“你要负起知道了这件事的责任哦！”

只有主人公一个人的点心同好会被纱祈夺走，被改造成了为了成为现充——互相商量恋爱事宜的同好会。
接着，唯一的朋友？身为模特且喜欢恶作剧的学姐绢织双鸠，以及时隔数年重新开始交流的古怪玩家表妹千叶静玖(千葉静玖)，都因为觉得有趣而被卷了进来。

为了进行如蜜般甜蜜的恋爱的秘密究竟是什么？性格迥异的四人的恋爱咨询开始了。

v32183.title: 绘缘蜜恋-longing for you-
v32183.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Nabeshima Tatsuya, was a world-renowned painter.

However, after a certain incident, he disappeared from the public eye.
Now as a social studies teacher, he spends his days away from the art world.

He lives in seclusion with his cat in his social studies preparation room, which is his own residence, away from the public eye.
However, with the arrival of the new school semester, a new wind begins to blow.

Kusunoki Iroha, an attractive girl who adores Tatsuya.

Kurusu Sakuya, the most talented girl in the school, who is mysteriously attracted to Tatsuya;

and Akebi Saki, the daughter of Tatsuya's former teacher.

A life of dullness, like being dead inside while living.
Now it is being colored in gorgeous and vibrant colors by the three girls.
v32183.description:
主人公——鍋島立哉，曾是一位世界闻名的画家。

然而，以某件事为契机，他从台前销声匿迹，

作为一名社会科教师，过着与画坛毫无瓜葛的日子。

在作为自己居城的社会科准备室里，

避开世人耳目，与爱猫过着隐遁生活。

但是，随着新学期的到来，一阵新风也吹了进来。

慕恋着立哉的，现代女高中生楠木伊吕波(楠木いろは)。

神秘地引诱立哉的学园第一才女，来栖桜綾。

以及恩师的女儿，明日咲沙希。

如同生不如死般的钝色人生，

如今，正被三位少女，用艳丽的极彩色涂抹上色。

v33036.title: AMBITIOUS MISSION
aliases: アンビシャス　ミッション
v33036.description:
沙幌市——
这座城市流传着一个传说。
据说集齐被称为“Ambitious”的12颗星星之人，
能够实现一切野心……
而追寻它的人，今夜也现身于沙幌的街头——

“　　　　　　　　预告函
今夜，我要收下这座城市美丽的星空
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　怪盗密斯阿尔特”

在怪盗密斯阿尔特的作案现场，主人公“根津御影”碰巧在场。
机缘巧合之下，他看穿了其真身，
竟是班上的大小姐有濑辉夜(有瀬かぐや)。

“必须排除哪怕一丝被周围人发现的可能性。所以——我会偷给你看的。偷走你的心和叹息。”

不想暴露真身的辉夜，
为了实现自己的野心而创建了怪盗部，并试图将御影拉入其中，
但进展并不顺利。

就在那时，御影出生长大的“孤儿院”陷入了困境。
此时现身的密斯阿尔特，揭开了被隐藏的“真实”，
轻而易举地守护了孤儿院。
优雅，而又华丽。

“你是想说这和小偷不一样？”

“是的，偷走观看者的心。然后，偷走大家的叹息。这才是怪盗。”

“我明白了。我也来帮忙吧。帮你的那个‘野心’。”

“怪盗密斯阿尔特”与“怪盗午夜”
当两名怪盗联手之时，
围绕沙幌之夜被掩盖的“真实”的舞台，就此拉开帷幕——。
v33036.originalDescription:
In Sahoro City—

A legend persists. It's believed that whoever collects all 12 stars named "Ambitious" can achieve any desired dream...

And tonight, someone continues to chase this fable within the streets of Sahoro.

"Calling Card: Tonight, I'll be taking the beautiful starry sky of this city. Signed, Phantom Thief Miss Arte."

By pure coincidence, our protagonist, Nezu Mikage, happens to be at the scene of Miss Arte's latest stunt. Surprisingly, he deduces that the true identity of Miss Arte is his classmate, the  ojou-sama  (young lady) Arise Kaguya.

"We can't risk the slightest chance of someone finding out. Hence, I'll show you... I'll ensnare your heart and all the feelings it contains."

Not wanting her secret unveiled, Kaguya attempts to recruit Mikage into the phantom thief group she formed to realize her ambitions, but it doesn't quite go as planned.

At one point, the "orphanage" where Mikage grew up is jeopardized. Making her appearance, Miss Arte swiftly and elegantly protects the institution, revealing a hidden "truth" in the process.

"So, you're not like the typical thief?"

"Exactly. I steal the hearts of those who witness me and leave an indelible impression on them. That's the essence of a kaitou (phantom thief)."

"I get it. I'll lend my hand. To your yabou  (ambition) or whatever you call it."

When "Phantom Thief Miss Arte" and "Phantom Thief Midnight" join forces, the curtain rises on a tale revolving around the "truth" shrouded in Sahoro's night.

v77.originalDescription:
There’s a mountainous crag to the northeast of the Continent of Dragons called Dragon's Claw Marks. No one in the recorded history has been able to cross that area safely. However, they did not have a newly invented airship!

You play as the aspiring and newly appointed captain of this vessel, Loty Eiblyss, but you didn’t exactly come with your own crew of hardened sailors. In fact it’s more like a rowdy well-to-do family of women posing as a crew, coupled with an actual lady sword master (your teacher) and an another mysterious girl. At least this family of nine women appears to be trained to fight when the need arises.



The crew Loty Eiblyss leads is made of the sub-spirits from the Rakios Spirit Corps that Yuuto led in Eien no Aselia.
v77.description:
龙之爪痕。
位于大陆东北方的巨大裂痕。
据说在那彼方，有着被称为海佩利亚的乐园，而裂痕的底部，则有着被称为巴尔加·罗亚的地狱。
完全的隔绝。
无人能够跨越，也无人知晓跨越的方法。
它只是作为世界的神秘存在于那里。
但是——

“事情很简单。总之，有一艘能飞上天空的船就行了”

以某项发明为契机，一支世上最喧闹的探险队被组织了起来。
队员是一名天才，以及充满好奇心的精灵们，还有其他少数几人。
全身充满干劲，向着未知的世界展开想象的翅膀。
然后，被推举为队长的是一名青年。
他被个性丰富的少女们耍得团团转，同时缓缓迈出了脚步。

就这样，从结束了漫长战争的凡塔斯马戈利亚，新的冒险开始了。
出发吧，前往龙之爪痕的彼方！

v419.originalDescription: The main character is Yuu, who has just entered a high school. One day, he is forcibly taken to the club room of the love and romance club, and he finally joins them. What they do is to enjoy love and romance based on certain rules. The main purpose of this club is to help the members be able to enjoy communications with other people.
v419.description:
舞台为现代，介于城市与乡村之间的城镇——汐美台。
如其名所示靠近大海，是休闲胜地之一。主人公等恋爱部的部员们，就读于建在高地上的男女共学学校——汐美学园。
刚刚入学汐美学园的主人公——泽崎游(沢崎遊)，被恋爱部招揽，在近乎被绑架的状况下参观了恋爱部。因为恋爱部没有向大众公开活动内容，被大多数人认为是类似交友社团的社团活动。因此游起初不愿入部，但在部员们热心的活动面前，内心逐渐动摇起来。
恋爱部的活动内容，主要是进行被称为“拉布罗瓦”的、基于一定规则的恋爱。因过去的心理创伤等而与人保持距离，或不擅长应对异性，无法认真恋爱的人们，通过社团活动重新找回与他人的联系，便是这个故事的主题。

マギウステイル エタニティ
v689.originalDescription: Am I dreaming? I just came to the island to inform Koyuki, my younger sister, who is a student of a boarding high school located on the island, that our father is missing. I was perceived as an intruder, and attacked with magic. I'm now damaged so badly.... Without Koyuki, I'd have surely lost my life. Anyway, I know the reason why this school is isolated from the outside world. This school is actually established to train magicians. Like this, my new life on the island starts....
v689.description:
在世界树下，来谈一场如魔法般美妙的恋爱吗？

我是在做梦吗？为了将父亲失踪的消息告诉义妹小雪，我来到了她所在的寄宿制学园所在的岛上……作为非法入侵者被四处追赶的我，遭受的是……名为「魔法」这种不讲道理的攻击手段。

登上这座岛后第一个遇到的，是叫艾莉西亚(アリシア)的失忆女孩……叫星莱(セーラ)的女孩，满脸怒容地毫不留情地用魔法生成的电击朝我劈来。要是没遇到小雪……我肯定已经丢了命吧。

在那里我第一次知道了，这座岛拒绝与外界联系的原因。它是一座对世间隐匿的魔法使之岛。

在高耸入云的世界树下，我经历了各种各样的相遇。

失去记忆……像刚出生的小鸡一样跟在我身后转来转去的艾莉西亚。重逢之后，又开始照顾我起居的义妹小雪。相遇是最糟糕的。把我视为眼中钉的精英魔法使星莱。虽然娇小，但做事拼命、热爱花朵的学姐优花(優花)。说是小雪好友的双胞胎学妹，蕾娜(レナ)和妮娜(ニナ)。

跨越了种族……甚至跨越了次元的相遇，在我面前开辟出新的道路。小小的相遇之种……终将绽放出巨大的花朵，朝着那样的未来。

MagusTale～世界树与恋爱的魔法使～，开始了。

v1155.title: 輝光翼戰記
v1155.original: 輝光翼戦記 天空のユミナ
aliases: 輝光翼戦記 天空のユミナ
v1155.originalDescription:
"The Student Council Election is your only hope. Fight, win, and change your destiny!"

Midorishita Yumina is a junior at the prestigious Jinbu Academy. Far from being a model student, Yumina skirts the precarious line between barely passing and failing hard. One day, a young man named Akashima Ayumu transfers into her class. Ayumu claims to have been sent by his father, an eccentric and possibly delusional man who ordered Ayumu to find and protect Yumina, whom he believes will one day save the universe.

Ayumu and Yumina are at odds from the moment they first meet. They bicker endlessly, day after day, until finally Yumina goes too far and starts a fight just before a critical test. Her failure dooms her to repeat the year.

But just when it seems all hope is lost, a mysterious girl named Kurokawa Kirara appears and invites Yumina to run for Student Council President.

According to Kirara, whoever wins an Election War and becomes President will have the power to change any school rule he or she likes. Realizing that this is her only hope of becoming a senior, Yumina agrees to join the race, and drags Ayumu along for the ride!

Thus begins an epic tale of love and friendship in which youthful passions run high and debates shake the foundation of the heavens.

Who will emerge victorious!?
v1155.description:
「在星徒会淘汰赛上连胜到底吧。升级条件什么的，成为星徒会长之后进行变更就可以了」
神抚学园二年级学生，女主角「翠下弓那」由于成绩不良，过着如履薄冰的学园生活。
某一日，「朱岛步武」转入了弓那的班级。步武之所以按照父亲的吩咐转校，却是出于
『因为神抚学园内名为翠下弓那的少女，是将要守护世界的救世主』
这样一个超出常轨的理由。虽然步武认为那只是父亲的妄想，但与弓那实际见面之后，顺水推舟地与她成为了朋友。
可是二人却在根本上性情不合，每天都过着争吵不已的学园生活。
结果弓那在考试当日闹出了暴力事件，陷入了留级确定的事态。
在无比绝望的弓那面前，弱小社团「辩论部」部长「黑河云母」出现了。
云母告诉弓那，只要在星徒会淘汰赛一直赢下去成为星徒会长，就能取得所有的权限。
于是，步武与弓那被态度强硬的部长所指引，为了取消留级决定，成为候选者参加了星徒会大战！
以乱七八糟的社团活动为主，与各种各样的社团与委员会进行辩论对决。
候选者们使用设置在学园中的能够「将自己的语言实体化」的「Ethereal System」，展开了接二连三的辩论战。
依次登场的强有力的竞争对手们。不负责任的选民们。谜之无口少女、御木津蓝的登场。
然后是与最强的现星徒会长的决战。使思念具现化，让彼此的心与力激烈碰撞吧!!

v1376.originalDescription: In a nameless world where there is a ring of light in the sky and a giant tower on the ground, there exists mysterious living things called ‘Pristers’ which are alter-egos for the girls they follow. There’s a big event to determine the ‘magic girl’ and each of the 3 kingdoms send their own team to compete for the title.
v1376.description:
天空中有光环，大地上耸立着巨大的城堡，这是一个无名世界。
那里有着成为女孩分身的不可思议的生物“普莉斯塔”。
凭借拥有凶恶可爱与特殊能力的普莉斯塔的活跃，无名世界中诞生了国家，铭刻下了历史。

旧时代急速衰退，缓缓向新时代变化的时代……
其先驱者，便是リリカルプロダクション推出的“魔法少女”。
操纵拥有被称为魔法的辉煌力量的普莉斯塔，自由驰骋天空，跨越国境活跃的魔法少女的身姿，成为了凛然美丽的新时代的象征。
魔法少女们的活跃连日被媒体报导，转眼间成为了世上女孩们憧憬的对象，女孩们争先恐后地参加为了成为魔法少女而举办的世界级大型活动“魔法少女决定大会”。

从大陆上的三个国家分别选出代表队伍，在决战的舞台·金金城诞生新魔法少女的大会。
但是，仅靠女孩是无法让普莉斯塔闪耀的。在激烈的战斗中，纤细的身体与心灵会受挫。
为了引导以顶点为目标的女孩与普莉斯塔的存在，召唤导演是不可或缺的！

v1517.originalDescription: There is a restaurant, Pia Carrot. Hiroto starts working there as a part-timer, but a big gas explosion occurs on his first day there. He is badly injured and loses his job. A masked girl suddenly appears in front of him and gives him some advice. By following her advice, he becomes a boss of a newly opened restaurant, a branch restaurant of Pia Carrot. He meets his classmates and old friends there and they start working at the restaurant. His life gradually gets busy...
v1517.description:
这次是『学园』＋『Pia▼キャロ』！超人气系列第5作！

Cocktail Soft人气作品「Pia▼キャロットへようこそ!!」系列的最新作，结合了「学园」与「Pia▼キャロ」的、“if”世界具现化的、家庭餐馆+学园ADV！
继承了由前作「Pia▼キャロットへようこそ!!G.O.」开始的、制服会随着时间变化的“制服更换”，同时又跟之前的系列不同、尝试采用分章回数而进行故事的形式的，新生的「Pia▼キャロット」！
这次将以前作中担任「Pia▼キャロットへようこそ!!G.O.」原画的「日向睦月(ひなた睦月)」带头，再加上「凉香(涼香)」「光星(光星)」等人气画家3名，作为这次的制服设计以及原画！片头曲将由A-POP的先驱者“K杉”参与的大型新人组合「クサカンムリ」承担！
期待这由豪华画家＆工作人员阵容的新一代「Pia▼キャロット」吧！
 
 
故事情节
这个地方是以探索新的服务与商品为目的、贩卖对象仅为学生的学园特区：『私立水萌学园』。家庭餐馆连锁「Pia▼キャロット」也在其中的参加企业之中。
主人公鸭下大翔，获得了在「Pia▼キャロット」8号店当侍应打工的机会，却在打工的第一天引发了煤气爆炸！虽然性命保住了，然而不但难得的打工机会化为乌有，而且还要承担高价的赔偿。主人公因遭遇不幸而自暴自弃。突然，假面女侍应出现了。
因为她的建议，主人公成为了新开的「Pia▼キャロット学园特区分店」的店长。
在学园特区中、他遇上了青梅竹马、萝莉御姐、同班的眼镜娘、温柔的学姐以及可爱的学妹。
主人公将迎接她们这些各具个性的女侍应，在与她们一起工作的过程中，为各种接连不断的麻烦以及桃色事件、还有学园生活和「Pia▼キャロット」而劳碌。

v1547.original: 77（セブンズ） ～And, two stars meet again～

v1547.originalDescription:
There is a world where magic is widely spread. The story takes place at Tenryou International School, which is famous for an elite training school. The students are divided into three groups: Intelligence, Power and Fate. A school festival is held once a year. 

The main event is a battle in which a girl and two supporters are chosen from each group and they fight for a selected man, who has a special ring. Yes, the main character is the one who accidentally gets the ring.... While he is persistently chased by heroines, a mystery of their school gradually comes out...
v1547.description:
『围绕主人公展开的学园规模争夺战!?』

魔法的存在被普遍认知的世界。
科学的发展也令人瞩目，是一个更加重视个人能力与个性的时代。

故事舞台“天棱国际学园”是凭借超技术在东京湾上空悬浮的、日本引以为傲的精英培养机构。
其中特别优秀的人会根据特性被分配到“知之塔”“力之塔”“命运之塔”。

学园认可学生自治，会举办由学生主导的一大娱乐活动“星待祭”。
关乎各塔威信的这一活动，由各塔代表的女性“织姬”以及被选为其支援角色的两名“星之巫女”，为了俘获被选中的一名男性“彦星”的心而奋斗。
偶然得到了成为“彦星”的关键道具戒指的主人公，就这样被各怀心思的女主角们四处追逐。

在此之中，随着故事的推进，学园的谜团逐渐揭开。
故事逐渐发展成撼动世界的重大事件。

He takes in charge of three students and works hard! Days later, his ex-coworkers suddenly appear from the devil region and the atmosphere of the heaven region gradually becomes uneasy...
v1742.description:

v2886.originalDescription: At school, there is now an exciting competition for the next school captain. The students who go to the final are two girls, Yumina and Nayuta. The main character is Ayumu, a close friend of Yumina. He supports and fights with Yumina. But the final ends in a draw. Though they promise to fight again in several days, Nayuta tells Yumina to give Ayumu to Nayuta as her personal secretary until next battle. Ayumu is depressed at first, but he gradually understands Nayuta's concerns as he spends time with her...
v2886.description:
那由他与我们的故事

在自由的学风之中，众多学生度过日常的神撫学園。
然而如今在那里，正展开着赌上下一任会长之位的炽烈争斗。

在激战的锦标赛中胜出，站上决赛舞台的，是2名少女。
为了回避留年而参战，与论说部的同伴一同晋级的翠下弓那。
试图将现在的支配体制变得完整的前会长・神乐那由他(神楽那由他)。
而朱岛步武(朱島歩武)作为弓那的亲友，支撑着她并共同战斗。

然而弓那与那由他的决赛，以前所未闻的平局这一结果告终。
那由他虽然凭借前会长的权限占据优势，却放弃了胜利，向弓那提出了日后的重赛。
作为那个条件，那由他所提出的是，让步武作为会长秘书，调任到那由他身边。

步武本人的意愿无关紧要，被干脆地从论说部交了出去。
起初消沉的步武，在与那由他共度新的日常之中，一点点地理解了她所怀抱的想法与烦恼。

作为会长秘书工作，与那由他共度的日子。
步武的、那由他的、以及神撫学園的未来，会朝着怎样的方向前进呢——

v2936.originalDescription: It’s the last summer vacation in Taichi’s school life. He got a call from his older sister Akemi inviting him to come to his hometown to play. She works at the Pia Carrot cafe and after being introduced to the manager Sayuri, he ended up helping out at the cafe. This will be an unforgettable summer vacation.
v2936.description:
过一个难以忘怀的暑假——

校园生活最后一个暑假。
收到表姐羽瀬川朱美的电话，羽瀬川太一来到养育他的故乡来游玩。
与朱美的再遇以及两宿之旅的期待，他怀着的就是如此轻快的心情。

在阔别数年的故乡迎接他的朱美，介绍了她所工作的名为Piaキャロット的店。
那一晚，不知何故由朱美引荐给经理真柴さゆり，开始了面试。
这样在自称太一的姐姐的朱美的恳求（声泪俱落），他被迫住进了Piaキャロット7号店的宿舍打工。

翌日，他与青梅竹马的滝川ゆな相遇，开心与感概的背后，却有着一个不想再见面的理由……
甚至连妹妹ミサ也追着太一，让Piaキャロット起了大骚乱!!

与个性十足的可爱侍应一起过的夏天里的一个月。
肯定会有难以忘怀的记忆留在您的心里——

v3992.original: 涼風のメルト -Where wishes are drawn to each other-
aliases: 涼風のメルト -Where wishes are drawn to each other-
Suzukaze no Melt -Where wishes are drawn to each other-
v3992.originalDescription: Whirlpool’s 5th title is about the bonds between humans and spirits. Akihito lives in Mishiro-machi, a town which is said to be protected by a local god and spirits, but not many people nowadays believe this. Every 10 years, there is a large festival at the local shrine. Akihito serves as the priest during the festival due to his lineage, while his childhood friend Nazuna is chosen as the miko. There are rumours of a strange being around town and he doesn’t believe them until he saw the spirit himself. It seems that the spirit was lost and they help it return deep into a forest where normal people cannot enter. There he meets the beautiful god of the land Suzu. He decides to protect all the spirits in the town and return them to the forest.
v3992.description:
游戏介绍
Whirlpool第5弹作品，就是这描述精灵们与人类之间“羁绊相系的故事”的最新作！！

久违了一年多，再次由てんまそ先生操刀负责原画，Whirlpool最新作即将登场！
与第2作『MagusTale』一样，本作也将由てんまそ和大三元共同负责，同时众人比较熟悉的SD画师こもわた遙華以及脚本创作的高嶋英二也将加盟，为你送上乐在其中的温馨喜剧，当然，也会在故事可读性与内涵深度上精益求精。
而且，为了更好地营造出身临其境的感受，视觉方面的演出将采用“背身站立图片”以及“光源层控制”等。

由实力派制作成员为您献上的这崭新一作，原先的粉丝们也好，新的玩家也罢，定能为这而着迷！
 
 
故事情节
御代街（みしろまち）——这是一个随着都市开发计划而急速发展的城镇。
从很久以前这个城镇就是由土地神和精灵所守护着的，这样的传说也渐渐成为过去的故事而已了。
时至今日，还会继承这信仰的人，已经所剩无几。

尽管如此，10年一度的土地神祭依旧是万人空巷的盛大活动。
在御鷹ヶ丘学園（みたかがおかがくえん）上学的主人公瀬川彰人，由于那自古留传下来的血统，即将在祭典时担任神官。
而且，为了守护土地神，必需选出一名巫女，而这一次的巫女将会是青梅竹马的捺菜，对此彰人不禁雀跃，说不定这会成为一次特别的祭典。

然而，就在为了准备祭典而充满朝气的城镇上，仿佛小孩子的恶作剧般，无法解释的事件开始频频发生。
很快地，不可思议的谣言开始在大街小巷传开。

「我看到不可思议的生物了！」

当然，对于那样的谣言，彰人并不相信，可是某一天，他还是看到了，那绝不可能存在的奇妙生物。

「真的能看到呀。」

那是因城镇开发而失去住所，不知该往哪去的精灵们，捺菜如是说。
带着一头雾水的彰人，她把精灵送回了森林深处，那是普通人因结界而无法踏足的禁地。
就是在那里，彰人和自古以来就住在这里，美得百般难描的土地神——涼相遇了。

和她的接触，让彰人下定决心：势必保护迷失到城镇的精灵们，将它们安全送回森林。
人类，以及超越人类的存在所上演的，这一出永恒的“羁绊相系的故事”就此拉开了序幕。

v6668.originalDescription: The fantasy SRPG Gin no Toki no Corona follows ETERNAL’s previous title, Tenkuu no Yumina. Touka isn’t a normal student: he has the ability to sense and interfere in the purple-lit space known as ‘shinya’ (true night). One time in shinya, he met a strange girl named Tokino who also had the same ability as him. Then a woman named Murial descended from the skies and entrusted a small girl Corona to them. Even though she is an innocent girl right now, she is a dragon girl who possesses enough power to destroy the world. Murial tells them if they raise Corona right then they will be able to save the world from ending.
v6668.description:
小田桐统果(小田桐統果) 并非极其普通的学生。
他拥有感知并干涉充满紫色光芒、被称为“真夜”的特殊空间的能力。

某天在“真夜”中，统果遇到了一位不可思议的女性。她的名字叫天津刻乃(天津刻乃)。
和统果一样，她也拥有干涉“真夜”的能力。
然后又有一天，一名女性从天而降，降临在统果面前。她的名字叫缪丽尔(ミュリアル)。
性格难以捉摸又不可思议的她，将一名少女托付给了统果和刻乃。
这名少女的名字叫克罗娜(コロナ)。
是一旦成长便拥有毁灭世界之力的龙人之一。只不过，现在还只是个天真无邪笑着、纯洁的少女。

“这个世界正面临着各种各样的毁灭。如果能将克罗娜正确抚养长大，或许就能避免毁灭”

听着缪丽尔的话语，看着依恋自己的克罗娜的视线，统果知晓了无法逃避的命运。
阻止世界的毁灭。将这份信念铭记于心，现在，小田桐统果和克罗娜的“时刻”开始转动了。

v10244.originalDescription: Over a thousand years ago, there was a large battle against an evil dragon. With the help of a holy dragon, they managed to defeat it, and then founded the Kingdom of Vestoria. The princess’ song has the power to grant miracles and as such, people who engage in music are highly respected in the country. Lute is a student at the prestigious Ertmail Music Academy, where young people gather to pursue their dreams of becoming a musician. One day, he met a mysterious girl in the street and ended up spending the day with her. Before leaving, she said that they will meet again. He was about to have dinner with his imouto Mel when he heard a loud noise outside. There was a giant hole in his garden and in the middle of it was a small dragon.
v10244.description:
很久以前，发生了一场与恶龙间的大战。
与圣龙合力将威胁击退的人类们建立了威斯特里亚王国，
这个国家的象征是拥有奇迹之歌的力量的公主，因此在这个国家中，音乐从事者是一种让人向往和令人尊敬的职业。
而音乐家培养机构--艾尔特梅尔音乐院，允许招收的都是从音乐从事者这个人群中被层层选拔出来的佼佼者。
因此，这所音乐院云集了许多以成为未来的音乐家为目标的天才。
刚刚进入这所学院一年的主人公--鲁特，一边在学院勉强混个不会留级的成绩，，一边和妹妹两个人平静地生活着。
这样的日子中的某天，鲁特在街上碰到了一位拥有着不可思议的气质的少女。
在些许的偶然之下，两个人共处了一阵子。
-段短暂的快乐时光后，她留下了一句"将来还会再见面”，分别了
当天晚上，正在为刚刚经历的这场幽会而心潮澎湃的鲁特，突然听到自家的院子里响起了什么东西坠落的声音在院子被砸出的一个大洞里，发现了一头身体被鳞状物覆盖的谜之生物窝在里面。
常年累月的平凡故事，翻开了崭新的一页.

v10957.title: 幸福噩梦

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v10957.originalDescription:
Lucid dreams.

Dreams where you know that you're dreaming.

After an accident in his youth, Tooru Naitou began to have nothing but lucid dreams. Always being aware of when he's dreaming meant that his mind could no longer rest when he was asleep. Only when he collapsed from utter exhaustion does he finally get a reprieve.

Lucky for him, he has a childhood friend, Saki, who insists on calling him 'Nii-san' that tries to do what she can to support him. In his science club, his senpai Yayoi is endlessly amused by his awkward way of living. And he has an underclassman, Keiko, who likes to sing in front of the station and likes to call him weird for his less than normal attitude towards life.

Tonight, Tooru dreams again. But this dream is different from those that came before.

"Maia...? Why are you in my dream...?"

A girl he hasn't seen ever since he started having lucid dreams, and to Tooru, this was the very worst form she could take. But Maia wasn't the only one who appeared.

"I'll put an end to bad dreams right here."

With those words, a girl who calls herself Alice rescues Tooru from Maia's grasps. Alice says that she's a traveler of dreams, and now she's come to Tooru's dream. What could all this mean? The anxious Tooru certainly has no answers as Maia softly whispers into his ear:

“This is the story of a sweet, happy nightmare.”
v10957.description:
―清醒梦―　在梦中意识到“这是梦”的梦。
内藤透以某次事故为界，所有的梦都变成了清醒梦。
本来睡眠是为了好好休息。 然而他却变得无论睡还是醒都无法休息。
他能休息的，只有疲惫到倒下的时候。
支持着他的青梅竹马咲，称呼透为“哥哥”，
科学部的前辈·弥生觉得笨拙的透的生存方式很有趣，在车站前唱歌的景子说透是个奇怪的前辈。

然后透今天也做梦了。 但是，那是与至今为止的梦不同的东西。
“舞亚……？ 为什么，你会在梦里……？”
自从开始做清醒梦以来，一次都没有在梦里出现过的女孩子。
舞亚再次出现在他面前。 那对透来说是最糟糕的噩梦的形态。
但是出现的并不只有舞亚。
“不好的梦，必须在这里结束呢”
这样说着在梦中帮助了透的，是自称有栖的女孩子。
据说穿梭于梦境之中，来到了透的梦里的有栖。
――这场相遇是什么的开始。 烦恼的透找不到答案。
在他的耳边，舞亚低语道。
“这是甜蜜又幸福的噩梦的故事”

v11316.originalDescription: One year has passed after the day when this world was saved from destruction. Tokino and Akane graduated, and with no imminent threat all member now enjoy their long awaited carefree days. But on a certain night of falling stars a new force has begun to move, and once again Touka's exceptional sense warns him about danger.
v11316.description:
“各种毁灭正在逼近这个世界。”
从这句话开始的，拯救世界免于毁灭的战斗。
与同伴一同重复了无数次的毁灭时间，终于将世界从毁灭的命运中守护了下来。
在那场战斗的中心——龙护寺，原本就住在这里的刻乃等人，以及小田桐统果(小田桐統果)、克罗娜、缪丽尔(ミュリアル)等人也照旧生活在这里。
此外，被救出的赤也加入了进来，一如既往吵闹的日子仍在继续。
一边与回归原本生活的智明等队伍的三人，以及齐藤龙一(斉藤竜一)、远野明日翔(遠野明日翔)等协助者保持联系，一边处理着偶尔找上门来的关于魔物或灵异事物的委托，就这样度过了时光。

就这样，大约过了一年。
刻乃和茜从皇河学园毕业，其他人也都各自顺利升级。
某天，曾一同与毁灭命运战斗的论说部部长黑河云母(黒河雲母)，通过米德尔斯坦向龙护寺发来了联络。
“我要休一段时间的假，能不能让我在龙护寺住下呢？”
在之前的事件中没能好好道谢的小田桐统果等人，爽快地答应了。
小田桐统果等人满心期待论说部的到来，但论说部的众人却没有出现在龙护寺。

然后，在流星降临的夜晚，故事开始转动。
传来了仿佛陨石坠落般的惊人巨响，前往那个地方一看，发现有一个遍体鳞伤的少女，和一个身受致命重伤的少年。
某件事正在开始发生。小田桐统果渐渐有了这样的预感——

v12602.originalDescription: It’s been two years since the mysterious disease “princess syndrome” had been made public. It affects young girls during puberty and the split personality-like symptoms range from mild to serious. In serious cases, she could become like a totally different person due to her wavering feelings and gain a special ability called ‘märchen’ which could cause great problems to those around her. To combat this problematic illness, all carriers (called ‘princesses’) were gathered at Saint Andersen Private School on the secluded island of Yumegashima. One day, a boy Yuuji came to the school. He was the ‘liar prince’ who could put a stop to their rampaging.
v12602.description:
“女孩的心中，住着一位公主哦”

＜公主病【公主综合症】＞。
这种不可思议的疾病公之于众，仅仅是大约两年前的事情。

它就像是青春期少女身上萌发的多重人格障碍，
因人而异，从轻微到严重程度各不相同。
其中严重的症状，会因一定程度的＜情绪波动＞，
而寄宿下完全不同的人格。
并且在那时，还能使用被称为＜望奏【童话】＞的特殊力量，
根据蜕变后的人格不同，有时还会使用这种力量四处大闹。
也就是说，这是一种会给周围人添麻烦的疾病。

不久后，患上这种病的女孩们被称为＜公主＞，
为了便于收拾问题，她们被集中到了一所学园里。
＜圣安德森学园＞。
那里位于一座与都市隔绝的、被称为＜梦之岛＞的岛屿上，
是一所聚集了许多＜公主＞的女子学园。
在那样的学园里，某天，一个男孩来到了这里。
他的名字是有须祐二。
能够阻止＜公主＞暴走的，＜王子＞。

通称，＜说谎王子＞。

v13108.title: 幸福噩梦 FD
aliases: ハピメアＦＤ, ハピメアFD, Hapimea FD

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v13108.originalDescription:
This is the fandisk to HapyMaher. After a certain accident, all of Tooru’s dreams became lucid dreams. However, after that winter incident, his happy nightmares came to an end. Yuuko was finally starting to recover from her illness and could attend school again with him. With the help of his osananajimi Saki, Yuuko’s friend Keiko and the somewhat helpful Yayoi, they gradually became accustomed to the school life.

However, he could not forget about ‘her’, even though he knew that he would never meet ‘her’ again. He noticed his dearest nightmare Maia appear by his side. “It’s true that there is no dream that one doesn’t wake up from. However, it doesn’t mean that one will stop dreaming.” She whispered into his ear: “This is the story of a dream leading towards a sweet happy end”.
v13108.description:
―清明梦―　指的是在梦中意识到"这是梦"的梦。
内藤透以某次事故为界，开始把所有的梦都做成了清明梦。
然而，以冬天发生的某起事件为契机，他直面了那场事故留下的东西，幸福的噩梦宣告了终结。

鸟海有子(鳥海有子)。
自幼患病、反复住院出院的她，病情终于趋于康复，开始重新回到休学的学园上学。
虽然并非同为病友的关系，但主动提出帮助的透半强迫地缠上了她，与他的青梅竹马咲、凡事都靠得住的弥生、原本就和有子是朋友的景子一起，她逐渐习惯了学园生活。

然而，透心中始终有一个无法释怀的身影。
心灵相通，却再也无法相见的"她"。

本该已经接受了。
也明白将有子与"她"的身影重叠，对双方都是不义的。
但他，察觉到了什么。

"没有不会醒的梦，确实如此说过呢"
出现在那里的，最爱的噩梦的形态。

"——但是，也不会有不再做梦的时候哦。呵呵，难道你没有察觉到吗？"

"并没有结束，这是新的梦。遗憾与后悔，以及无法释怀的思念的形态。真是的，老是做这种梦，真是拿你没办法"

然后舞亚(舞亜)在他耳边甜蜜地低语。
"这是一个甜蜜而幸福的、走向终结的梦的故事"

v16208.title: 柯罗的怀表

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v16208.originalDescription:
Meet Sawatari Rei, heir to a corporate empire, whose most valuable inheritance isn't stock but his grandfather's pocket watch. Within it lies a curious power: the ability to rewind time by five minutes, an ability he can use infinitely, though mastering it proves tricky. 

While world-saving feats could be possible, Rei initially leverages this power for daily excitement—specifically, risk-free romantic reconnaissance. He confesses to one cute girl after another, then rewinds time to gauge their interest without consequence.

But one ordinary school day ends in horror when a girl falls from the roof. Using his watch, Rei jumps back and discovers the victim, the shy but brilliant first-year Suzuki Miu, caught mid-confession with his best friend just moments before. 

Deeply impressed by the determination he lacks—confessing without a safety net—Rei impulsively decides to help Miu succeed in her next confession.

This decision sparks a bizarre three-way dynamic, complicating Rei's own ongoing mission to confess to the girls on his list. 

For Sawatari Rei and his time-altering watch, this is only the beginning.
v16208.description:
身为大企业少爷的主人公・泽渡澪(沢渡 澪)。
他持有的祖父遗物＝怀表中寄宿着不可思议的力量。
“限定5分钟的过去时空穿梭”
虽然可以无数次使用，但有些难以驾驭，
不过如果善加利用的话也许能做到各种各样的事情。
拯救世界……这种宏大的事情就不去考虑了。
为了把日子过得有趣好玩，
更为了把可爱的女孩子变成女朋友，
成为时间移动能力者的主人公那充满波折的校园恋爱故事开始了。

夏日的日常。
泽渡澪制作了校园里可爱女孩子的列表并四处告白，
利用怀表的力量毫无风险地调查着有戏的女孩子。
在这样的某一天放学后。
一名少女从校园的屋顶上掉下来，猛烈地撞向地面。
不知发生了何事而倒转时间来到屋顶的澪，把学妹・铃木美羽(鈴木 みう)，
正准备向他的好朋友告白的场面给破坏了。
虽然是极度容易紧张且拥有罕见倒霉体质的美羽，
但她还是鼓起勇气准备告白。
无法锁定喜欢的对象，如果没有怀表的力量连告白都做不到的主人公，
被她的直率所打动，决定为了她的第二次告白提供帮助。
那同时也是奇妙三角关系的开始。
同时，这也成为了泽渡澪获得向其他女主角们告白的勇气的序章。

●城之内真琴(城之内 真琴)　（CV：山田ゆな）
主人公的同班同学。
有些不得要领，没有明显特征的可爱少女。
但是，却抱着一个双亲是武斗派黑帮组长的秘密。
身体能力高到莫名其妙的地步，战斗力也很高。
当主人公看着她装出“呜呜”这种普通人反应而暗自偷笑时，她会涨红了脸想着“可恶，杀了我吧”。
“一大早就直呼女孩子名字，还真是随性呢♪”

●泽渡满(沢渡 満)　（CV：藤森ゆき奈）
主人公的妹妹。
幼年时因高烧失去了视力，但本人却满不在乎。
对周围的人很有礼貌，无论在哪里都受到偶像般的对待，但实际上是不拘泥于过去和未来的唯物的快乐主义者。
“哥哥，我可以亲吻您吗？”

●安藤美咲(安藤 美咲)　（CV：北見六花）
主人公的学妹。
是个还算过得去的大小姐，为了不输给家世而喜欢努力特训的热血类型，但也有着什么事都拿不到第一的不灵巧性格。
感情表现丰富，经常生气，经常哭泣。
把出身于地位远高于自己的“泽渡家”的主人公视为眼中钉，但这其实是傲娇娇娇娇比例的倒反表现。
“如果做得好的话，也会给前辈发一朵小红花的！”

●D・D　（CV：桃井いちご）
主人公的？？。
出生和成长都在英国，但祖父是日本人的四分之一混血。
来到主人公家里寄宿，作为女仆行事。
在为了熟悉语言和文化而浏览日本网络的过程中，被御宅族文化染透了。
“英国的饭菜真的是太难吃了！日料和中餐是最棒的！”

●铃木美羽(鈴木 みう)　（CV：上原あおい）
主人公的学妹。
在比一般人稍显贫寒的单亲家庭长大的现代孩子。
虽然对男性有着强烈认生害羞的一面，但同时也兼具积极向上和勇敢之心的不协调少女。
虽然畏畏缩缩，但也有把想说的话说太多的轻微毒舌属性。
与她的一番话让一切开始了。
“喜欢上一个人，需要理由吗？”

●“怀表之精”柯罗(クロ)　（CV：かわしまりの）
和主人公是相声搭档。
自称时间之神克罗诺斯的怀表之精。
只有怀表的所有者能看到其身姿并与之对话，但无法触碰。
并没有明确要管理怀表之类的目的，也不太理解自己到底是为了什么而存在的——本人也觉得无所谓。
“怎么看，我辈哪里像幽灵了？”

v18141.title: ワールド・エレクション
v18141.original: ワールド・エレクション
aliases: ワールド・エレクション
v18141.originalDescription:
World Election is the 10th anniversary game for Whirlpool.

The world was split up amongst 5 different factions, the dark world of hell, an advanced technical world, the peaceful land of God and Angels, the primitive beast world, and the human world.

As our story begins, it’s already been about 20 years since all of these worlds have been unified and are ruled in peace by the World Government. The protagonist is a type of person that people call a “Neo”, a human of the new generation who has been born with a special power. He currently attends an international school in the special region, but otherwise lives a very ordinary life.

One day a meteorite crashes down nearby, and a single girl appears out of the rubble. She says her name is Kururu and that she is the God of destruction, though the rest of her memory seems to be lost.
Her arrival happens just as the school is preparing for the new student council elections and due to circumstances our protagonist ends up running in them as well.

Other famous students follow his example and also nominate themselves as candidates in the elections, not to mention the dangerous ones as well. All of this marks the starts of the greatest student council elections in history, opening the door for a new chapter in the history of the world…
v18141.description:
你的一票能改变世界？

阳光无法照透的暗之居民的世界，「劫魔界赫尔梅里尔」
没有生者的机械文明，「机械帝国马基纳因苏拉」
静谧的神与天使之国，「天乐园鲁伊图塞尔」
兽人们的乐园与原始的世界，「大自然乡阿西里·亚·万亚马」
以及我们人类居住的「人间界盖亚」

五个世界毫无预兆地统合的「变革之日」至今约20年——。
世界归于统一，在世界政府之下，人们获得了和平。

所以这是一个尾声的故事。

以变革为契机觉醒了特殊能力的新人类
「尼奥斯（neo´s）」之一的主人公，
作为特区「瓦雷隆国际学园」的学生，
过着既不意外也不特别的平平淡淡的每一天。

在这样的他面前陨落了陨石，更正，是谜之少女库露露(クルル)。
「吾名破坏神·库露露，宣告这颗星球终结之人……本应是」
少女失忆了，还有点「那个」。

在这样的相遇中，学园里正在推进学生会选举的准备。
因离奇的命运和小规模的原由而参战学生会选举的主人公，
以及搭档（？）自称破坏神的库露露。
学园的超名人和超危险人物们也跟随主人公纷纷宣布参选，
被后世称为「学园史上最大最凶」的选举战就此拉开帷幕。

尾声向序幕变迁。
新故事的大门，由活在当下的少年少女之手开启了——。

「总之，想让你和我一起想想怎么毁灭这颗星球」

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v24725.originalDescription:
Kemba Gakuen is a school where Asagiri Chihaya attends. In the past, he was involved in an accident where he lost some important memories.

His beautiful childhood friend named Miyamato Satsuki calmly advised him to try and remember. As life goes on, Chihaya heard rumors in social media about the existence of an app called "Alive".

It is a legendary gaming app but shrouded in mystery. Still, Chihaya continues life as a regular student. But one day, an application has been installed on his smartphone and Chihaya realizes the name of the app:

“Alive”

The app itself can change the fate of the people around it where Chihaya himself does not realize it.
v24725.description:
就读于神庭学园的朝雾千隼对遭遇事故的过去记忆模糊，
一边被青梅竹马美大和咲月训斥，一边度过着平稳、不经意的日常。
在这样的情况下，千隼听到了社交游戏《Alive》的传闻。

连存在与否都不确定的如同都市传说般的游戏，
千隼并未放在心上，一如既往地度过每一天，
但在某一天，千隼发现自己的智能手机上不知何时安装了一个应用程序。

《Alive》

千隼还不知道，那个应用程序正是将大幅改变自己与周围人命运的关键……

v24987.title: 爱因斯坦携爱敬上
v24987.original: アインシュタインより愛を込めて
aliases: アインシュタインより愛を込めて
v24987.originalDescription:
They say I'm a guy who doesn't understand human emotions at all. 
But really, who actually does? 

The start of summer: 
Aiuchi Shuuta, a second year at Hokumakidai Academy, is the smartest student in his grade. However, he loses this title for the first time.
A girl, Arimura Romi, climbed her way to the top, while continuing to publish cutting-edge research papers online. She's a very mysterious girl: the textbook definition of an enigma. 

And thus, Shuuta seeks Romi's help on a certain matter.

"Aiuchi Shuuta" and "Arimura Romi" 
It all started from the meeting of these two geniuses-- a distant summer adventure begins.
v24987.description:
被人说是不懂别人心情的家伙。

但是别人的心情，又有谁能懂呢？

夏天的开始。

北牧台学园二年级学生。每次考试都名列第一的爱内周太(愛内周太)，第一次让出了那个位置。

取代他成为第一的是“有村路美(有村ロミ)”，一个在网络上持续发表尖锐论文的、

谜之少女。

然后，周太向路美提出了一个商量。

“爱内周太”“有村路美”

以两位天才的相遇为契机，

漫长夏天的冒险开始了。

本作的概念是“一个夏天的科幻爱情故事”。

故事由大致的四个章节构成。

从与女主角相遇并创立科学特搜部的序章开始——

与女主角一同面对迎来转机的命运的学园篇。

逼近主人公爱内周太的秘密的过去篇。

以及解开散布在世界各地的谜题的真相篇。

主人公与女主角们在瞬息万变的境遇中，

即使被命运捉弄，为了抵达那微小的幸福，

也会携手前行。

v31436.original: アインシュタインより愛を込めて APOLLOCRISIS
