アインシュタインより愛を込めて APOLLOCRISIS
Einstein Yori Ai o Komete: Apollo Crisis
v31436.originalDescription:
It's been about a year since he returned from Ogasawara.

It's the start of summer. Aiuchi Shuuta, now a third year at the academy, has lazily watched the seasons pass-- his carefree classmates, his peaceful day-to-day life... and his love who hasn't returned, Arimura Romi.
He simply vacantly watched and continued to wait.

And to him comes a letter from the head of the Comet Organisation, Miko.

Once again, along with his comrades and the rest of the world, he gets caught up in their big plans regarding the comet. The final summer was about to begin.
v31436.description:
从小笠原归来已近一年。

初夏。

升入学园三年级的爱内周太，漫然眺望着季节的更迭。

悠闲的同班同学。和平的每一天。

未归的恋人，“有村路美(有村ロミ)”。

只是茫然地眺望着这一切，不断等待着。

这样的他，收到了来自彗星机构首领“米可(ミコ)”的信件。

他与他的伙伴们，以及世界，再次被卷入与彗星相关的野心之中。

最后的夏天即将开始。

v32021.title: 久那土国记

developers.name: パープルソフトウェア

v32021.originalDescription:
One day, metals have gained a will and randomly began to attack humanity all over the world―――

Without knowing the cause, all the civilization and history on the earth were destroyed, and mankind has been hit by unprecedented catastrophes for about 1,000 years.

Humans drastically reduced their numbers and managed to survive while resisting the attack against the metal with will Tekki.

Many of the remaining humans have awakened to their supernatural powers, and devoted themselves to the days of battle. Meanwhile, a girl named Natsuhime, one of the warriors belonging to the frontier country of Kanto, defeats Kurokami, the greatest threat of Tekki.

The people of Kanto who survived are shaken and rejoices the disappearance of a thousand-year-old threat to human existence.

This story revolves around the boy Shin, who has no memory of being found in the remains of Kurokami after the battle. It is a story of mankind's revival and how it reconstructs history from the former civilization that humans lost to Kurokami.
v32021.description:
公元2034年。\
名为“铁鬼”的金属生命体出现，大半人类被驱逐殆尽。\
金属制品也变得无法使用，连文明与技术都随之丧失。\
只有在铁鬼活动缓慢的“间隙”里，人类才得以幸存。\
\
那之后过了1000年。\
一位英雄，打倒了作为铁鬼核心的存在之一。\
\
『赌上人类命运的战斗，在100天前，结束了』\
『所以，从现在开始的故事里，只剩下“希望”和“幸福”了』

故事的舞台是被称为“坎特”的国家。\
总人口800人的能力者们所生活的，和风文明。\
战斗结束了，然而。\
为了生存而持续战斗的坎特的人们，失去了个性与文化。\
一般居民全都只是戴着狐狸面具的「不是任何人的存在」而已。\
\
「“希望”和“幸福”，是什么？」\
「我们除了战斗之外该做些什么，完全，不知道」

就在那时，一位从1000年前起就处于冷冻睡眠状态的青年被发掘了出来。\
青年——他，将成为这个故事的主人公。\
\
他，或许是因为冷冻睡眠的弊端而失去了记忆。\
虽然不了解自己的事情，但是，却拥有文明与文化等方面的知识。\
\
「能和我们约定，为这个世界创造出希望与幸福吗？」\
\
在宛如异世界的坎特醒来的主人公。\
以保障衣食住为交换，他被请求为坎特带来文化。\
\
他的故事，在赌上人类命运的战斗结束后才开始。

\
这是，讴歌古怪学园生活的故事。\
是关于咖啡店与货币经济的故事。\
是关于统治者所需的资质与努力的故事。\
是什么人都不是的一位少女，直到怀揣梦想的故事。\
\
然后——是关于“英雄”之死的真相，以及关于“他”真实身份的告白。

v40725.originalDescription:
Now a sophomore, the protagonist Narita Hinata, is delighted to be in the same class as his familiar buddies. While chatting with his friends, he loses his balance and falls, desperately grabbing on to something......he feels, something soft. And then, what he sees, in white, a girl's underwear.

The girl's name is Kurano Kokage. Her bangs hide most of her face, gloomy vibes, a completely plain girl.

No matter how many times Hinata apologizes, Kokage never says a word. Feeling guilty, "I want to do something to make amends," and in respond, Kokage opens her lips "Come to my house, now."

In this title, with the encounter of Hinata and Kokage, marks the beginning of a bittersweet love story.
v40725.description:
今天起成田日向成为了高二学生。
虽然重新分班了，但又一次和好朋友分在同一个班，正享受着短暂的谈笑。
然而，在与朋友的交谈中，悲剧发生了。
椅子失去了平衡，像抓住救命稻草一样伸出手去，碰到的是女孩子的胸部。
作为揉了胸部的补偿，被带回家的日向所等待着他的是……
从最糟糕的相遇开始的男女故事，现在拉开帷幕。

v61834.original: Relirium -レリリウム- 遺跡と出逢いと冒険と
aliases: Relirium -レリリウム- 遺跡と出逢いと冒険と
Relirium - Iseki to Deai to Bouken to
v61834.description:
追溯至今30年前。
撕裂天空的暴风雨与接连不断的大地震，伴随着令人联想到世界末日的天灾地变，『那个』突然出现在了日本的海面上。
『古都阿玛茨奇』
广袤的岛屿上耸立着神秘的遗迹群，地下则蔓延着无尽的迷宫。
无法用常识解释的空间与异形的生物们。
给世界带来巨大混乱的那座岛屿，即便在付出众多牺牲持续推进调查的如今，
依然连全貌的轮廓都不曾显露……
后来在联合国的主导下，这座岛屿以『约兹哈共和国』之名实现了独立，
安全保障区域允许普通人进入，如今已成为世界屈指可数的旅游国家。
在那里建立的约兹哈共和国唯一的高等教育机构——阿玛茨奇学园。
最初由联合国主导的地下迷宫调查，
如今大部分已由接受过特殊教育的部分学生们承担。
如果阿玛茨奇的全貌是"无法穷尽的远方"，那慢慢来就好。
暂且搁置，托付给下一代！
或者，将遗迹中的冒险升华为娱乐（修正轨道）也不错？
想要扬名立万、想要触碰未知的浪漫、想要一夜暴富……等等，
怀揣各种心思的人们正从世界各地向阿玛茨奇学园集结。
而这里又有一位，并非被阿玛茨奇的神秘所吸引……而是为了某个目的造访约兹哈的少年。他的名字叫绚濑陆。
等待他的是荣誉还是神秘的秘宝。
无数邂逅的前方，是危险与浪漫、未知陷阱与怪物交织的冒险剧。
身不由己开始的冒险者日常的前方，等待他的是……？
v61834.originalDescription:
Thirty years ago, as storms split the heavens and massive earthquakes hit one after another - cataclysms that seemed to herald the end of the world - a mysterious landmass suddenly appeared off the coast of Japan.

The Ancient City of Amatsuchi

A sprawling island of towering, mysterious ruins. Beneath it lies an endless underground labyrinth. Impossible spaces and grotesque beings - things beyond human understanding. The island that plunged the world into chaos has been under investigation at the cost of countless lives, yet even now, it refuses to reveal even the faintest outline of its true nature...

In time, the island gained independence as the Republic of Yozuha under United Nations leadership. With safe zones opened even to civilians, it has since become one of the world's leading tourist locations. There stands the Republic of Yozuha's sole institution of higher education: Amatsuchi Academy. While investigations of the underground labyrinth were initially led by the United Nations, much of that work is now carried out by a select group of specially trained students.

If Amatsuchi's full secrets are still out of reach, we can take our time. For now, let's shelve it and leave it to the next generation! Or hey - why not turn the adventures in the ruins into entertainment? Works for me!

Seekers of fame, adventurers drawn by the unknown, fortune hunters... people with all manner of motives are converging on Amatsuchi Academy from around the world. And here too is a boy drawn to Yozuha - not by the mysteries of Amatsuchi, mind you, but by a certain purpose. His name is Ayase Riku.

Glory? Or secret treasures? Ahead lie danger and romance - a grand adventure teeming with unknown traps and monsters. And what awaits Riku as he is swept into the life of an adventurer...?

v66697.original: カフェトリカルカフェ
aliases: カフェトリカルカフェ
v66697.originalDescription:
The Heroine Race: A Love War That Begins at a Café

It is the middle of May. Spring is scattering away, and the footsteps of summer can already be heard. Kiritani Shuusuke, an ordinary guy whose only real talent is making coffee, transfers to Kiyama Academy and moves into Kiyama Dormitory, located on the school grounds.

On the very night he moves into the dormitory, Shuusuke meets a senpai.

"Kiritani Shuusuke-kun. Won't you come and work with me at Arte?"

Held out before him is Shinomori Yomogi's small, delicate hand. As though lured in by the irresistible sweetness and exquisite beauty that seem to reside within it, Kiritani Shuusuke holds out his own hand.

"If you'll have me, I'd be very happy to lend a hand."

From this moment onward, Shuusuke's stagnant world begins to take on color.
And so, Kiritani Shuusuke's elegant new life at the café be--

"Nii-san! How dare you try to get a part-time job without telling your own little sister!"
"Shuu-kun! Your childhood friend is here to help!"
"Darling, here I am."

Just as Shuusuke's heart is soaring at the thought of his elegant new café life, three girls appear.

Kiritani Aoi, his biological little sister.
Tachibana Mia, his childhood friend whom he hasn't seen in five years.
Shiina Serika, the mysterious beauty who lovingly calls Shuusuke "Darling."

"Nii-san is my nii-san and nobody else's! I won't hand him over to anyone!"
"Nooo! I'm the one who's getting Shuu-kun's first kiss!"
"I'm Darling's lawful wife. No matter how much other women throw themselves at him, it will be of no use."
"Shuusuke? Well, aren't you quite the popular one? You haven't forgotten that I was the first to approach you, have you?"

At Café Arte, the battle for Shuusuke is on, with girls whose affection levels are over 200%! Just which heroine will capture his heart!?

And so, the Love War begins!
v66697.description:
春花凋零，已能听见夏日脚步声的5月中旬。
除了泡咖啡之外没有什么特别长处的普通人“桐谷秀祐”，
转入了“辉山学园”，并入住学园用地内的“辉山宿舍”。


而在入住的那天晚上，秀祐遇到了一位学姐。


在秀祐对今后的咖啡馆生活满心期待之时，出现了3个女孩。
有血缘关系的亲妹妹“桐谷葵依”
时隔5年再会的青梅竹马“橘美杏”
称呼秀祐为达令并爱慕着他的谜之美少女“椎名雪里香”


以咖啡馆“阿尔特”为舞台，好感度超过200%的女孩们展开的秀祐争夺战！
究竟谁能成为射中秀祐的女主角！？


的序幕，现在正式揭开！

v1256.originalDescription: A restaurant is about to be closed, and Issei is ordered to whittle down part-time workers. Shizuka, Kimika, Rinne, Asuha and Hiyori. About two months are left until closedown... Each girl spends time at the restaurant with each feeling... Issei faces it and finds his way as well. Make it unforgettable, with girls....
v1256.description:
「这家店……要关门了？」。家庭餐厅「特里亚农」北桥店，
被总部下令在这个夏天结束后关门。
奉命负责人员裁减的主人公城岛一诚，
从同样面临关门的系列店「维托咖啡」接收了人手。
在关门之前的这段时间里，作为经理管理店铺，
还必须从员工中选出"留下的人"——
一份沉重得不可思议的职责压在了他的肩上。被列为候选的是五个女孩。
一心扑在工作上早?年、无法坦率的铁面主任，町田静。
恋爱第一工作第五、自称多情少女，绪方希美果。
黑色纯情权谋家、无情的资深打工者，天野轮回。
与其说积极向前不如说前倾跌倒、超级新人打工者，新田明日叶。
温柔包容一切的寡妇店长，织原日和。
与这样一群人共同开始的 Last Summer Order。距离关门不到两个月。
每个人各自怀抱着不同的心意，刻下剩余的时光。
主人公必须面对这些，
引出她们隐藏的心意。
而主人公自身也在她们的支持与启发下，
探寻着应走的道路。让逝去的夏天，成为难以忘怀的记忆。
与重要的人们，共同编织的轮舞曲……

v2835.title: あまつみそらに！
v2835.originalDescription: Takahisa lives on Misora-jima with Kanna, a goddess who came to his house when he was a child and started living with him. He also has an imouto Miyu who is a gravure idol and is often away from home. That doesn’t mean things are quiet though, since Miyu’s best friend Serika idolizes Kanna and often causes a big ruckus. One day Serika comes in with big news: there’s a miko coming to the island!
v2835.description:
漂浮在濑户内海上的美空岛。

在丰富的自然与缓缓流逝的时间中长大的少男少女们，即将知晓恋爱之事。

主人公观崎高久(かんざき・たかひさ)曾与神明生活在一起。

从小时候起，神明就理所当然般地待在身边，作为家人一起长大。

神明的名字是一桥神奈(ひとつばし・かんな)。

明明身为神明的能力相当高，神奈却更像是作为人类在行事。

观崎家还有一个人，是妹妹美唯(みゆ)。

对他们而言，这三人就是无可替代的家人。

在这样的情况下，美唯作为偶像的工作开始步入正轨，家庭也渐渐迎来了变化。

青梅竹马、民宿老板娘帷千纱(とばり・ちさ)，

虽然不再像以前那样毫无隔阂地交往，但还是会各种挂念缺乏生活能力的观崎家。

美唯的亲友、网球部的清澄芹夏(きよすみ・せりか)，

无论是在学园还是家里，都会跑到主人公那里闹出各种骚动，是个喜欢凑热闹的人。

芹夏憧憬着神奈，把常和神奈在一起的高久视为竞争对手。

神奈和芹夏惹出天大的骚动，

美唯和高久设法收拾残局，便是这四人的固定模式。

在度过着往常那样日子的初夏某日，芹夏带来了一个消息。

“前辈前辈！听说会有巫女从岛外来！”

因为这一句话，众人便去参观了神社的迁移仪式（迁座祭）。

主人公在那里，与有着不可思议氛围的巫女叶月深景(はづき・みかげ)交谈起来。

相遇连锁般地打动了少女们的心，摇曳着她们隐藏的心意。

就此开始的，是循环往复的思念的故事。

v7786.original: 春季限定ポコ・ア・ポコ!
aliases: 春季限定ポコ・ア・ポコ!
v7786.originalDescription: The third installment in ALcot Honey Comb’s mid-priced novel series. Even since his parents disappeared a year ago, Kanata did part-time jobs every day in order to take care of himself and his imouto Ai. He skipped classes and didn’t join any clubs even though he had entered the music academy with a scholarship, believing that music doesn’t help bring food to the table. However, it was natural that because of this, his scholarship was revoked. The granddaughter of the principal, Mana, gave him a second chance at his scholarship if he revives the legendary quartet. So, he picked up his cello for the first time in a year and was joined by bracon imouto Ai, my-pace and self-centered Sakura, and super cool beauty Natsumi. Will he be able to regain his scholarship, and more importantly, his love for music and lost friendships?
v7786.description:
主人公、野々宮 彼方是个苦学生。
为了代替一年前失踪的父母筹措妹妹和自己的生活费，他每天都沉浸在打工中。
好不容易作为特待生进入的音乐学园，他也没怎么去上课，社团活动更是完全不露面。 
“靠音乐吃不上饭。有那种闲工夫去打工要有意义得多。”
对于如此宣称的天才少年，周围的人们虽然感到无奈，却仍用温暖的目光守护着他。
——然而，平稳的日子并未持续太久。
野々宮 彼方被学园告知将被剥夺特待生资格。
被要求全额返还免除的学费，野々宮 彼方陷入了困境。
在这种情况下，由于学园理事的孙女——前辈多々良 真奈（たたら・まな）的斡旋，只要在毕业典礼上重新开始音乐活动，就能获得重新变回特待生的机会。 
“彼方君，让传说中的学生四重奏复活吧！”
简直就像命运女神不允许他放弃音乐一样的状况。
野々宮 彼方虽然叹息，但还是时隔一年再次拿起了大提琴。 
曾经四重奏的伙伴，我行我素的唯我独尊美少女，一樱(一 桜)。
在四重奏解散后也独自默默坚持音乐的兄控妹妹，野々宮 藍。
敌视野々宮 彼方的绝对零度、超级冷酷美女悠木 夏海。
以及，虽然有才能却完全没有干劲的主人公，野々宮 彼方。 
在超越了别扭而变得支离破碎的人际关系中，
野々宮 彼方究竟能否找回对音乐的热情与失去的友情（还有特待生资格等各种东西）呢？！

v8158.title: 大图书馆的牧羊人
aliases: a good librarian like a good shepherd
v8158.description:
从大都会出发的直达电车放慢了速度。
在被光、绿意与海风点缀的平原上，有一座城市。
其中心是私立汐美学園。
这是一所不仅汇聚了学业优秀之人，更不分领域地聚集了拥有一技之长者的学园。
如闪耀星辰般的才能，数来约有5万。
身披自由与希望，今天学生们也昂首阔步。

耸立于广大学域之中的，图书馆的最深处。
然而本应被寂静支配的阅览室里，却洋溢出欢快的语声。
占据房间的是6名学生。
直到前几天都毫无瓜葛的他们，为何会聚集于此地——
这个隐秘的理由，还无人知晓。
即便是在笑容的中心翻动书页的他也一样。
v8158.originalDescription:
When he was young, Kyoutarou wanted to read all the magic books in the world, but they were all in the magic library. Someone told him that to get there, he must be kind to everyone and bring happiness to their hearts. He received a bookmark, which was his entrance ticket to the magic library.

One day while heading to school, he received a text from the ‘shepherd’ (hitsujikai) telling him that his fate was going to change. He had a vision of an accident at the tram station and helped prevent any injuries by calling away a nearby girl. That girl, Tsugumi, later came to the Library Club room, which he was a member of, to thank him and also to ask for his help to make Shiomi Academy more fun. It seemed that she had also received a text from the shepherd, who is rumoured to appear before people who try their best to grant their wishes. One by one, other students also join their group with the shepherd’s guidance.

v10341.title: LOVELY QUEST
v10341.originalDescription: Summer is the season of love. There have been many cases of ‘impure’ relationships at Academy Amanotogawa and the “Lovely Smile Committee” was started to promote ‘pure’ love. But what is pure love? Is holding hands after school ‘pure’? What about feeding a homemade bentou, giving a lap pillow or going to the bath together? Zenichi was chosen to be the lone member on the committee and sets out to search for true pure love. There’s no time to be embarrassed, the future of the school has been entrusted to you.
v10341.description:
季节是夏天。

在恋爱盛行、充满笑容的天之户河学园，最近不顾他人目光的异性交往频频成为问题。
感到问题严重的学园方面决定取缔"不纯"的异性交往，并成立推荐有节度的"纯"恋爱的研究委员会——"可爱微笑委员会"。

——真正的纯爱，究竟是什么样的呢。
"牵手上下学是'纯'？还是'不纯'？"
"用手工便当互相喂食呢？"
"膝枕是'纯'吗？"
"作为唯一的可爱微笑委员被选出的主人公，以理事长出的题目和学生们投稿为基础，与女主角携手寻找真正的纯爱。
害羞？那种话已经说不出口了。因为学园的未来，如今已托付给你了。

v10803.title: 硬要无视与你的未来 ~Relay broadcast~
v10803.original: あえて無視するキミとの未来 ～Relay broadcast～

あえて無視するキミとの未来 ～Relay broadcast～

v10803.originalDescription: Takurou can see the future. No matter if it’s in his dream or as an image that suddenly comes to his mind, it will certainly happen. However, having this special ability isn’t without its demerits. He knows how he will end up after graduation, as well as for the rest of his life. He cannot bring himself to be excited about anything since putting in effort is futile when the end result is already decided. One day, a peculiar transfer student Souka appeared before him, something that he had not seen in his future. She told him that his future is his own creation and it isn’t something that is decided from the beginning. Then, Takurou saw a future in which she became his girlfriend. Which future will be his? Is it already decided?
v10803.description: 拓郎能够看见未来。无论是在梦中，还是突然浮现在脑海中的画面，都一定会发生。然而，这种特殊的能力并非没有代价。他得知了自己毕业后的下场，甚至连之后的人生也全都看得一清二楚。既然结果早已注定，他便无法对任何事情抱有热情，也找不到努力的意义。某天，一个名叫奏香(ソウカ)的特异转学生出现在他面前。她并没有出现在他的未来里，并且她告诉他：“未来是由自己创造的，并非从一开始就注定好的。”接着，拓郎却看见了她会成为自己女朋友的未来。他的未来究竟会是哪一个呢？真的已经注定了吗？

v12476.title: 卡卢玛卢卡＊同好会
v12476.originalDescription: “You’re the master of this world!” With those words, Kaito was invited by his energetic turtle-toting underclassman Nicole to Seikai Academy’s student council room to join the star-crossing circle. All of the girls in that group are peculiar in their own way. Once every year, on the night of Tanabata, they gather to try to access ‘Karumaruka’. If they are successful, then they would be freed from their curses and their fear of the future.
v12476.description:
“你就是这个世界的主人！”

被带着乌龟、格外有精神的学妹邀请，来到了学生会室。
聚集在那里的，是各自有着一两个怪癖的怪人们。

“我一直在等你来”
“这可是关系到我的内部评价的，给我好好配合”
“你会替我干活的吧？”

——到底为什么是我啊？

被突然连珠炮似地一顿说，在抱着头苦恼的我身边，有一个低着头散发着黑色气息的少女。

“为……什……我……”
“啊？”
“为什么，我会喜欢上你啊？！”
“我、我怎么知道啊……！”

“星渡同好会”

那是，一年一度，在七夕之夜渡过星辰，尝试连接“卡卢玛卢卡”的季节限定同好会。
传闻有着学园理事的保证，是学生会直属的——但总觉得十分可疑。

主人公御影海人虽然很不情愿，但还是将名字挂在了星渡同好会，开始与完全合不来的成员们共同行动。

据说能够连接上“卡卢玛卢卡”的人，将从一切束缚中解放。
从过去的罪孽，甚至从未来的恐惧之中——。

在回荡的钟声中，他们会许下什么愿望呢。

v13325.title: 幸运草的约定
v13325.description:
**那是，隐忍的思念\
那是，永远的誓言\
那是，发自内心的心愿\
那是，一直怀抱的后悔**

**以及，幼年时的约定——**

\
被父母抛弃，在英国的福利机构长大的优人，成为了经营贸易商的鹰仓义臣(鷹倉義臣)的养子，来到了日本。\
支撑着连日语都说不太好的他的，是双胞胎义妹，开朗而容易害羞的鹰仓杏铃(杏鈴)与冷酷而可靠的鹰仓杏璃(杏璃)。\
还有初等部的同班同学，质朴而温柔的龙胆燕(つばめ)与爱慕虚荣而不坦率的结桥泉(泉)。

不知恋爱为何物的少年与少女们笑着、哭着，孕育出了无可替代的羁绊。

10年后——街景发生了巨大的改变，优人他们也改变了。

——但是，也有未曾改变的事物。

**“那天的约定……你还记得吗？”**

10年前搬到国外的，另一对双胞胎青梅竹马。

加贺美碧瑠(ヘキル)与加贺美光瑠(ヒカル)再次出现在优人他们面前，停滞的“思念”再次开始转动。

丰饶的日子 **＜Clover Day's＞** 从此开始——
v13325.originalDescription:
Bottled-up emotions...
An everlasting oath...
Heartfelt desires...
An enduring regret...
And a childhood promise.

Yuuto was abandoned by his parents and raised in an orphanage in Britain before a trading merchant by the name of Takakura Yoshiomi adopted him and brought him to Japan.

He could barely speak the language, but he had the support and love of his two new sisters, the cheery yet shy Anzu, and the calm, collected Anri.
During his time in elementary school, he also made new friends: the ingenuous and kind Tsubame, and the ostentatious but guarded Izumi.

They were young and oblivious to love back then. They laughed together, cried together, and nurtured irreplaceable bonds with one another.

Ten years later...

The landscape of the town has changed, and so have they.

Yet some things never do change, no matter how much time passes.

"Do you still remember the promise we made that day?"

Ten years ago, during their childhood, there was another pair of twins that they all played with.
Hekiru and Hikaru reappear and the emotions that have since frozen in time are now rekindled.
This marks the beginning of their resplendent time together, their "Clover Days."

v15143.title: 杀恋～悠久流传的恋之歌～
v15143.original: サツコイ～悠久なる恋の歌～
aliases: 杀恋～悠久流传的恋之歌～
サツコイ～悠久なる恋の歌～
v15143.originalDescription:
One snowy night, the protagonist, Kanou Izumi, kicked out of his house under some circumstances, lay dying in front of the train station. Unable to move from hunger, his five senses frozen from the cold, he was about to lose consciousness. His feelings were already past despair; he was void of all emotions.

Then, a girl, Shirahase Yuu, a classmate who often skips school, appears. As if picking up an abandoned kitten, she takes him to her apartment.

"Kanou-kun, you are my meal so I'm going to feed you to fatten you up." She smiles faintly as she voices those words.

"This girl is messed up."

Even while thinking that, Izumi had nowhere else to go, and so stays in her apartment. However, Izumi eventually realizes... Yuu is a descendant of the immortal man-eating mermaids.

Would you die for the sake of the one you love?

The predator and the prey. 

A love story that no one will ever understand.
v15143.description:
——你能为了爱而死吗？
某个雪夜。
主人公・加纳泉(加納イズミ)因为某些原因被赶出家门，在车站前濒临死亡。
饥饿让身体无法动弹，寒冷让感觉消失，眼看就要失去意识。
内心越过绝望，变得毫无感情。
这时，一名少女——有些拒不上学的同班同学・白羽濑悠(白羽瀬悠)出现了。
她简直就像捡起弃猫一样捡起了他，带回了她独居的公寓。
“加纳同学，你是我的饲料，所以我会把你养胖了之后再吃掉哦”
悠伴随着浅浅的笑容吐出了这样的话。
（——这家伙，绝对不正常）
虽然这么想，但无处可去的泉暂时留在了悠的公寓里。
但是，不久后泉将会知道。
悠是吞噬人类、活过悠久岁月的人鱼的后裔这件事。

v16906.title: LOVEREC.
v16906.originalDescription:
The story takes place at the end of April in a small school in Funakura, a quiet town close to the sea. Akira is a shutterbug who loves taking videos even during meals. He left the film research club to start a videography club with his childhood friend Chiho. He wished to create a work which will make people smile. However, the film research club’s young prodigy director Miyuki strongly opposed it. It was decided at the school’s information session that if they can defeat the film research club at a competition, then they would be recognized as a proper club.

He ran around finding members for the new club, but they still did not have enough members as the deadline approached. Just as their future looked bleak, there was a strange flash from his cherished video camera that he’s had for the past 10 years and a small girl appeared before him.

“I am the camera spirit. Let me protect you, Master”

After meeting the easygoing camera spirit Hitomi and the pro video editor Nori who doesn’t attend school, his surroundings began to greatly change.

Why do we create things? Why do we fall in love? Why are we there?

They experience the emotions of youth – anxiety, anger, laughter, sadness – as they gradually move forward together true to their own feelings.
v16906.description:
樱花也已散落的四月末。
从临近海边、宁静街道的小小校园开始，故事拉开了帷幕。


连吃饭时都在转动摄像机的摄影笨蛋青年『梁瀬 旭』。
他为了“拍摄让人露出笑容的作品”，
和爱照顾人的青梅竹马『芳永 千穂』一起，
正准备成立视频拍摄同好会——通称“動好会”。

但是，旭的老东家映研所属的年轻天才导演『白澤 美悠紀』强烈反对。
她提出了条件，如果在校园宣讲会上举行比赛并战胜映研，就认可動好会。

为招募成员而四处奔走的旭，却招不到人，期限也日益临近，一筹莫展。
就在那时，心爱的摄像机溢出不可思议的光芒，娇小的少女现身了。

“我是相机的精灵。赐予主人加护吧——”

慢条斯理的相机精灵『瞳(ヒトミ)』。
持续不上学的视频剪辑专家『御厨 乃梨』。
通过与她们的崭新相遇，旭周围的环境发生了巨大的改变。


我们，是为了什么而创作事物的呢。
我们，为什么会喜欢上一个人呢。
我们，为什么会在『那里』呢……。

烦恼、生气、欢笑、哭泣。

度过着平凡的青春，
少年与少女面对自己的内心，一点一点地向前迈进——

v18790.title: 缘契初情乃今家舍妹
v18790.original: そして初恋が妹になる
aliases: そして初恋が妹になる
Soshite Hatsukoi ga Imouto ni Naru
v18790.originalDescription:
Having faced many hardships as a child, the cynical Kazuharu believed that the world was a wasteland and the only way to survive it was to work your hardest. There’s no time for playing nor falling in love, like the rest of his classmates.

While he was working hard as usual, he saw a mysterious girl with a uniform he did not recognize. She appeared to always avoid the gaze of others. Normally he wouldn’t pay much attention, but for some reason he was particularly interested in her. Then suddenly one day, she became his imouto.
v18790.description:
「青春什么的，我是无福消受」



这是自幼就过得很辛苦，养成了有些排他的性格的主人公時谷一春的口头禅。

这个世界便是一片荒野。要在这荒野求得生存，只能拼尽全力劳动。



「我可没有像其它同学那样，享受游乐啊恋爱什么的事情的空闲啊」



一春日复一日都抱着这样的想法努力劳动着。



在这样的他面前，突然出现了一位谜之少女。

穿着没见过的校服，似乎总是躲避着他人耳目的，连名字都不知道的老实少女。

如果是平时的一春可能管都不会管她，可不知为何一春就是在意得不得了。



然后，某一天她——突然变成了一春的妹妹。



「为什么啊！？」



将困惑的一春和愉快（以及有些怪）的伙伴们卷进去的，

“没有享受青春的机会的年轻人们的青春剧”即将开幕——

v21495.title: 伊人天使妹侧畔
aliases: Kanojo wa Tenshi de Imouto de
My Little Sister Is an Angel
v21495.originalDescription:
Yuuki has always attracted attention due to his superior looks and being the son of two entertainers. However, he has a quiet demeanour and did not feel comfortable in the spotlight, instead wishing for a more peaceful and ordinary life. But things don’t always go the way you want them to in life.

He met an angel by chance one night, who asked him if he wanted to become a god. Ignoring his perplexed response, she made him an ‘angel candidate’ and his life changed completely. First, the girl Touka became his imouto by using her powers to create a ‘miracle’. Moreover, two girls were sent to train him: the school’s prettiest girl and idol Mia, who was actually an angel; and, the solitary cool beauty genius girl Kazumi, who was actually a shinigami.

He was put through harsh training by the three girls, but could not become an angel, much less a god. Not only that but his osananajimi Erina, the only place of solace he could turn to, was awfully displeased with him since he’s been so close to other girls lately. Things really don’t go the way you want them to.

One year later, Yuuki still remained an angel-in-training. In fact, it’s like he hadn’t grown one bit. Would an angel without wings like him ever become a god? What kind of future awaits him?
v21495.description:
优希(ユウキ)凭借其出众的容貌以及作为两位艺人之子的身份，始终备受瞩目。然而，他性格文静，不习惯站在聚光灯下，渴望过上更加安稳平凡的生活。但是，事情并不总能如愿以偿。

某天夜里，他偶然遇到了一位天使，并被问及是否想成为神。她无视了他困惑的反应，将他变成了“天使候补”，他的人生从此彻底改变。首先，少女灯花(トウカ)运用自己的力量引发了“奇迹”，成为了他的妹妹。此外，为了训练他，又派来了两个女孩：米娅(ミア)，学校里最美的女孩，其实是天使的偶像；还有孤独冷酷的美之天才少女和美，其实是死神。

在三个女孩的严厉调教下，他别说成为神了，连天使都当不成。不仅如此，他唯一能依靠的慰藉之所——他的青梅竹马艾丽娜(エリナ)，也因为他最近和其他女孩走得太近而对他极为不满。事情真的不能如愿以偿。

过了一年后的现在，优希依然是修行中的天使。不仅如此，他甚至觉得自己一点都没有长大。像他这样没有翅膀的天使能成为神吗？等待着他的会是怎样的未来呢。

v93.title: Muv-Luv
aliases: MUV-LUV Save in the name of true love
v93.description:
EXTRA篇
白陵大附属柊学园3年级白银武和青梅竹马鉴纯夏，好友铠衣尊人过着愉快普通的校园生活。某一天的早上，醒来的武发现身旁睡着一名少女。这位名叫御剑冥夜的少女就这样住了下来。
由于冥夜的登场与周围的人发生些许变化的关系。随着同学榊千鹤、彩峰慧、珠濑壬姫的加入展开的喜剧日常。与到目前为止平缓的时间相反的急速变化的心。还有期望这些的人与不期望这些的人。
前方等待着武的，到底是······

UNLIMITED篇
白银武与冥夜、纯夏还有同学们一起友好地过着不普通但又平凡的生活。某一天早上醒来的时候，时间已经过了8点。想着要迟到的武急忙飞奔出去，但眼前的却是已经 成为废墟的小镇，和倒在已经倒塌的纯夏的家的人型机器人。武以为这是梦，来到白陵大附属柊学园，那里却变成了“联合国部队横滨基地”。越来越确信这是梦的武，在被当作可疑的人被捕之后，终于开始觉得这不是梦了。
被香月夕呼从拘留所里释放的武从她那得知了这个是世界是与地球外起源种“BETA”处于战争中。而且武还无法接受“白银武并不存在于这个世界”的事实。
但是为了日后的生存，武接受了香月夕呼的话，无可奈何地开始了训练兵生活。在那里见到了“原来世界的同学们”御剑冥夜、榊千鹤、彩峰慧、珠濑壬姫。当然，冥夜她们并不认识武。武困惑着与战争时期军国主义社会的价值观和觉悟的不同，一边相信着自己总有一天回到原来的世界，一边与冥也她们一起努力训练。
在那个战乱的世界中得到的知识、友情和爱极大地影响了武的心。以前自己生活的世界真的是现实，还是梦？在这个世界的自己是真实的自己吗？以及这个世界以后到底会发生什么。

v92.title: マブラヴ　オルタネイティヴ
v92.original: マブラヴ　オルタネイティヴ
aliases: マブラヴ　オルタネイティヴ
v92.description:
本作是该公司于2003年所推出的作品Muv-Luv（マブラヴ）的续篇。

“Muv-Luv”整部作品主体共分为三个篇章，分别是EXTRA、UNLIMITED和ALTERNATIVE；由于游戏制作上的时间问题，âge决定先发售包含EXTRA&UNLIMITED的Muv-Luv，而第三部分ALTERNATIVE（即本作Alternative）则于日后制作完成再行推出。

而本作品的故事舞台一如âge的不成文惯例设定在柊町，这也使得本作和âge首部作品《你所在的季节（君がいた季節）》和成名作《你所期望的永远（君が望む永遠）》处于同一时空，而彼此有联系。


2001 年10月22日，身为普通高中生的男主角・白银武一觉醒来，发现自己进入了一个平行世界。在这个平行世界里，地球人数十年来都与带有敌意的外星生命体“BETA”苦战着；而他就置身于因此而荒废的柊町（主角家乡，位于日本横滨）。在这个一切都改变了的世界重新出发的武加入了联合国军，并参与了对抗BETA的最后手段，拯救人类的“ALTERNATIVE4” 计划。为此他成为联合国军卫士（巨大人型兵器“战术机”的驾驶员）并和伙伴们一起努力。但到了12月24日，人类放弃了最后的奋斗而启动了放弃地球的“ALTERNATIVE5” 计划。（到此为止是前作“Muv-Luv”UNLIMITED篇的剧情）

而在此三年后，睡醒时发现再次置身于自家卧室的武，以为自己已经回到“原来的世界”，然而户外的景象却和三年前相同。日历上的日期是2001年10 月22日。武发现自己经过时间跳跃又一次来到了充满战乱的平行世界，而在此，他决定以唯一知道这个世界的未来的人类的身分，为了完成“ALTERNATIVE4”计划而再次敲开联合国军横滨基地的大门。再次被编入207实验部队的武，带着3年之间的军事经验和未来的记忆，以及不输给伙伴们的觉悟，再次迎向挑战。

时间只剩下两个月左右。究竟武是否能达到目的，人类又是否能战胜BETA呢……？
v92.originalDescription:
"A destiny tossed about, in an insane world---
A flame of life blazing forth, in a dying world---
And now, one more future that is spun---

This is the alternative ending unable to be told before:
A very great, a very tiny, a very precious...
Tale of love and courage."

Muv-Luv Alternative continues the story of Shirogane Takeru after the events of the original Muv-Luv. This is a tale of a love so deep it breaks all barriers; about courage in the face of adversity and overcoming hardships. Takeru encounters insurmountable odds while his entire world is turned upside down around him.

v94.title: 你所期望的永远
v94.originalDescription: At first, Takayuki Narumi is befriended by Mitsuki Hayase only because Mitsuki's best friend, Haruka Suzumiya has a crush on him; however since then, Takayuki, his pal Shinji Taira, and Mitsuki have grown to be the best of friends. Then one day, Haruka confesses to Takayuki her love for him. Not wanting to hurt her feelings, Takayuki agrees to go out with her. After a few incidents, their relationship gets intimate, even while Takayuki and Mitsuki begin to realize their feelings for each other. But suddenly, when tragedy strikes, things are never the same for these four friends again.
v94.description:
主人公鸣海孝之(鳴海孝之)是白陵大附属柊学园的三年级学生。
毕业临近却无法决定出路，虽然感到模糊的焦虑，却仍随波逐流地度日。

某天，同班同学兼女性朋友的速濑水月(速瀬水月)邀请他，与好友平慎二一起去夏日祭典，并介绍了水月的好友凉宫遥(涼宮 遙)。那个女孩，是他以前曾见过的内向女孩。
在水月努力将遥拉入三人的圈子之下，孝之也试图友善地对待遥，但不知为何遥总是试图避开孝之，令他愈发焦躁。

日后，孝之被叫到学校后面的山丘上，在那里等待的遥向他告白说喜欢他。
无法抗拒这个内向女孩鼓起勇气说出的一句话，他随波逐流地开始与她交往，但不出所料，与遥的对话十分生硬尴尬。
然而随着时间推移，两人的距离逐渐缩短，孝之开始纯粹地爱上了她。

就在这样的某一天……

âge人气作品「你所期望的永远」以满足粉丝所有要求的形式重制!!

经过多种媒体展开、至今仍拥有顽强人气的「你所期望的永远」重制后再次登场！
追加新的演出效果，以及以新演出重新收录的"if"剧本「你所期望的第一章」，加上作为OVA原作剧本的遥的后日谈，以及新撰写的水月、茜的后日谈所构成的"第三章"追加剧本。当然，图像方面现有CG几乎全部进行了重绘，伴随新剧本的追加也新增了全新绘制的CG。
在内容充实、全面升级的「你所期望的永远」中，再次品味那份感动吧!!


『你所期望的永远 重置版』追加与新要素
●第一章的演出重绘与AGES对应！
作为全新的「你所期望的永远」，对应了演出的重绘以及âge独有的动态演出系统AGES（Age Global Effect System）。
在不破坏「你所期望的永远」原有氛围的前提下，融入动态演出，可以享受表现力更加丰富的故事！

●追加人气选项与新剧本！
将「你所期望的永远 ～special Fan Disk～」中收录的"if"故事「你所期望的第一章」以全新演出重新收录。此外，以游戏形式追加成为OVA「你所期望的永远 ～Next Season～」原作剧本的遥的后日谈！伴随于此，水月、茜的后日谈也为重置版全新撰写。可以享受三位主要女主角的"第三章"。

●图像重绘等各种品质提升！
伴随重制，所使用的图像素材进行了重新审视及品质提升！为了表现更高的演出效果，立绘CG全面重绘，图案数量也增加了。当然，为新剧本准备的事件CG和背景也新增了全新绘制的内容！此外还采用了约16:9的宽屏画面，并为各角色添加了眨眼、张嘴的动画效果。

●栗林美奈实(栗林みな実)演唱的新片头主题曲与新片头动画的追加
收录了由主要女主角凉宫遥的配音演员栗林美奈实演唱的新片头主题曲，以及游戏开始前的新片头动画！

●收录全新撰写剧本带来的豪华初回特典！
初回版计划收录以「你所期望的永远」为主题的全新撰写剧本的游戏形式特典。

Jouji Gouda is a new transfer student at Hakuryo High School. On his first day of class, he fell in love at first sight for Akane Suzumiya and boldly proposed to her on the spot. The two characters conflict with each other greatly, but Jouji never gives up and would do anything to express his love towards Akane.

Although his attempts to win Akane's love at first do nothing but anger Akane, he gradually starts to make an impression on her, inspiring Akane to be more honest about her own feelings.
v161.description:
刚田城二(Gouda Jouji)是白陵高中的转学生。在他上课的第一天，他对涼宮 茜(Suzumiya Akane)一见钟情，并当场大胆地向她求婚。两人之间冲突不断，但刚田从不放弃，为了向茜表达爱意，他愿意做任何事。

尽管他最初试图赢得茜的爱的举动只会惹怒她，但他逐渐开始给她留下印象，激励茜对自己的真实感情更加坦诚。

回避“第1章的悲剧”，以及3年前与水月、茜的交往等，粉丝跨越3年的梦想终于实现。

v404.originalDescription:
Muv-Luv Supplement is fan disc that focuses on Muv-Luv Extra and wants to make up for the lack of Sumika and H.

It contains:

Sakura no Hana ga Saku Mae ni ~Muv-Luv After Episode~

Before the Sakura Trees Bloom is an after story to Sumika's route in Muv-Luv Extra, starting in February 2002, showing the events where Takeru, Sumika, Ayamine, Sakaki, Yoroi and Tama graduate from Hakuryou Academy.

Muv-Luv ~Another Episode Collection~

Also known as the Heroine Short Story Collection, it's a batch of short stories that take place prior to and during Extra, each one centered around one of the main heroines. They were later included in photonflowers. Contains the following stories:

* Takeru-chan to Issho! - story centered around Kagami Sumika
* Sono Na wa Takeru and Waga Na wa Meiya - two stories centered around Mitsurugi Meiya
* Shirogane-kun Chotto! - story centered around Sakaki Chizuru
* Shirogane... Tabeteru? - story centered around Ayamine Kei
* Takeru-san no Shippo - story centered around Tamase Miki

Muv-Luv Duelist

Rumbling Angel is a trading card game sold by Silver Blitz. It features characters from various galge brands such as Age. This is a PC adaptation of this game featuring the heroines of Muv-Luv.
It has a story mode that serves as a tutorial and also a free battle mode.

KimiNozo Radio Shucchouban 2

Accessories, wallpapers and voice collection

The latest trailer of Muv-Luv Alternative

v444.description: 突然出现在正树面前的伊隅四姐妹的表姐妹，照子。那是据说绝对不可能入手的白金门票“与最后的炼金术师夏洛特同游欧洲超常地点”的旅行券。正树一行人被明和照子推着踏上了前往欧洲的旅程。最初的住宿地是建在某座湖中岛屿上的古城。悲剧公主的亡灵、狼人传说、湖中巨兽、飞碟坠落……这是由一座报告过各种超常现象、问题重重的城堡改建而成的。妖艳的女主人薇尔卡以及女仆们的奇怪举动。在正树身边接连发生的超常现象。还有……在水面下暗流涌动的某个组织所策划的阴谋。城堡崩塌——欧洲横贯列车爆炸——东京毁灭？！伊隅四姐妹的命运究竟会如何！

v1380.title: さくらテイル
aliases: the tale of cherry blossom septet
v1380.originalDescription:
Masamune has just started his school life, but he soon gets involved in a recruiting battle by sports clubs. What saves him is a girl in strange clothing. He is attracted to her, but he meets another girl who looks totally different a few days later.

Light and darkness. He meets his childhood friend at the school dormitory, but she has completely changed.

"Masamune. I'm glad I could save you." 

New season. New school. New friends. The story takes place at a school gently watched by a big cherry tree.
v1380.description:
恋爱的少女会改变两次！
——然后，又是樱花盛开的季节。
借着入学的机会离开父母身边，开始一个人生活的主人公，新条正宗(新條正宗)。
然而，满怀对新生活的期待来到这里的他，刚一踏入学校用地，就被卷入了以体育系社团招募新生为目的的骚动之中。
拯救身处困境的正宗的，是一位穿着打扮奇特、疑似高年级学生的女学生。
在被她英姿飒爽的身影看呆了半天后，正宗紧接着遇到了位于其对立面的少女。
阴与阳。
在学校宿舍时隔数年再会的青梅竹马，在许久未见的这段时间里，朝着不太好的方向发生了巨大的蜕变。
本该是曾经作为最喜欢的邻家姐姐而仰慕的人，却不顾任由疯长的头发和毫无女人味的打扮凑近了脸庞。
“正宗”
与对同龄异性所感到的截然不同的心跳，令人感伤地响起。
“……真危险呢。能救到你太好了哦”
双手小心翼翼地抱着三角包牛奶的她，这样，结结巴巴地低语道。
新的季节。新的学校。然后，与充满个性的女主角们的新相遇。
以被樱花大树环抱的“王立春宵学园”为舞台，与少女们的故事开始转动——。

v2884.originalDescription: Yuuma is caught in a fierce battle and a pretty girl comes to his aid. Her name is Natia and she intends to protect him and the town from destruction. He greatly wishes to be able to help her, and that’s when a bright light envelops them and Natia’s weapon transforms into a giant sword. So a normal boy will become the key to saving the world... no, the universe!
v2884.description:
为了拯救走向崩坏的世界，一名少年现在！被卷入了其中……

主人公赤城优真是个随处可见的普通青年。
从出生至今，他既不擅长运动也不擅长学习，连女朋友都没有……
这样的他在放学回家途中遇到的，是美少女手持武器战斗的景象！
而且，他还被卷入了那场激烈的战斗之中！！

挺身而出保护优真的美少女名叫纳蒂亚。
她为了保护优真和城镇，自己受了伤。
优真强烈地想要帮助她！就在这时，下一瞬间，两人被耀眼的光芒包围，等他回过神来，优真已经附魔在纳蒂亚的武器上，变成了一把巨大的剑！

两人以超乎寻常的威力击退了敌人。
当优真恢复人形、正处于混乱之中时，纳蒂亚告诉了他一个冲击性的事实。

「你已经与利亚·法尔融合了」

一切都是未知。

从这一天起，优真充满波折的日常生活开始了！

v4572.title: ら～じPonPon
v4572.originalDescription:
Our hero's girlfriend, Rurika, suddenly informs him that she is being transferred to Paris. However, after only a few months, she gives up her job and comes home; she is pregnant. Following an extremely hot argument, she leaves him without telling him where she is going. 

Our hero goes looking for her and learns that she has checked into an obstetrics ward. Here at the hospital, he accidentally runs into Yukari, an old childhood friend from school. He also starts up a hot relationship with a married woman named Touri, who is staying in the next hospital room. His girlfriend really starts to get jealous of his other playmates. Will he fulfill his obligations to Rurika, or will he keep going after hot, new babes?
v4572.description:
本作是0verflow公司的处女作，游戏名“大号PonPon”实际上就是指“妊娠”，也就是怀孕，是昭和时代的俗语，也说明了本作的主题。本作是成人游戏界孕妇属性这一体裁的开端。在发售当时饱受争议，并引起部分人的恶心反感。

游戏系统方面，作为一款恋爱冒险游戏，一改单纯的指令选择型，引入了移动地图和时间流逝的概念。错误的时间或错误的地点都会导致偏离路线，大大增加了游戏难度。

v4573.description:
◆◆游戏介绍◆◆
什么是《Overflow　欢乐盒子》？
这是《ら〜じPonPon》与《Pure Mail》的角色们交织而成的娱乐软件♪
里面充满了各种各样的感情哦……

【Pure Chatter 碧】
《Pure Mail》的女主角“奈川碧”围绕游戏主人公“绪方圭”，展开打字大激战！
碧能否击退所有为了得到他而接连挡在面前的其他女主角们！
女人之间的友情与恋爱的去向，也许全靠碧引以为傲的键盘操作就能解决？

【Quiz DE☆PonPon】
和らーじPonPon的角色们用问答一决胜负！
能迅速记住对实际生活毫无用处的知识！
《らーじPonPon》的故事发生约1年后。
主人公阴差阳错地和在医院遇到的所有女孩都发生了关系，
而对此一无所知的琉璃香正过着新婚生活。
然而，世事并非那么简单。
琉璃香的上司，雾岛队长因为“怀孕”住进了那家医院。
琉璃香邀请主人公一起去探病，但主人公却不太情愿。
这也难怪，因为雾岛队长肚子里的孩子就是他的。
其实不仅如此。
被琉璃香强行带到医院的主人公面前，
曾经和他发生过关系的女孩们挡住了去路。
全都挺着大肚子………
既然如此，就通过回答挡路的女孩们提出的问答，来完成“男人的清算”吧！

【Pure Mail外传】
波澜不惊的暑假结束，校园生活再次开始。
就在这时，转校生“友坂真彩”出现在主人公面前。
因为结城绫华和鳄垣在暑假期间转学了，
她便转入了和主人公相同的班级。
听说她在转学之前上的是升学学校，同学们出于好奇追问转学理由，
真彩却对此闭口不谈。
这意味着她被班级孤立了……
与此同时，主人公的手机上收到了一封写着“来做邮件笔友吧”、
署名为“久美”的邮件。
最近主人公经常收到陌生人发来的这种邮件，于是他回了一句
“是女的就行”，
在轻松应对的过程中，和“久美”成了邮件笔友……
此外，还有【之后的Pure Mail】、【制作人员室】、
【壁纸集与屏幕保护程序】等，内容丰富多彩的《Overflow　欢乐盒子》。

3000 years in the future, after a terrible war has polluted the worlds atmosphere.

A young girl named Eve has lived in an underground shelter for a long time with only a robot AI for companionship.

When one day a guy finds her and her world starts to move again.
v19012.description:
在最终战争中大地荒废的遥远未来。
由于大气污染，人类的寿命减半以下。

……在这样的时代，
生活在贫民窟的少年修德(シュド)遇到了神秘的逃亡者阿塔尔瓦(アタルヴァ)，
从他那里听说了关于一个少女的事情。

那个少女的名字是【伊芙(イヴ)】。
在古人留下的巨大地下避难所【尼奥斯菲亚】中，
与管理AI【克莱德尔(クレイドル)】一同度过了3000年时光的那个少女，
据说在身上隐藏着某种禁忌的力量。

得知此事的修德为了用那股力量净化大地，
与阿塔尔瓦一同前往地下的尼奥斯菲亚，
就在与少女邂逅之后不久，遭到了军队的袭击。

……面对军队巨大的人型兵器的力量，修德他们束手无策。

然而那时，仿佛呼应着少女的危机一般，
纯白的人型兵器【钢刃列骑(ティアブレイド)】在少年们面前现身了……

v5096.originalDescription:
End of Edo period, Kyoto. 
Hero becomes a part of a newly-formed Shinsengumi unit. He is to protect Kyoto from the evil hands of Kinno (Kyushu) and develop relations with squad female members such as Hijikata and Okita. 
Despite the real historical period, events are mostly comical and beyond time limits. For example, heroines often appeal to human rights protection. Depending on the value of real "absurdity" parameter in the game you can get rid of the great devil coming to Kyoto with a 88 mm cannon, cyborgs or panda samurai.
v5096.description:
以幕末京都的新选组为舞台的游戏。
主人公成为新选组的新人队士，为了刚刚举旗成立的新选组而奋斗。然后，在保护京都免受勤王魔爪侵害的同时，加深与土方、冲田等新选组女性队士们的交流。
这款游戏虽说是时代剧，却毫不严肃，别说时代考证了，连女主角们是不是人类都令人怀疑的事件频发。根据“荒谬度”这一参数的数值，甚至会发生用88毫米炮击退前往京都的大魔神，或是改造人和熊猫武士袭击新选组之类的事情。
主线故事因为“刷新”而变成了另一部作品，所以没有变化，但追加了大量事件，无论是初次接触的人还是老手都能乐在其中。
此外，前作中意见很多的“荒谬度以外的参数的意义”得到了改善，游戏中也追加了众多小游戏。再也不会让人说出“除了荒谬度以外都不需要”这种话了！

v431.title: "Hello, world."
v431.originalDescription:
Set in Akihabara in the near future, "Hello, world." is a hearty, feature-length, cyber battle-action/campus-life story about a robot boy and the girls that surround him.
Tremendous progress has been made in technical advances. Various networks have taken strongholds with each new generation. Though not nearly advanced as humans, two-legged robots are utilized in many practical areas throughout the world. Amid worldwide peace, the human race remains unchanged.

Kazuki Tomonaga is a robot made by an entity called "HIKARI" for the purpose of "GLOBAL ILLUMINATION". He's created with ingenuity as precise as that of a human being. Kazuki is commanded to research the concepts of "human emotion". Along the way he meets various girls and has exchanges with them. In their "exchanges" his "curiosity" gradually turns into "affection" and his mission becomes more intense. He gradually starts to build his own philosophy, not knowing he will be forced to make crucially important decisions in the near future.
v431.description:
这里、有我想要守护之人存在。

主人公、友永和樹乃是「机器人」。
并非简单的机械组合、
而是装备与人类相似的、超精密程式的、高科技机械大脑的拟态机器人。
被任命调查人类感情的和樹。
为了完成任务而潜伏进入到了适合调查的某一场所“皇路学園”。

为了完成目的而与各种各样的女孩子相遇、并积极与她们交流、
但她们对待自己的态度行为那些感情完全是自己无法理解的。

比起深化交流获取有价值的信息变为了纯粹的“兴趣”与“好意”、
并非因为命令、他渐渐的自发形成了个人的价值观。

v443.originalDescription: Masaki has 4 childhood friends – Yayoi, Michiru, Marika and Akira who are all sisters, they let him stay in one of their family’s apartments since he doesn’t live with his family. Masaki’s hobby is photography and one day, he meets a famous photographer who lets Masaki become his apprentice. Time passes, and Masaki also gets a girlfriend too and life couldn’t be any happier for him. However, one day he is asked to go to America to work in the huge photography business over there but he thinks that having a long distance relationship would be incredibly hard. He now has a life-changing decision to make – does he follow his dream or does he stay with the person who he loves most in this world?
v443.description:
诞生出众多大人气作品的会社——âge的原点！

在世界观通用的âge全作品中，处于始祖地位的《你的季节（重置版）》重制决定！

剧本当然由原作执笔的鬼畜人塔姆氏担当，故事构成・剧本编写全部从零开始！
包括原版中没有的“和女主角成为恋人之前的小插曲”在内，追加大量新剧情，容量更是以前的2倍以上。
原画方面，起用在作品《Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse》中表现活跃的宫田苍氏，使用曾获得高度评价的演出系统・AGES，给玩家带来美妙的现代风视觉效果。
完全刷新原作的光景，即使称为“完全新作”也毫不为过。

权衡梦想和恋人的天平，在烦恼中选择人生方向的主人公，与女主角们复杂的恋爱模样将滋润你的心灵。



故事情节
主人公・前岛正树与四邻公认的美人四姐妹伊隅一家是青梅竹马。
目前在伊隅家所有的公寓中独自生活。

喜欢摄影的正树在一次偶然的机会下得到著名摄影师・香月光子(香月ミツコ)的赏识。
成为光子弟子的正树一边磨练着自己的摄影技巧，一边与四姐妹中的一人确定了恋爱关系。

梦想与恋爱双赢的幸福状态中，更大的喜讯降临到他头上。
那就是——正树的作品被当今世界数一数二的摄影大师赫尔穆特·牛顿约翰看中。
正树得到以他弟子的身份前往他位于美国的工作室深造的机会。

得到赫尔穆特的认同让正树兴奋不已。
但在意识到成为大师之徒后，就不得不面对与恋人超远距离恋爱的事实，陷入迷茫。

一帆风顺的人生出现关键的分叉点。
正树最后是会选择追寻梦想，还是守护恋人？

v579.title: アノニマス
v579.originalDescription: Kousuke lives with his mother, Sakiko, and younger sister, Izumi, peacefully. But Izumi starts to withdraw at home, and they decide to move to another city. There are girls he knows at school where they transfer, Natsuki and Yuka, whom Kousuke met at the beach of his hometown last summer. But Natsuki seems to hate Kousuke. He doesn't know why, and can't understand her. One day, he receives an email from "Anonymous" saying, "I know your secret." He doesn't know what it is, but the email comes to his cell phone every day. It seems the sender enjoys seeing him being confused. He thinks something happened during the summer when he met them. He starts to investigate what happened on that day, even though he has a bad premonition...
v579.description:
偶然的重逢，是通向悲剧的序章。季节正迅速走向冬天。

主人公鹿岛浩介，与母亲沙希子、妹妹泉水三人一起生活。他们原本住在某个乡下小镇，但因为泉水变得闭门不出，一家人决定搬家。

搬去的地方是都市。面对骤然改变的生活，浩介感到困惑；而在转入的学园里，他遇见了熟人。那是今年夏天到浩介乡下海水浴时相识的女主角泷野夏葵与深山由香。

这本是意外的重逢，然而令人惊讶的是，夏葵对浩介显露出强烈敌意。她不断责备着什么，但浩介毫无头绪；而夏葵又拒绝交谈，使他无法问出事情缘由。

某一天，一封不可解的邮件成为契机，主人公一行人的命运开始转动。浩介的手机收到一封来自自称 Anonymous 的对象发来的邮件。

“我知道你的秘密。”这句话让浩介陷入困惑。接连不断发来的信息。Anonymous 明明知晓一切，却不打算告诉他真相，仿佛是在享受浩介的焦躁。

然而，这已足以让浩介确信：在他们曾生活于乡下的那个夏日，在他与夏葵、由香相识的那个夏日，在导致泉水闭门不出的“某件事”发生的那个夏日里，存在着连浩介自己也不知道的“秘密”。

浩介试图抵达那个“秘密”。

他当然预感到，那一定会招来对自己而言并不美好的事物。

但浩介实在太天真了。后悔，从来不会先于结果到来……

v1743.originalDescription:
In Kyushu, there lies the small village of Suno. In that small village, four childhood friends, Touma Takumi, Ogami Ritsuko, Amamiya Kanon, and Takanashi Mio comprise a small music club at the village school. One day, Takumi happens to see and hear the violin performance of Orihara Ai, a girl who recently moved to the village and transferred into the school. This performance later eventually causes Ritsuko to resolve to recruit Ai into their music club no matter what.

However, one day, one of the childhood friends is separated from the other three, but before doing so passes on her role of "Supervisor" to Takumi. Later, they learn that the school they all attend is going to be closed down in one month due to a government-ordered evacuation of the village. Everyone resolves to make their last month together as memorable and enjoyable as possible before the school closes down...
v1743.description:
远离都市喧嚣的偏僻乡村的宁静小镇。
无论是喜悦还是悲伤，都任凭身体随着如天空中飘浮的云朵般悠然流逝的时间一同流转。
主人公・冬馬 巧 （とうま たくみ），与两个青梅竹马过着奇妙的共同生活。
年纪较小但与外表不符十分可靠，像仰慕哥哥一样仰慕着巧的小鳥遊 澪 （たかなし みお）。
比巧大一岁，但与外表相反却怎么也靠不住的雨宮 歌音 （あまみや かのん）。
3人就读于镇上的小分校，隶属于音乐部。
掌管音乐部的，是豪爽、帅气、唯我独尊这些词汇极其适合的律子 （りつこ）学姐。
在她的引导下，部员仅有4人的音乐部每天都在努力练习。
就在这样的某一天，运动万能少女・折原 藍 （おりはら あい）转学到了巧的班级。
被律子学姐命令去劝诱藍加入音乐部的巧，为了实现她那胡来的要求而四处奔走——

v2809.originalDescription:
EDEN is a land of pleasure. It's an urban legend, and no one knows where it is or whether it really exists. Some have opened up their own web sites based upon available information and call them EDEN. No one knows for sure if these web sites are real or not, but in any case, the name EDEN is a symbol of immorality and anti-socialism... Hiroki Okamoto lives with his sister Yori. He likes his sister's tutor, Arisa, who is beautiful and rich.

Every savage gamer praised the previous episode of Rasen-Kairo since its release in Jan. of 2000. Now, it's back with even more immorality and abnormality! Whichever you choose, you're guaranteed to get caught up in the horror of this psycho thriller!!

就在这样的某一天，太一发现了在柏木家门前做出可疑举动的少女。
自称“沙希”的少女面对太一的追问，告诉他说她的哥哥“久信”似乎正在和晴子交往，所以正在进行调查。

看到沙希从哥哥房间里偷出来的几张照片，太一受到了打击。
另一方面，沙希敌视着晴子，认为不能让一个不知来路的女人和哥哥交往。
就这样，目的微妙地达成一致的两人，为了确认真相而结成了合作关系……

v7052.original: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ トータル・イクリプス
aliases: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ トータル・イクリプス
v7052.originalDescription:
In the year 2001, the Japanese Empire’s attempt to develop a next-generation Tactical Surface Fighter for their army had hit a dead end. To solve this problem, they decided to work with the American government to build upon their 3rd Generation TSF, the Shiranui.
The project was given the code name XFJ, and Takamura Yui, a 1st Lieutenant in the Royal Guard, was put in charge of it.

Yui had always been against any attempts to work with other countries to develop a new TSF, and she departed for Alaska’s Yukon base with a heart laden with worry and dissatisfaction.

2nd Lieutenant Yuuya Bridges, an American, was also headed to Yukon Base as well. He'd been chosen as the main test pilot of the XFJ Project, and hated Japan because of the sad circumstances of his birth. He too, was very unhappy with the project.

Of course, the two quickly collided, and completion of the project seemed impossible. But if it failed, Japan was doomed...

Set on an Earth pushed to the brink of destruction, Total Eclipse is an intense human drama about the race to develop a new TSF!
v7052.description:
2013年发售的PS3/Xbox360《Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse》的内容得到了进一步打磨。以小说《帝都燃烧》为基础，还追加了描绘女主角之一篁唯依过去的新剧本！

故事
公元2001年，日本帝国的次期主力战术机开发陷入了僵局。
因此，在与美国的合作体制下改良第3世代战术机“不知火”的“XFJ计划”被提出，帝国斯卫军篁唯依中尉被任命为负责人。

认为纯国产开发才有价值的唯依，怀着不安与不满，前往了进行开发的美国阿拉斯加州育空基地。

同一时期，美军的尤亚·布里吉斯(ユウヤ・ブリッジス)少尉也正前往育空基地。
他被选拔为“XFJ计划”的主要试飞员，但因不幸的出身而憎恨日本，怀着极大的不满参加计划。

理所当然地，两人之间产生了激烈的争执，计划的执行蒙上了阴影。
若不能跨越这道难关，日本便没有未来——

以濒临灭亡危机的地球为舞台，围绕新型战术机的开发，充满热血的人们的戏剧现在开幕！

v10335.originalDescription:
You, the young son of a fisherman on a remote island, find a naked girl collapsed on the beach. A doctor nurses her back to health. She seems to have amnesia.

Two men, claiming to be servants of her household, come to take her away. She appears afraid of them, but what can you do about it? Nothing.

The next day, she transfers to your school.
v10335.description:
少女纺织的丝线是——。
或许能够改变注定的未来——。
住在海星岛的海取幸一，一边帮忙祖父的家业渔业一边上学，过着平凡的日子。某个夜晚在海边散步的幸一，忽然在视野中发现了没见过的东西。
没有意识，简直就像被抛弃了一样倒在沙滩上的少女……。幸一抱起她，慌忙跑回了家。在住在附近的海原诊所医生海原夏海子的照料下，少女不久后醒了过来，但她几乎不说话，似乎连自己的名字都不记得了。
没过多久，自称是少女家人的两个人来访了。
少女露出害怕的样子，紧紧抱住幸一不肯离开，但无计可施的幸一就这样把她送走了。临别之际，少女向幸一展现的寂寞表情……。
那天夜里，那表情从幸一的脑海中再也没有消失过……。

v14910.title: シュヴァルツェスマーケン
v14910.original: シュヴァルツェスマーケン
aliases: シュヴァルツェスマーケン
v14910.originalDescription:
The story follows the East German Army's 666th TSF Squadron in its battles and political conflicts during the BETA's westward push in 1983.

The East German Army 666th TSF Squadron "Schwarzesmarken" (Black Marks) are a special-forces unit tasked with assaulting BETA forces through unconventional tactics; specifically, they target Lux and Magnus Lux to deny the BETA the advantage of ranged firepower. Their orders are given the topmost priority, such that it is common practice for the 666th to ignore allied distress calls that will result in deviation from their original mission, even if only for a short moment.
v14910.description:
1983年。遭到异星起源种BETA侵略的东德被迫进行着绝望的消耗战。
在这种状况下，被称为“东德最强”的，隶属于第666战术机中队“黑之宣告”的
提奥多尔·艾伯巴赫(テオドール・エーベルバッハ)少尉是一个既不信任国家也不信任他人，只为了自己存活而持续战斗的卫士。

在那种战场上发现孤立的战术机的中队长爱丽丝蒂娜·伯恩哈德(アイリスディーナ・ベルンハルト)大尉
与提奥多尔一同前往救援战术机。提奥多尔报告说平安救出的卫士是西德军的少女、
凯蒂亚·瓦尔特海姆(カティア・ヴァルトハイム)少尉，
但爱丽丝蒂娜却露出了难掩惊讶的表情。

来自西德的少女凯蒂亚为了流亡东德而越过国境，
请求编入第666中队。
随队政治军官格蕾特·耶克恩(グレーテル・イェッケルン)中尉进言说这会引起统治着东德的国家保安省的
注意，但爱丽丝蒂娜还是批准了编入，
并任命提奥多尔担任凯蒂亚的教导员。

不想被国家保安省盯上的提奥多尔追问她为何要流亡东德，
凯蒂亚回答说是为了寻找某个人物而来的。

置身于欧洲展开的战争中的卫士们的故事，现在即将讲述。

v32753.title: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ チキン・ダイバーズ
v32753.original: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ チキン・ダイバーズ
aliases: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ チキン・ダイバーズ
v32753.originalDescription:
Chicken Divers was originally a Muv-Luv Alternative fanfiction written by Wei Luxin.
It was officially recognized by Age and published by them during Comiket 74, the 15 August 2008, as part of a fanbook called MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE Operation Lunatic-Dawn:Base521. Lunatic-Dawn referred to Ariake where the Tokyo Big Sight, the venue for the Comiket, was located. Base521 referred to Age's booth number.
Later, Chicken Divers was made into a visual novel which was released at Comiket 76 which took place during August 2009 (14-16).
The 30 July 2010, it was republished inside Chronicles 01, bundled with the databook MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD3 Code：Rebellion. Voices were added and the production value enhanced.

Chicken Divers is a sidestory about a squadron of Orbital Divers before and during their participation in Operation 21st, the battle to take the Sadogashima Hive. The story focuses mostly on Henri Gietzen, identified as Aquila 1, of the UN Aerospace Army's 6th Orbital Corps' Aquila Squadron throughout the story, as he reminisces about his past before the drop.

v32754.original: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ レイン・ダンサーズ
aliases: マブラヴ オルタネイティヴ クロニクルズ レイン・ダンサーズ
v32754.originalDescription:
Rain Dancers was originally a Muv-Luv Alternative fanfiction written by Wei Luxin.
It was officially recognized by Age and published by them during the âge x Nitro+ Kanzen Gattai DX Godo Akiba Event, the 27 December 2008, as part of a fanbook called MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD2 PROJECT PROMINENCE.
Later, Chicken Divers was made into a visual novel which was released at Comiket 77, which took place during December 2009 (29-31). Unfortunately, this release was full of bugs.
The 30 July 2010, it was republished inside Chronicles 01, bundled with the databook MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD3 Code：Rebellion. Voices were added and the production value enhanced.

Rain Dancers is a short story that takes place in November 1995. It details part of the effort of a combined European force using the brand new test EF-2000 Typhoons to create a foothold in Europe by retaking parts of Italy from BETA control.
v32754.description:
Rain Dancers 最初是由 Wei Luxin 撰写的一篇 Muv-Luv Alternative 同人小说。

它在2008年12月27日的 âge x Nitro+ Kanzen Gattai DX Godo Akiba Event 期间获得了 Age 的官方认可并由其出版，作为名为 MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD2 PROJECT PROMINENCE 的同人志的一部分。

后来，Chicken Divers 被制作成视觉小说，并于2009年12月（29日至31日）举行的 Comiket 77 上发布。遗憾的是，这个版本充满了漏洞。

2010年7月30日，它在 Chronicles 01 中重新出版，并与资料集 MUV-LUV ALTERNATIVE LD3 Code：Rebellion 捆绑发售。添加了语音并提升了制作水准。

Rain Dancers 是一个发生在1995年11月的短篇故事。它详细描述了欧洲联合部队使用全新的测试型 EF-2000 Typhoons，通过从 BETA 的控制下夺回意大利部分地区，从而在欧洲建立立足点的一部分行动。

v32759.title: 君がいた季節 ～Primary～
v32759.originalDescription: Maejima Masaki is an aspiring photographer presented with an opportunity to study under a world famous photographer, due to a photo he took of one of the 4 Isumi sisters with whom he is close to which managed to attract attention. However, he must make a choice of whether he wishes to pursue that opportunity or not.
v32759.description:
● 概要 ●
主人公和青梅竹马的她在一个月前刚刚顺利成为恋人。
与此同时，为了实现长久以来的梦想……成为职业摄影师……
一个或许能在现代摄影第一人的工作室里修行的机会降临了。
然而……那个工作室在纽约！
如果自己去了纽约，她该怎么办呢？
好不容易得来的两人时光，难道仅仅一个月就要结束了吗？
是“梦想”还是“她”？这个选择就交给你了！
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
与现有的游戏有所不同，本作品“一开始就有女朋友！”。
本作品的主旨就是逼迫玩家做出“是‘梦想’还是‘她’？”的终极选择。
如果是各位会选哪一个呢？又为何会这样选呢？
对于你选择的道路，她们会如何回应呢？
这务必请用你自己的双眼去见证！

游戏系统非常简单！
只需从地图上选择目的地，在之后发生的事件中从选项里选择喜欢的回答即可！

但是，请不要忘记，那将成为决定你未来的重要关键。

v14.originalDescription:
In the school the three people met. Their relation had been changed in the season, and turned into three love stories.

Makoto has been admiring a girl he has seen on the train. That girl is Kotonoha Katsura, and he even managed to take a photo of her with his cell phone. Due to new seating in his class, he ends up next to Sekai Saionji, a nosy, but sweet and sincere girl. As she snoops for his cell phone while talking to him, she discovers his crush and vows to help him until Kotonoha agrees to go out with him. When Sekai finally gets them together, she realizes her own feelings after finding out that the person Kotonoha liked was, in fact, Makoto. While waiting for her train next to Makoto, who was waiting for Kotonoha, she has him talking about how he can repay her for all of her help. Before leaving for her train, she kisses him and cries when she boards the way home. Kotonoha happily arrives for her date with Makoto shortly after. With all three main characters carrying different expressions on their faces, the story begins.

v183.title: 鬼哭街 - The Cyber Slayer
v183.originalDescription:
A tale of revenge set in future Shanghai, where crime syndicates and cyber-warriors rule the city.

The schools of martial arts can be largely divided into two styles - Waijia, the external schools that concentrate solely on the development of speed, strength, and powerful forms and techniques - and Neijia, those that use control of breathing and blood flow to master the internal energy - qi - that flows through the body's meridians. Because of these methodological differences, the two styles have vied time and again for supremacy.

Although practitioners of Waijia were far greater in number, in the end not one of them could stand up to a warrior who had truly mastered the secrets of Neijia.  For centuries, this was the unchallenged law of the martial arts world. However, the advent of cybernetics changed everything. Freed from the yoke of their physical limitations, Waijia schools discovered an entirely new world of possibility. The Neijia schools that had reigned over the martial world with their secret techniques, suddenly found themselves obsolete.

In this age where technology is changing the face of combat, heirs to the ancient martial traditions have developed anti-cyborg techniques for the sole purpose of defeating cyborgs with one's bare hands - at great cost to the wielder. 

Kong Taoluo, one such master and former assassin in the Qingyun Society, returns to Shanghai from a year in recovery after being betrayed by the syndicate and assumed dead. Discovering the horrible truth of what has happened to his sister during his absence; Taoluo swears an oath of vengeance and sets out to murder those responsible.
v183.description:
我是将一切赌在这一刀上的修罗
错误的未来，某人做出了错误选择的世界。

身心皆被怒火烧尽的涛罗，手中执起了复仇之剑。

——仇人共有五人。

将各个毫不逊色、凶恶无比的赛博格武艺者们一个接一个地血祭，孤高的剑鬼驰骋在魔都上海的夜暗中。

v23516.title: 东京时笼
v23516.originalDescription:
Spring 2018. 
Kyosuke Sakurai—you—awaken in the city of Shibuya, Tokyo, oddly quiet and devoid of its bustle.

Nobody is around. The only exception is the group of eight childhood friends which you used to be part of.

As the group gathers in the city's famous scramble crossing, a blood-red message flashes on a nearby electronic billboard.

"I am dead. Who killed me?"

If this world is similar to the Chronos Worlds that had emerged in the past, there is only one way out—to find the one causing this strange phenomenon and kill them.
v23516.description:
《东京时笼》是一款堪称“VR游戏史上最耐玩”的选择式多结局游戏。
偌大的涩谷竟只剩下包括主角在内的8个人。他们为何会来到此处，又如何才能逃离。此等离奇现象又是因何而起。
玩家将化身为主角——樱井响介，突破层层迷雾，逃离空寂无人的涩谷。

【游戏买点】
■文字冒险游戏×VR的超凡进化
总游戏时间长达15小时，耐玩性十足。游戏会根据玩家的选择而迎来不同结局。

■哭湿无数头显的超催泪剧情
玩家真实感想：“买了Oculus之后，我试了很多款游戏，但没几款能让我满意的。但这款游戏颠覆了这一印象。刚上手的时候就被它精美的画面惊艳到了，但玩到后面就会发现剧情的质量完全凌驾在画面之上。”

■VR独有的游戏体验
360°超视角片头片尾影像，外加与女主角们的超亲密互动，为玩家带来VR独有的极致故事体验。

【游戏背景】
1988年。
"在俄罗斯莫斯科州的巴拉希哈市，有个十三岁的男孩和他的母亲一起失踪了。"
这起普通的失踪事件，却因一年后巴拉希哈市近郊森林中一名半老男子的出现而变得扑朔迷离。因为这名男子声称自己就是那个失踪的男孩。此人声称“自己和母亲被困在了一个世界里”，“母亲死后，自己才得以返回原来的世界”。
而DNA鉴定的结果也表明他确实是当年失踪的男孩。从此，这一事件就被称作了“巴拉希哈事件”。
某位学者指出，这与阿加莎·克里斯蒂离奇消失的11天等事件相同，共通点都是人类突然失踪。
后来这一现象就被冠以了“柯罗诺斯世界”的名字。



【游戏剧情】
2018年，春。
一睁眼，樱井响介便发现自己来到了一个寂静反常的涩谷。环顾周围，却不见一个人影。而后发现这里除了包含自己在内的8个童年玩伴，竟空无一人。
正当他们聚在涩谷的全向十字路口讨论该如何逃脱这一诡异的世界时，巨型幕墙上突然显示出了一则血红色的信息。
“我死了。凶手是谁？”
答案已经很明显了。
如果这里真的就是“柯罗诺斯世界”……那逃离此间的方法只有一个。
——找到那个引发这一离奇现象的凶手，并将其杀掉。

v26987.title: 白日梦的构想图
aliases: Cyanotype Daydream -The Girl Who Dreamed the World-
The girl who's called the world
v26987.description:
海斗醒来时，发现自己失去了记忆。
他不知道自己身处于何处，甚至连自己是谁都想不起来。 
白色的房间里，唯一的家具就是两张床。
除了海斗之外，房间里还有一位机器般毫无感情的少女——世凪。 
海斗被告知，自己的梦正被记录下来，这份纪录能拯救世凪。
而这一切，都是失去记忆前的自己安排好的。
他决定与世凪一同潜入梦的世界。 
当三个梦皆迎来悲伤的结局之际，海斗也将重拾过去的记忆。 

一位被称为“世界”的少女——
这是一个将视觉小说的系统和故事构造巧妙结合的纯爱故事。
故事的主角是一位青年与一位少女。
游戏的最初，玩家将以随机顺序体验三个故事。

迎来和三位少女的“离别”后，故事线将收束，并最终揭开那一位少女的真相。
诚邀您体验这款牵动了无数日本玩家心灵的纯爱故事。



人类开始做相同的梦了。
　　
某晚是女学生与教师的不伦之恋——
　　
某晚是剧作家与女演员跨越身份的恋爱故事——

又某晚是不登校的少年与教育实习生的淡淡初恋——
　　
人类开始反复做着这三种梦。
　　
为何全人类会持续做着相同的梦呢。
　　
这是被称为“世界”的一位少女的故事。
　　
case-1:

有岛芳(有島芳)是45岁的兼职讲师。

有岛曾经以成为小说家为目标，
但在大学时代遇到了名为波多野秋房的前辈，
被对方在笔力与为人能力上的差距狠狠打击，
从而放弃了那个梦想。

如今他一边承受着身为编辑的妻子的蔑视目光，
一边过着毫无变化的日子。

某天，有岛大学时代的研讨课教授过世。
有岛在告别式上，发现了自己任职学园的学生身影。

那名女学生·波多野凛(波多野凛)，
正是大学时代从有岛手中夺走笔杆的波多野秋房的女儿。

以在告别式上相遇为契机，有岛与凛开始在图书馆交谈。

“我想读你写的文章。”

凛对有岛抛出的这句话，正是妻子曾经说过的。

对学生的背德恋心，与对冰冷夫妻关系的死心。
在其夹缝中，有岛再次提笔，开始书写。

case-2：

威廉·莎士比亚(ウィリアム・シェイクスピア)与双目失明的父亲两人经营着酒馆。

威尔拥有“完全记忆”的特长。

在店里站着，记住所有从各地聚集而来的客人的谈话，
以此作为题材编造故事，暗中卖给伦敦的剧团。

即使加上那笔收入，一边照顾父亲一边维持的生活依然捉襟见肘。

无法让父亲吃上像样的饭菜，在父亲日渐衰弱之中，
父亲久违地吃到了某种食物。

那是当时在英国最高级的食材鹿肉。
威尔为了让父亲吃上饭，潜入某位贵族的庭院，
却轻而易举地被抓住了。

被捕获的威尔面前出现了两名贵族，
奥莉薇娅·蓓丽(オリヴィア・ベリー)与哈洛德·斯宾瑟(ハロルド・スペンサー)。

身为房主的斯宾瑟当即要处刑威尔，
但奥莉薇娅提出将威尔作为奴隶赎买。

奥莉薇娅曾担任自己剧团的团长，买过威尔的剧本，
是察觉到其才华的舞台演员。

当时正值伊丽莎白王朝戏剧的全盛期。
女性被严禁登上舞台。

但奥莉薇娅女扮男装，暗中登上了舞台。

女性担任团长的剧团。
这样的剧团不可能留住优秀的演员，
奥莉薇娅的剧团里尽是些不合群的演员。

奥莉薇娅向威尔提议，为自己的剧团写剧本，
只要让剧团存续下去就饶他一命。

威尔一边打理酒馆，一边开始担任奥莉薇娅剧团的驻团作家。

case-3：

饴井康奈(飴井カンナ)是蛰居在车库里的不登校儿童。
把一辆动不了的房车当成了自己的房间。

那辆车里，装满了与已故母亲的回忆。
失去母亲后，康奈找不到去学校的意义。

母亲还在时，父亲改变之前，三人一起度过的时间——
对康奈而言，那辆动不了的房车，就是快乐过去的本身。

就在某天，教育实习生桃之内李(桃ノ内すもも)造访了车库。

“来学校嘛。”

即使无视了这声呼唤，李也没有退缩。
面对不乱自己步调的李，康奈感到烦躁，赶走了李。

那天晚上，在房车里睡着的康奈
感受到了怀念的摇晃与温暖，醒了过来。

“妈妈……？”

回过神来，康奈发现自己正被李抱着。
车正在行驶。

在完全无法掌握状况时车停了下来，有人从驾驶座下了车。

发现车被偷走的康奈，趁盗窃犯·松风梓姬(松風梓姫)不备踩下了油门。

无证的康奈驾驶的车一阵暴走后，停了下来。
从燃烧的据点里走出来的梓姬从康奈手中夺过了方向盘。

“我差点被你的无证驾驶撞到。往大了说就是爱车被报废了，住处也被烧了。”
“要是嫌麻烦的话，就暂时窝藏我吧。”

自称废品猎人的梓姬，向康奈提出了条件。

善于见机行事的李，没有放过偶然在场的这个好机会。

“那我也来！”
“要是康奈同学不来学校的话，我今天看到的事情说不定会全告诉别人哦！我嘴巴可是很松的！”

露出坏笑的李。
冷笑的梓姬。

康奈寂静的日常轻易地崩塌了。

退路被断绝，被两位年长女性抓住缰绳的康奈的新生活开始了。
v26987.originalDescription:
Kaito wakes to find himself in a strange room with no memories of who he is or how he got there. The only other people around are a quiet white-haired girl and their overseer, Izumo. As three separate stories unfold around him, Kaito begins to wake up to the truth of this world, and his own role in it. And it's all connected to the strange, silent girl named Yonagi...

CASE-1 Hatano Rin
Arishima Kaoru is a 45-year old part-time teacher, stuck in an unhappy marriage and living a life of tedium after having long given up on his dreams of becoming a novelist.

One day, he finds out that a student of his, Hatano Rin, is none other than the daughter of the writer he once admired above all others.

As the relationship between the two deepens, Arishima grapples with immoral impulses toward this younger girl. But even as his life spirals and his marriage crumbles further, he picks up his pen and starts to write again.

CASE-2 Olivia Berry
Our stage is set in the heyday of Elizabethan theater, a time where women were prohibited from acting on stage.

A young William Shakespeare runs a failing pub together with his blind father. Blessed with a perfect memory, he uses the tales his patrons tell as inspiration for the plays he writes to earn extra income.

When his fate ends up in the hands of one Olivia Berry, a woman with a fiery personality and a fierce sense of purpose, Will finds himself in the midst of a real-life drama of his own.

CASE-3 Momonouchi Sumomo
Amei Kanna is a college dropout who spends his time holed up in his dad's garage trying to fix his late mother's old, beat up camper van.

But when a young teacher-in-training shows up out of the blue, she provides the spark to get him out of his mancave and into the world again.

Together with the self-styled scrap hunter Azuki, they set out on an adventure to find the special place Kanna's mother left behind in a drawing.

As Halley's comet streaks across the sky, the three share an unforgettable summer of sweet beginnings and bitter ends.

---

After experiencing these stories and bidding farewell to them, the threads converge in the truth of one girl.

v7623.originalDescription:
The protagonist boards the ultra-luxurious sleeper express train "Magic Arrow" running through a certain country in Eastern Europe at the beginning of the 20th century. However, they get involved in a major accident on the train and are presumed dead. Yet, they somehow leap through time and space, returning to the past, several hours before the accident occurred.

为此，必须借助魔女女孩的力量。

然而，一旦少女耗尽了魔力，就无法维持从过去到未来的时间与空间，列车将会爆炸。

v28307.description:
选择某个人，就必定会伤害另一个人……
描写主人公·鸣海孝之成长的真实爱情故事

主人公·鸣海孝之是白陵大附属柊学园的三年级学生。
毕业临近却无法决定未来的出路，
怀着模糊的焦虑感，随波逐流地度日。

某天，既是同班同学又是女性朋友的速濑水月，
邀请他和好友平慎二一起去夏日祭，
并介绍了水月的好友凉宫遥给他认识。
那个女孩，是他以前曾见过的那个内向的女孩。
多亏了水月想方设法努力让遥融入他们三人的圈子，
孝之也试图友善地对待遥，
但不知为何遥却试图躲避孝之，让他渐渐感到焦躁。

后来，孝之被叫到学园背后的山丘上，
在那里等待他的遥向他告白，说喜欢他。
无法抗拒这个内向女孩鼓起勇气说出的一句话，
他便顺其自然地开始和她交往了。


果不其然，和遥的对话变得十分生硬。
然而随着时间的推移，两人的距离也逐渐拉近了。
然后，不知不觉中被遥的纯真所打动，孝之也开始纯粹地爱上了她。

就在这样的某一天……

v16583.title: The Human Reignition Project
v16583.originalDescription:
In the near future, mankind remains much the same as it is in the modern day. There are no flying cars. There are no robots; no incredible new world order. However, as is natural with the passage of time, society has changed. Technology and modern conveniences  have become so widespread and accessible that just about anyone can easily fill their lives with luxurious simplicity. As a result, the general workings of modern life have changed. Many formerly busy systems and occupations have become obsolete or entirely digital. In drastic contrast with the size and population of cities, birth rates have long since hit a plateau and continue to drop slowly. In a general sense, the modern world is slowly dying. 

One man, a relic of an older time, forms a small group that seeks to change that.

v19775.title: Episicava Vol.1
v19775.originalDescription:
One day, the face of the Earth was changed permanently when it came into contact with a mysterious force known as the “Alpha Nebula”. With it, humans developed various unexplainable abilities, and divided themselves based on those traits.

The main factions include: The Tonitrui, the Excedente, the Praecantator, the Permuto, and the Northmanni. All have their own set of unique abilities that came with infamous Alpha Nebula collision, with the exception of the Northmanni who remain largely unchanged.

Among these races however, existed a special group of people who managed to retain all the other race’s abilities. They were a very powerful, but small isolated group of people, called “emulators”.

Arin Arlento was one of these people, living in a remote village with his grandfather and other emulators. All was going peacefully, until it was attacked by the Northmanni empire, who slaughtered his entire race and kidnapped his childhood friend, Aria.

Being the only other survivor, Arin escaped into the Northmanni empire, hiding and plotting his revenge. That is until finding out that Aria is still alive, and is being experimented on by the Northmanni.

Resentful of the society that took everything away from him, Arin begins his quest to retrieve his friend, and exact retribution on those who destroyed all that he held dear.

It’s one misguided man against the world.
v19775.description:
One day, the face of the Earth was changed permanently when it came into contact with a mysterious force known as the “Alpha Nebula”. With it, humans developed various unexplainable abilities, and divided themselves based on those traits.

The main factions include: The Tonitrui, the Excedente, the Praecantator, the Permuto, and the Northmanni. All have their own set of unique abilities that came with infamous Alpha Nebula collision, with the exception of the Northmanni who remain largely unchanged.

Among these races however, existed a special group of people who managed to retain all the other race’s abilities. They were a very powerful, but small isolated group of people, called “emulators”.

Arin Arlento was one of these people, living in a remote village with his grandfather and other emulators. All was going peacefully, until it was attacked by the Northmanni empire, who slaughtered his entire race and kidnapped his childhood friend, Aria.

Being the only other survivor, Arin escaped into the Northmanni empire, hiding and plotting his revenge. That is until finding out that Aria is still alive, and is being experimented on by the Northmanni.

Resentful of the society that took everything away from him, Arin begins his quest to retrieve his friend, and exact retribution on those who destroyed all that he held dear.

It’s one misguided man against the world.

v22896.title: Cautionary Tale
aliases: If in Your Dreams; the Flood
v22896.originalDescription:
A parable about agency, and how three people choose to navigate it. Developed for NaNoRenO2018 with a team of around 50 people, three games in one engine.

The three tales, each unique in their own right:

Beyond Yesterday's Grasp

"When she is given a full scholarship to a prestigious boarding school, Alex Kartha feels hopeful for the first time since the accident that killed her parents and took her forearm. However, she soon realizes that old challenges cannot be easily ignored. Will you solve the mystery of Artemis Hall? Or will you turn away from your duty and value your life?"

Let Go.

"Today is like any other Winter day. Snow's on the ground, there's a chill in the air, and Eli is about to confess to his childhood friend. Terrified of rejection, he practices his lines underneath a tree in the city, preparing for whatever may come. There's nothing to be afraid of - he's known her forever, right? But unbeknownst to him, something feels off… Hasn't he done this before?"

If in Your Dreams; the Flood

"The Flood. That's all Ophelia can think about. Ever since she was a young child she dreamed of the water, slowly making its way, higher and higher. Now she's about to turn eighteen, and the flood will soon overtake her. In a desperate attempt to avoid her fate, she stays awake throughout the night, wandering the late Seattle cityscape. It's there that she meets an unfamiliar friend."

v26922.title: LoveSick Darlings
v26922.originalDescription:
LoveSick Darlings is a visual novel focused on creating and testing the limits of teenage relationships. It explores friendship, high school life, love, and everything in between. The game plays with tropes and expectations found in romance visual novels and dating sims by undercutting this often-romanticized period of everyone's lives with a realistic edge.

Syd, our protagonist, moved into town at the start of this year. He’s become best friends with a girl called Maisy who lives on the same street with him – and by extension, her friends too. Over time he has become a natural part of this diverse group of friends. The school year is growing closer to its end, and Syd’s friends are pressuring him into asking his crush out to the formal at the end of the year. Will he be able to do it? How will his friendships hold up around him as he makes these big decisions towards the end of this high school year? And what if someone in his own group of friends sees him as more than... "just a friend"? It's up to you to make these hard decisions and deal with these situations as Syd to decide the fate of him and all of his friends.

And that is where our story begins.

v31089.title: Netghost
v31089.originalDescription:
Ian Newfield is a talented grey-hat hacker who works as a high-ranking cyber security engineer at Daikon Industries, an Information Technology company that is part of a shadowy branch of a larger conglomerate of corporations. His job is to type in the letters and numbers that make up the encryption for top-secret software his company is hired to guard, details of which he knows nothing about.

Ian basks in a frail sense of financial security - that is, until he is told by his boss that their product was cracked and posted anonymously online. Now, Ian is tasked with finding the leaker among his peers by using any method at his disposal, in a workplace where anyone, from his fellow coders to the janitor of the building, could be the perpetrator...

Meanwhile, Ian's sister, Vivie, is confined to a hospital bed for years now, ill from a bone-wasting disease, and Ian works overtime to cover all her expenses and keep her happy. Despite his generous salary at Daikon, their situation has them living from paycheck to paycheck, and their objective of going for an expensive, experimental treatment for Vivie seems way out of reach.

With Ian's earnest effort to uncover the elusive Daikon leaker, his life and career begin to converge with the criminal underworld of Tri-State City. As fate would have it, opportunities rise for Ian to cut corners and make big money, money that could, perhaps, help find a cure for his sister. An age-old question is brought forth: 

Does crime pay?

原画请来了以《奸染》系列闻名的Gentle佐佐木氏，通过描绘连口水和鼻涕都流下来的强烈高潮脸，表现出更能让人撸的淫荡H场景！！
对“黑裤袜的美腿”有着无尽讲究，瞄准烦恼的色情情境值得注目！

v2107.originalDescription: Seiji is a permanent part-timer. He has been dating a girl, Ai, for two years and he is now thinking about marrying her. But one day, he has a traffic accident and breaks his leg. Like this, he is hospitalized.... "I'll visit you every day," Ai says it with a smile. But their relationship gradually changes after his hospitalization.... A real estate broker who hit Seiji. A guy at the same hospital room. A handsome doctor in charge of him. A co-worker at his shop. A nurse who is his ex-girlfriend. Various people cut in on Seiji and Ai's relationship.... Will they be able to overcome it and keep their relationship...?
v2107.description:
在床上不断积聚的是疑念与焦虑……
主人公“中村诚二(中村誠二)”是在披萨店打工3年的自由职业者。
虽然对没有固定工作感到担忧，但工作很有成就感，
而且和同为打工伙伴的恋人“藤泽爱(藤沢あい)”的感情也很顺利，
过着一帆风顺的日子。和爱的交往也到了2年，
正当开始意识到结婚的时候，突然的不幸袭击了诚二!!
因为自己的疏忽而发生交通事故的诚二腿部骨折，被迫
住院了。“我每天都会来探病的!!”
看着爱露出笑容的样子，诚二想着“正好可以好好休息一下”，
但以这次住院为契机，两人周围的状况
向着意想不到的方向发展下去……。
“事故对方的不动产经纪人”
“同病房住院患者中那个讨人厌的男人”
“帅气且拥有天才技术的担当医生”
“一直默默守护着两人的打工前辈”
然后……
“作为护士工作的前女友”
各种各样的人仿佛要撕裂诚二和爱的羁绊一般，
介入到两人之间。
克服接连袭来的困难，两人能够将爱情贯彻到底吗……。

v2273.title: 操り孕ませDreamNote
v2273.originalDescription: Masaya is a uni student, who works as a home tutor part-time. One day, he receives a parcel. That is a notebook. He frowns when he reads a letter, which is also in the parcel. It says, "If you write a girl's name in the notebook, you'll be able to control her as you like." He thinks it is ridiculous at first, but he decides to give it a try. The name he writes is Yumi, his student.... As a result, it comes true, and he shags with her. "This notebook is proved to be real. I can now have fun with it...."
v2273.description:
一边上大学，一边做家庭教师兼职来维持生计的須田雅也。
某天，他家收到了寄件人不明的包裹。
包裹里装的是一本毫无特别之处的笔记本。
但是，读了附带的纸上所写文章的雅也皱起了眉头
“只要在笔记本上写下女性的名字，那个女人就会任你摆布……你说？”
荒谬可笑，肯定是某个人的恶作剧吧……
虽然这么想，但对日常感到无聊的雅也，
决定以玩乐的感觉在笔记本上写下名字。
那个名字，是他担任家庭教师的高梨優美……
果然，写在笔记本上的事成为了现实，雅也夺走了優美的处女之身。
“这本笔记本，是真的吗……如果是的话，事情好像会变得很有趣啊”

v2655.title: 姦染 ～淫欲の連鎖～
v2655.originalDescription: Extracurricular club activities are the norm for Japanese schools, but an all-night movie event scheduled at school and in August still sounds strange/unusual, especially considering the tiny size of the Movie Research Club (merely six students). And indeed, the two teachers supporting this novelty have hidden motives/objectives, although also the six students themselves chose to participate in the event for personal/secret reasons...
v2655.description:
●强○、凌○、轮○、乱交场景满载！！
被沦为淫欲俘虏而失去理性的男人们袭击的女主角们。
呼救声也无法传达，被侵犯与蹂躏。
然而不久后，通过性交她们自身也受到感染，惨叫逐渐变化为愉悦的声音。
接着，随着淫欲的驱使走向乱交……
事件CG的绝大部分都是汁水满满的强○、轮○、乱交场景！

●主人公成为感染者去凌○女主角们的路线也有！？
主人公一边从感染者手中保护女主角，一边为了打破现状而奋斗。
但是，根据路线的不同，在游戏初期主人公也有可能最先被感染……
成为感染者的主人公，随着自身欲望的驱使，将女主角们一个接一个地凌○……
主人公将如何去强○女主角们呢？？

●逼近故事的真相？切换系统！
基本上故事以主人公视角进行，但在通关一次故事后，部分选项中，
可以选择其他角色的视角。
能够得知主人公不在时发生的事件详情，
并目睹在以主人公视角游玩时无法得知的冲击性事实！！

■故事
“私立凉陵学园”2年级的主人公加藤泰之，正暗恋着另一个班级的山岸优。
为了接近她而加入了她所属的“电影研究部”，却迟迟无法传达自己的心意……
然而，暑假期间企划了两天一夜的电影研究部合宿，加藤怀揣着某种淡淡的期待参加了合宿。
接着，电影研究部的6名学生与2名教师，各自怀揣着对这次合宿隐藏的心意迎来了夜晚……

■登场角色
●加藤 泰之
本作的主人公。
就读于本作舞台“私立凉陵学园”的学生。
2年级。
暗恋着同一所学校、不同班级的山岸优。
加入了“电影研究部”，入部的契机是
被好友竹内邀请，以及得知山岸优也要入部。
对电影几乎没有相关知识，顶多在电视上播放时打发时间看个程度。
像同龄男孩一样对性欲、性行为充满兴趣，但是个处男。
学业成绩中等。
品行算不上不良，但也算不上认真。
期待在这次电影研究部的合宿中，能不能和山岸优变得更加亲密。

●山岸 优
本作的主要女主角之一。
“私立凉陵学园”2年级。
与主人公同年级的不同班级。
父亲是政治家，母亲是电视剧女演员。
父亲作为政治家的女儿，母亲作为女性特质，对她进行了严格的管教。
本人对此乖乖顺从。也就是所谓的千金大小姐。
虽然是千金大小姐，但没有高傲的地方，性格开朗，和谁都能友好相处。
回到家也大多是一个人，为了排遣寂寞而加入了社团。
选择电影研究部的理由是，能看很多电影。
作为母亲管教的一环，在学习古典芭蕾，所以身体很柔软。

●佐伯 瞳
本作的主要女主角之一。
2年级。
与主人公同班的班长，也是学生会长。
不容许任何细微的失误，讨厌不洁/下流的事物，认为男女交往应当纯洁，
有着稍微有些洁癖般的认真。
因为某个契机对主人公抱有好感，但由于自己的性格作祟而无法说出口。
得知主人公加入了“电影研究部”后，追随他加入了社团。
顺便一提，她非常讨厌主人公的损友竹内，因为他很下流，一开口就尽说些猥琐的事。

●新道理沙(新道 リサ)
“私立凉陵学园”的理科教师。
“电影研究部”的顾问。
特征是衬衫快要被撑破的巨乳。
男生们对她的美貌抱有羡慕，又因为上课时的举止而将她视为严厉、严格的老师而有些畏惧。
这次电影研究部的合宿是理沙企划的，但是……
那背后是否有着别的企图……？

●五十岚 朋美
次要女主角之一。
“私立凉陵学园”3年级。
主人公、优等人的学姐。
是主人公和竹内的好友，正在和前辈田中交往。
和优是老朋友。
性格内敛且温吞，容易被气氛左右，优柔寡断。
在主人公看来虽然是年长者，却很不可靠。
和田中一起加入了“电影研究部”。
个子虽小，但意外地有胸。

v2916.originalDescription:
Kansen 2 (like the first episode) takes place during the initial outbreak of the Unknown virus epidemic, but the protagonists here have a much harder lot because they are stuck in the middle of a contaminated city immediately after its destruction by a mysterious cataclysm.

Stalked by hordes of infected maniacs, Hiroshi Ookura and his friends seek safety inside a mostly intact shopping mall, but madness and death are everywhere...
v2916.description:
■故事
协和学园的二年级生“大仓浩”与“速水爱丽丝(速水 ありす)”两人，虽然对彼此稍微有些在意，但关系仍是毫无进展的好朋友。
大仓等人在修业旅行时造访的夏日千台市，突然遭遇了地震。

————奇迹般毫发无伤获救的大仓与速水，以及同班同学“小林裕树”三人，
为了寻求帮助而在崩塌的城市中徘徊。

然而，他们在那里看到的是被淫欲与暴力支配的人们！！
大仓等人遭到他们的袭击，被逼得逃进了购物中心，但是……

■登场角色
●速水 爱丽丝
主人公的同班同学。
和主人公关系很好，交往起来简直像男性朋友一样。
学业虽然不算特别优秀，但头脑灵活，是个内心坚强的女孩。
很高兴能和大仓上演夫妻相声，或是互相调侃。

●神宫寺 摩耶
大企业“神宫司普莱伍德”的大小姐，就读于名门女校“白百合女子学园”的女孩。
对那些冲着自家品牌而来的人们感到厌烦，
除了住在千台市的祖父和爱犬约翰之外，不对任何人敞开心扉。
曾多次目击主人公等人（主人公、速水、小林）三人关系融洽地玩耍，感到十分羡慕。

●安西美纪(安西 みき)
外表温顺，和主人公一样，有着无法对陷入困境的人置之不理的性格。
为了和恋人约会，在前往格兰德城的途中遭遇灾害，从而与主人公等人相遇。
毕业于医疗系的专门学校，正在做医疗事务的兼职。

●长崎千寻
就读于千台市女校“青芭学园”的女学生。因为一心不想输给男生，而在锻炼身体。
隶属于排球部，是个运动全能的人。
讨厌男人。
对男性态度冷酷、冷淡且具有攻击性。

●大仓浩 主人公
地方学园“县立协和学园”的二年级生。
性格爱管闲事，无法对陷入困境的人置之不理。
和同班同学、同班的“速水”“小林”是好朋友小组。
经常三人一起行动。
和“速水”是会上演夫妻相声的关系，但并非恋人。

●小林裕树
和主人公、速水同班。
外表中性，是个可爱的男孩子。
有些内向。
和主人公、速水关系很好，三人经常黏在一起。
因为那副容貌，在女生中很受欢迎。
不管本人是否愿意，
他都在主人公和速水那永无止境的夫妻相声中担任吐槽的“吐槽”角色。

●菅生 竜也
个人经营运输业的男性。
碰巧在造访的千台市遭遇灾害。
性格粗鲁且下流。
在目睹了灾害及其后的惨状（感染者们做出的异常痴态）的过程中，
他心中的疯狂开始萌芽。

●鹤田 直美
自卫队队员。
为了确认是否有幸存者，单独进入格兰德城并与主人公等人汇合。
以锻炼得十分强健的身体为武器对抗感染者们，但是……

v2927.originalDescription: Tatsuya has a wife, Chizuru. They used to love each other, love passionately. But, their love gradually becomes colder and colder.... One day, when he is on his way home, he sees Chizuru walking with a man. He stops them, and asks them what's going on. Another man stops their quarrel, and tells them that he is a boss of a swapping club. He gets interested in it, and visits the club room with Chizuru...
v2927.description:
许多夫妻之间都有各种各样的问题，而本作的主人公蒲生达也，也正被夫妻间的巨大问题沉甸甸地压在身上。回想起来，他追到了在大学时代朋友们中很受欢迎的千鹤，结婚当初每天每晚，甚至相爱到天明，觉得两人的感情会直到永远……因为在最初职场上的成绩被寄予厚望，被派往整体业绩不佳的地区后，工作无论如何都无法顺利进行……每天的疲惫以及投入到工作上的时间，这些东西一点一点地挤进了他与千鹤之间……如今，两人已经变成了几乎互相不怎么说话的状态。明明对千鹤以外的人都不屑一顾，最近却被电车窗外看到的一位女性夺去了目光，达也对自己发生的变化也感到无奈。

走得双腿像棍子一样僵硬的时候，正想着这些事，却在街上看到了千鹤的身影。而且，不是一个人，而是和一个男人在一起！！达也任凭怒火驱使冲了进去。正当向惊讶的千鹤和语无伦次的男人逼问时，一位女性出言劝阻达也……那是前几天自己看入迷的那位女性。

摩诃罗阇矢泽(マハラジャ矢沢)，以及自称是其妻子的两人说他们运营着「交换俱乐部·蔷薇之恋」。听着摩诃罗阇矢泽极力主张有性功能障碍的自己，至今仍与妻子美姬关系融洽也是多亏了交换，看着美姬那充满诱惑的艳丽微笑，达也心中不断涌起兴趣：“如果能和那么可爱的女性做爱，夫妻关系也能变好的话”。然后，一边想着其他参与者的事情，达也带着千鹤前往了俱乐部会场。

v3230.originalDescription:
Four years have passed since the terrible events narrated in Kansen 1 and 2, and the terrifying plague which depopulated the Tohoku region of Japan has been reduced to a mere (bad) memory, thanks to drastic quarantine measures coupled with an effective vaccine.

But the Unknown virus is not dead yet and soon, very soon, an unescapable doom will fall upon Wataru Ayase and his family and friends, trapping them inside the "Hell on Earth" madhouse which originally was their home city, Tokyo...
v3230.description:
距那时已过4年……首都「东京」被淫欲的漩涡吞噬！
超人气系列第3弹以下载版登场！！

大崩坏——首都、秩序、人际关系……一切都在崩塌。

■故事
『UNKNOWN−LV4』引发的大灾害四年后。
随着Anti：UNKNOWN−LV4的完成，那股威胁逐渐远去，
四年的时光，正试图将『那起』事件从人们的记忆中抹去。
尤其是在远离事件发生地东北的东京。

在东京土生土长的人，以及并非如此的人。
在各种人、各种思绪交错的大都市中，『那股』威胁正在逼近。

改变了形态、变得愈发凶恶的『UNKNOWN−LV4』，不露形迹、无声无息地悄然逼近。
为了寻求更多的猎物——

■登场角色
●绫濑航
主人公。
住在东京涩谷的极其普通的学生。
性格开朗，重视同伴，能察觉到他人的烦恼，并拥有体谅他人的温柔与感性。
只是，因为没有特别的才能和梦想，
感觉自己被多才多艺的周围朋友们抛在了后面，因而感到不安。
兴趣是「天体观测」，『绫濑涟』的义兄。

●神凪悠帆（CV：民安智惠）
主人公的青梅竹马兼同班同学。
学业成绩平平，但作为前途无量的游泳选手备受期待，
加上外貌出众，在学园内人气很高，是偶像般的存在。

●绫濑涟（CV：计名沙也香）
比主人公小一岁的义妹。
因为体弱多病，外出受到限制。
性格内敛文静。
跟曾是弦乐器演奏者的母亲学习小提琴，继承了母亲的遗物小提琴，十分珍惜。
似乎对总是关心体弱多病的自己的义兄航怀有淡淡的恋慕之情……。

●玛格丽塔·巴斯克斯·穗村(マルガリータ・バスクェス・穂村)（CV：川濑结月）
在暑假前突然转到航他们就读学园的混血少女。
父亲是西班牙裔的使馆工作人员，母亲是日本人。
与外表不同，拥有古风的日本人气质，因此讨厌现在的涩谷这座城市，以及在那里玩乐的同龄年轻人。
也有修习武道。

●久我山瑞树（CV：春日安）
航和悠帆的青梅竹马。
曾梦想成为歌手，但以某件事为契机退了学，与航等人变得疏远。
现在是混迹在涩谷的放纵年轻人群体中的一员。

v3602.title: 悪の女幹部「この私にオシオキだと!? ふざけるなっ！」
v3602.original: 悪の女幹部「この私にオシオキだと!? ふざけるなっ！」
aliases: 悪の女幹部「この私にオシオキだと!? ふざけるなっ！」
Aku no Onna Kanbu "Kono Watashi ni Oshioki da to!? Fuzakeruna!"
v3602.originalDescription:
Katsuma is just a henchman of his female bosses... Whenever he does battle against Silva Star, a superhero, he loses...

One day, when he has another battle against Silva Star, his bosses suddenly spring a trap on Katsuma and Silva Star. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself being taken care of by Maria, Silva Star's partner. Katsuma is attracted to her kindness... No, he just sleeps with her... However, he acquires a special power by sleeping with her...!

He soon decides to take revenge on his bosses...
v3602.description:
《恶之女干部》是2010年由マリゴールド的成人游戏品牌ルネ发售的18禁成人游戏。并也发售了以原作为基础的成人动画。
本稿将说明以下系列作品。
《恶之女干部》（2010年3月26日发售）
系列的第1部作品，描写了身处邪恶组织的主人公，对企图侵略地球的恶之女干部们的背叛与复仇的作品。
《恶之女干部 满月之夜》（2012年3月30日发售）
原作的增补修订版，追加了新篇章“度假村篇”以及系统等要素。

“下仆们，给我匍匐在我的面前吧”
时代是现代。为了保护地球免遭突然出现在月球上的王国“伟大·露娜利亚姆”的侵略，十五夜月见(十五夜つきみ)与十五夜 玛丽亚(十五夜まりあ)的正义姐妹女主角“银色巴斯塔”站了出来！

主人公胜马(カツマ)是G·露娜利亚姆的干部。
在女系国家G·露娜利亚姆，力量与阶级是由与生俱来的“月之纹章”决定的。
而纹章等级低下、为数不多的男性胜马，处于被女干部们随意驱使的立场。
被命令上战场就会被银色巴斯塔打败，回去就会被女干部们训斥。他过着这样的日子。

某天，在不知第几次与银色巴斯塔的直接对决途中，6名女干部出现，连同胜马一起将银色巴斯塔陷入了陷阱。
回过神来时，胜马在陌生的地方被银色巴斯塔的一半——十五夜 玛丽亚所照料。
玛丽亚也因受到伤害而解除了变身，被独自丢在了一边。
尽管是敌人，胜马被救了命的玛丽亚的温柔所吸引……并没有这种事，他想着不吃送上门的食物是男人的耻辱，将玛丽亚推倒了。

那时，通过与玛丽亚交合，胜马沉睡的能力觉醒了。
被称为特殊能力“纹章窃取”的这股力量，能够从让其高潮的对手那里夺走“月之纹章”。
在阶级由纹章等级决定的G·露娜利亚姆，能夺走对手纹章的这股力量的价值不可估量。

察觉到自己拥有的出色能力的胜马，立刻想到了对陷害自己的女干部们的复仇。
只要使用这股力量，就能让那些可恶的女干部们屈服……！
胜马哄骗了玛丽亚，约定今后为了正义在背后泄露情报。

一切都是为了实现计划……

v3851.title: 姦染4 ～The Day After～
v3851.originalDescription:
Most events in Kansen 4 take place "The Day After" the endings of Kansen 1 and 2, during the reclamation of the contaminated areas by the Japan Self-Defence Forces.

Daisuke Sendou just enjoys his school life with his classmates. One day, they go camping just before summer holiday (therefore escaping the initial outbreak of the Unknown virus epidemic), but... A cruel result is awaiting them there...
v3851.description:
>
『UNKNOWN−LV4』与军队的空袭。
逃过这两场灾难幸存下来的人们，在仅有的些许信息中，
畏惧着连大空袭都未能歼灭的感染者，持续着等待救援的日子。
仅仅几天前还和平生活的街道在一瞬间崩塌了。
仅仅几小时前还正常的人们变成了淫乱的野兽。
“下一个也许就轮到自己了”
看得见的恐怖，与看不见的恐怖向人们袭来。
被抛入疯狂的世界之时。
“现在”以及“今后”该如何挺过去呢？

■故事
连偶然逃过『那一天』的人们也一同吞噬的惨剧——
住在东北地区乡下小镇的主人公『仙道大介』，是梦想成为汽车与摩托车设计技师的适龄男孩。
同班同学且有着相同爱好的『镫真琴』，家挨着家的青梅竹马『能登屋梢』，
以及同样是同班同学，充满神秘感的『真坂绚』，与他一起度过着平凡普通的学园生活。
暑假将近的某天，仙道等人被『石乡冈翔』与『桐越冴子』这对学长学姐情侣邀请去『露营』，然后——
本该留下快乐回忆的他们，等待着的是无情的命运……。

■登场角色
●仙道大介
主人公。
因升学问题与父母关系有些不睦。
喜欢摩托车，擅长摆弄机械。
为了买摩托车而同时打着几份工。

●真坂绚
与仙道同班，成绩优秀，气质凛然的美少女。
但沉默寡言没有朋友，给人一种在班级里被孤立的印象。
并非讨厌人，而是因为某些事情封闭了内心。
实际上的她相当爱照顾人。

●镫真琴
仙道的同班同学。
性格爽朗像男孩子，与男生女生都能一视同仁地交往。
父亲经营着汽车修理厂，受此影响喜欢上了摩托车。
因此与仙道很聊得来，放学后几乎每天都待在一起。
因为这个原因，有传言说两人是不是在交往，
但本人完全没有那个打算。

●能登屋梢
住在仙道家隔壁的青梅竹马。
两人都在二楼有房间，隔着院子进行对话。
在熟人面前表现得很开朗，但基本上怕生，有胆小懦弱的一面。
在仙道看来是妹妹般的存在，在能登屋看来他像是哥哥般的关系。

●桐越冴子
仙道的学姐，与石乡冈交往的年长女性。
拥有妖艳的气质，在地方上是罕见地精通时尚的人。

●石乡冈翔
仙道的学长，如同哥哥般的存在。
在三班倒的精密电机零件制造厂工作。
摆弄好不容易买来的二手车是日常功课。
正在与冴子交往。

v4115.title: オンリーワン2 ～召しませ 恵のすぃ～とエプロン～
v4115.original: オンリーワン2 ～召しませ 恵のすぃ～とエプロン～
aliases: オンリーワン2 ～召しませ 恵のすぃ～とエプロン～
Only One 2 ~Meshimase Megumi no Sweet Apron~
v4115.originalDescription: Main character finishes chef training in Europe and returns back to his home town. His parents die in a traffic accident leaving him a western-style restaurant "Hidden Rabbit". He's good at cooking, but he totally fails as a manager, so he calls a female childhood friend to take this position. Alas, she's no good as a waitress. They find a cheerful waitress to chase their dreams together.
v4115.description:
接到父母讣报的安藤渡，中止了在欧洲的厨师修行，时隔三年回到了日本。父母因突如其来的交通事故而不幸离世。两人留下的，只有身为主厨的父亲所经营的一家小西餐厅『隐兔』。

中途放弃修行的主人公，不可能有哪家名店愿意正式雇他当厨师，而要重返修行，既没有资金也没有人脉。于是，他决定在『隐兔』试试自己修行途中的手艺。

然而，餐厅的经营并不顺利。虽然厨艺不错，但作为经营者的才能却完全不具备。就在这时，看不下去的住在附近的青梅竹马此那幡惠来帮忙了。与她自留学以来时隔三年再次重逢。与分别时毫无变化的惠重逢的寒暄还未结束，她便提出想作为女服务员在『隐兔』工作。话虽如此，作为女服务员她完全没有技术和经验。加上她天生冒失的性格，情况并没有什么戏剧性的改变。

就在这样的情况下，为了鼓励失望的渡，惠吻了渡。渡被突如其来的举动吓了一跳，还没来得及反抗，就接了吻。第二天，小小的幸福降临，店里的经营稍有好转。此后，每当她鼓励渡时，店的经营便不可思议地好转起来。

一边注视着天真地欢喜着的惠，另一边渡对事态心存疑虑，但就这样，开始了与惠两人三足的『隐兔』运营。

v4922.title: 無限輪姦
v4922.originalDescription: Main character dates a girl he protected from bullying. After some time together with former bullies they go to an inhabited island where they want to find truth about a terrible incident. Their boat gets crashed upon landing in the storm, so there is no way back. Protagonist understands that the one who controls the handgun becomes the absolute law here. It's his chance to avenge the bullied girl twofold.
v4922.description:
主人公・増田孝，
与松崎江美一同遭受着同一所学校的欺凌小组的欺凌，
却如同互相舔舐伤口般地交往着。
然而，某天两人瞒着欺凌小组的交往暴露了，
江美被小组的男人・斉藤凌辱至极后夺去了处女之身。
几天后的结业旅行。
前些日子的悲剧仍留在脑海，江美与増田的关系依然生硬尴尬。
在这样的情况下，众人前往一座传闻曾发生过凄惨事件的无人岛。
但是，刚抵达岛上天气就变得恶劣，
船被冲到了不知何处，众人陷入了孤立无援的境地。
被外界拒绝……也被世界抛弃的我们……。
主人公与江美的绝望，因小组成员・有樹发现的一把手枪，
进而当它被交到小组冷酷无情的领导者，
双胞胎姐姐・早樹手中时成为了定局，
两人从小组那里逃了出去。
在暴风雨中，被恐惧驱赶着到达的地方，
还妥善保管着另一把手枪。
拿到枪的増田，对自己内心深处涌上的，
想要蹂躏一切的愤怒与淫靡的欲望，感到身体震颤。
“复仇”。脑海中浮现的词语。
用这把枪给予恐惧，将江美所受的屈辱与污辱加倍奉还，
现在的自己，能够做到——　
在他手中，无言的力量之块，沉甸甸……地彰显着它的存在感。

v5268.originalDescription:
In the near future...

Mai, an undercover investigator, is captured and confined by a crime group. The group decides to make her their spy and hires a professional trainer. From that day, a series of erotic lessons is given to her...
v5268.description:
─近未来。

正在对○罪组织进行内部侦查的女搜查官·真衣顺利地推进着诱饵搜查，但在最后一步时被组织抓住了。

组织打算将抓住的女搜查官○○成组织一方的间谍，并委托了在那个世界里很有名的专业“○○师”对女搜查官进行○○。

从那天开始的，不知何时才是尽头的对牝○○的○○。

在妖异的器具和媚○的作用下，逐渐被○○成淫乱身体的女搜查官的命运将如何呢……
