v1710.originalDescription:
The protagonist visits his hometown Miyagou Village for the first time in 10 years because the only rail line that connects to the village is about to be discontinued, when that happens, he will not be able to come back here again. So before that happens, he wants to go back to the place he was born one last time.

After he arrived, he called his friend who was supposed to let him borrow a place to stay, but was surprised to hear that he has moved to Nagoya. As he was walking around the village, he was reunited with his osananajimi Natsuki. After explaining his situation to her, she bought him to Kusakabe shrine where she worked as a miko and allowed him to stay there. 

And so starts his life living with mikos.

v3622.originalDescription:
The princess Alfiana Shatazelc once abandoned her status of royalty to become a pirate.
Steering the light, swift vessel, “Artemia”,
She navigates the great wide ocean freely, looting anywhere she pleases.

Then, the huge phantom ship of legendary sea pirate “Boneguard” appears before her.
Alfiana and her friends board the huge ghost ship in search of the treasure that is stored in the ship’s hold, however…
… Lying in wait for them is the ship’s crew, those who continue to live on as skeletons, and the still animated dead bodies of drowned sailors.
Defeated by the immortal and invulnerable phantoms, Alfiana dives into the ship’s hatch and is commanded to search for the lost sword “Aiken”, on the conditions of a one-on-one duel with the ghost ship’s captain.
However, the ship’s hold is the haunt of more of the ship’s starved ghosts, as well as a number of other unidentified tentacle monsters!!

v6755.originalDescription:
Kazuma and Reina were newlyweds.
After making love, they lay together in a lazy, intimate haze, still naked, enjoying sweet, idle conversation.
In the middle of it, Reina suddenly asked:

"Have you ever… been with someone else?"

Kazuma sighed inwardly but answered honestly.
"Yeah. Just with… you know, escorts. Sorry."
Then, he turned the question back to her.
"What about you? Have you ever… been with someone else?"

Reina paused, thinking.
Her hesitation sent a faint shock through Kazuma, but he kept his calm.

Reina answered in a small voice.
"Well… actually… just a little."

"…Huh?"
What followed was a confession Kazuma never expected.
In vivid detail, Reina began to describe the intense affair she’d had with another man—something that had happened without Kazuma’s knowledge.
The words spilled from the lips of the woman he loved, each one deepening his despair.

The protagonist, Kotaro Shinozaki, was living a happy life with his wife, Tomoka, and daughter, Moeka.
One day, however, he is involved in a car accident and falls into a serious condition that leaves him on the border between life and death.
Tomoka and Moeka grieved and prayed that their beloved husband would recover.
Their prayers were answered, and Kotaro made a miraculous recovery.
However, when he woke up, he found that the woman next to him was not Tomoka and Moeka. It was Maki Tachibana, his beloved girlfriend who he had lost a long time ago, who was standing by Kotaro's side as his wife.
Tomoka was only Kotaro's friend, and his beloved daughter, Moeka, did not exist.
Maki, who was supposed to be dead, is still alive and living as his wife.
There is another possibility that Kotaro could have walked in the world of IF.

v26900.originalDescription:
Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather.
The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

One day, the protagonist was told to meet his uncle.
His uncle told him he had newly opened a future-next generation Empire Club which was customizable and filled with new possibilities.
Unexpectedly, his uncle generously handed over the ownership of Empire Club… However, Empire Club was secretly in huge debt.
Although he cursed his uncle for fleeing outside of the country neglecting Empire Club as it was, he had no choice but to run the place. Not only he had to save the club from debt, there were so many outrageous problems. It was obvious that it wouldn’t be easy to solve everything.
In front of the protagonist who was totally at a loss, three maids appeared. They were the last few maids who remained working at Empire Club.
“Maria Seido” who is innocent and cheerful.
“Mafuyu Himuro” with serious and loyal personality.
“Risa Takizawa” a dignified, mature woman.
Starting with these three, the protagonist and maids cooperate to rebuild the future-next generation Empire club.



Tricked into taking over a debt-ridden Club by your uncle, it is up to you to decide where this will lead you. With three Maids in tow, you will promote and improve the Club in various ways while turning them into Idols. There are so many decision to make but all shall lead to building your own little paradise. Whether it is through being surrounded by an exclusive harem or other debauchery for there anything goes, if you let it be.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is a Visual Novel and Simulation Game which is set in a so-called Empire Club which is part of system which involves private high class clubs where the "Maids" (attire entirely optional) entertain customers in various ways. In which one is up to the "Master" (you) of the Empire Club to decide and the options have visibly been increased from past iterations.

While previously Maids acted as hostesses and Dancers when set as Private Maid or as Prostitute when set as Free one, the new generation of Empire Clubs is supposed to provide many other services through new facilities. These include but are not limited to Cafés, Restaurants and Bars as well as Hotels, Casinos and Massage Parlors.

Apart from working or learning skills for Night Service, Maids can be trained in various disciplines to attract customers through a daily scheduling system and can be visited or supervised.

Maids do now even become Idols which is center of this story. In an optional Rhythm Game, Maids not only dance but also sing alone or together to promote their club.

Everything is up to the master to decide, including which personality and appearance a Maid will have as well as how far and in which way the relationship develops through select-able events. "NTR" can be completely blocked.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is the upgraded version of Custom Maid 3D 2. With the exception of story and systems featured in expansions like the Empire League, VR Vacation and alike, everything else is either already there, improved or can be imported from the predecessor. 

Constantly being developed since CM3D2, the content can be increased vastly for a price. Making the predecessor having one of if not the longest script size for a video game (06/2017: 20 MiB). v26900.description:
Empire Club. The most luxurious bar that ladies and gentlemen come and gather.
The beautiful maids who worked there danced and talked with the customers to amuse them.

One day, the protagonist was told to meet his uncle.
His uncle told him he had newly opened a future-next generation Empire Club which was customizable and filled with new possibilities.
Unexpectedly, his uncle generously handed over the ownership of Empire Club… However, Empire Club was secretly in huge debt.
Although he cursed his uncle for fleeing outside of the country neglecting Empire Club as it was, he had no choice but to run the place. Not only he had to save the club from debt, there were so many outrageous problems. It was obvious that it wouldn’t be easy to solve everything.
In front of the protagonist who was totally at a loss, three maids appeared. They were the last few maids who remained working at Empire Club.
“Maria Seido” who is innocent and cheerful.
“Mafuyu Himuro” with serious and loyal personality.
“Risa Takizawa” a dignified, mature woman.
Starting with these three, the protagonist and maids cooperate to rebuild the future-next generation Empire club.



Tricked into taking over a debt-ridden Club by your uncle, it is up to you to decide where this will lead you. With three Maids in tow, you will promote and improve the Club in various ways while turning them into Idols. There are so many decision to make but all shall lead to building your own little paradise. Whether it is through being surrounded by an exclusive harem or other debauchery for there anything goes, if you let it be.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is a Visual Novel and Simulation Game which is set in a so-called Empire Club which is part of system which involves private high class clubs where the "Maids" (attire entirely optional) entertain customers in various ways. In which one is up to the "Master" (you) of the Empire Club to decide and the options have visibly been increased from past iterations.

While previously Maids acted as hostesses and Dancers when set as Private Maid or as Prostitute when set as Free one, the new generation of Empire Clubs is supposed to provide many other services through new facilities. These include but are not limited to Cafés, Restaurants and Bars as well as Hotels, Casinos and Massage Parlors.

Apart from working or learning skills for Night Service, Maids can be trained in various disciplines to attract customers through a daily scheduling system and can be visited or supervised.

Maids do now even become Idols which is center of this story. In an optional Rhythm Game, Maids not only dance but also sing alone or together to promote their club.

Everything is up to the master to decide, including which personality and appearance a Maid will have as well as how far and in which way the relationship develops through select-able events. "NTR" can be completely blocked.


Custom Order Maid 3D 2 is the upgraded version of Custom Maid 3D 2. With the exception of story and systems featured in expansions like the Empire League, VR Vacation and alike, everything else is either already there, improved or can be imported from the predecessor. 

Constantly being developed since CM3D2, the content can be increased vastly for a price. Making the predecessor having one of if not the longest script size for a video game (06/2017: 20 MiB). While featuring only 3 Personality types without any additions, the number can be increased to 16 currently. Other additions include more customization options, night skills, dances, events and new systems like marriage which come with a high amount of new events.

The It's a Night Magic Version removes all options, customization and otherwise as well as events related to sex. Developed in the Unity Engine, modding is easily done, allowed and has spread.

"Various Corrupted Marinas in the bad end scenarios reach across time and space and encroach upon the couple who are living a happy life!"

The only way to return them to normal is for Souma to satisfy the unfulfilled desires of the fallen Marinas.

v5292.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Takayuki Sugawara, has spent his entire life—since he was a child—as a childhood friend of his older cousin, Saori Ayakawa, due to family circumstances. When he went off to college after passing his entrance exams, he began living on his own, but even after that, Saori continued to look after him, and their relationship as childhood friends remained just as it had always been.

One day, Saori—who was in the same broadcasting club as the protagonist—was tapped as a last-minute replacement to host the afternoon broadcast, and she began to attract attention throughout the school. As he watched Saori receive love letters and confessions of love, the protagonist realized he wanted to be by her side not just as a childhood friend, but as her boyfriend. He mustered the courage to confess his feelings, and she accepted him; they successfully became a couple and began spending happy times together.

The two of them had no idea that Kouzuki, the broadcasting club’s advisor, was watching them with a cold, calculating gaze…

Masaki leads such a fulfilling student life, but there was one event in his mind.
That is his friend Shuji Kusaka.
Before going to the current school, Shuji belonged to the same track and field club as Masaki, but after a violent incident during the last tournament before graduation, he left the track and field club and became a loner. It was because I was there.
Masaki enjoys a fulfilling daily life with his girlfriend Ayumi.

But little do they know, what kind of feelings Shuji has in his heart while staring at them...

v10848.originalDescription:
Takahiro was relieved by the doctor’s explanation, but when Asuka woke up, she had lost all her memories except those related to her personal relationships.

After being discharged from the hospital, Takahiro tried once again to help Asuka regain her memories—her memories of their time together. To that end, Asuka began living her life just as she had before the accident, hoping that this would serve as a trigger to bring her memories back. In response to Takahiro’s wishes, Asuka resumes her household chores—such as cooking and laundry—as well as her part-time job at the bookstore, which she had held since before the accident.

However, Nakagawa, the manager at the bookstore where she works, learns of her situation
and begins to creep into the void left in her heart by the accident…

v22072.originalDescription:
January, just shy of their third wedding anniversary.

 One message arrives at the Asamiya household, where the happily married couple lives together.

 It's from Kazuki, the nephew of the wife, Kanana, asking if he could stay at their home for a little while.

 To be honest, Shun, the protagonist, thinks to himself, "After all, we finally have this life just the two of us..." — but since it's a child Kanana has
 doted on since long ago, he ends up agreeing.

 When they meet, Kazuki is a polite and gentle young man, and Shun feels relieved. Life with Kazuki — who is thoughtful and even helps with the housework
 — blends in far more smoothly than he imagined.

 Around the same time, Shun's work becomes busy, and he finds himself away from home more often.

 Still, for his wife's sake... for their future, for having a child with Kanana, he keeps pushing forward.

 —The small distortion that unfolded behind the scenes.

 Without ever noticing it growing larger and larger...

 Things that had never been done to her by her husband.

 Things she had never done for her husband.

 And the first time—

 ...the body of his beloved wife is slowly being eroded.

She suggested for him to take a bath, and while the protagonist was in the bath, the bathroom door suddenly opened. In the depths of the steam, his beloved was standing completely naked. The older sister is puzzled by some things, but is excited about the idea of semi-cohabitation with her boyfriend. The days in which the protagonist tries to skillfully cajole the younger sister and to elevate his relationship with the older sister are about to begin.

v29531.originalDescription:
A few years ago, Takahide Sagami was introduced by a business associate to Yura Sagami, the daughter of a prominent family; they subsequently married, and he became a son-in-law. Although there was an age difference of nearly 10 years between him and Yura, the marriage was entered into by mutual consent, and throughout their married life, he made a conscious effort to prioritize his family as much as possible, even amid his busy work schedule. As a result, his wife never complained, and even though their marriage hadn’t stemmed from a passionate romance, he believed they had built a harmonious home. That is, until that day—

One day, when Takahide returned home from a business trip, he found a pair of men’s shoes—not his own—by the front door, and heard suspicious sounds coming from the back of the house. Trembling with fear, he went inside and peeked into the bedroom, where he found his wife in the arms of a stranger—who had even ejaculated inside her. Overwhelmed by shock and confusion, he lost all sense of reality and instinctively fled the scene. After he managed to calm down and returned home, Yura noticed Takahide was back and admitted she had been with another man. However, she explained that they didn’t love each other and that it was merely a physical relationship. Takahide, concerned for his own reputation,
intended to forgive this infidelity if she swore that this was a one-time mistake and that she would never do such a thing again. However, Yura said she would continue the relationship, and if he couldn’t forgive her, she told him he could blame everything on himself and go ahead and leave her.

Takahide is deeply confused, unable to fathom Yura’s true feelings, but he chooses to win his wife back rather than break up with her. Yet even after that, Yura continues to sleep with that man—.

Why does his wife sleep with that man?
Was she a promiscuous woman he never knew she was, or is there some reason Takahide simply cannot fathom—?

v33204.originalDescription:
If the opposite of love is indifference, then the opposite of hate is...

Haru and Anri are a couple who have been married for three years and are famous in their neighborhood.
Haru is a serious and sensible person, and Anri is a cheerful and uninhibited person, and although they are complete opposites in personality, they have never had a single quarrel since their marriage.

However, Haru and Anri were not close from the beginning either.
When they first met, the quiet Haru and the gal-like Anri were not very good with each other.
But they ended up getting married and became a couple so popular that there were even rumors about them, so you never know what can happen in this world.

There was one more rumor about Mr. and Mrs. Sakuraba.
It was that Anri did not care much about being seen.
Anri had always been fond of flashy and revealing clothes, but her habit was not to think much about how people saw her.
The presence of such a defenseless married woman would attract a lot of attention.
When Haru, her husband, became aware of this rumor...

He thinks that he will bring out the true sexuality of Yayoi, which Wakaba will never be able to see.

v34445.originalDescription:
The protagonist, Akito Akishima, has a girlfriend named Aika Shiroyama. When they worked at the same company, Akito had feelings for Aika, but he gave up on her because she already had a boyfriend. However, after hearing rumors that she had broken up with her boyfriend, Akito made a desperate effort to win her over. Eventually, she agreed to go out with him.

After that, Akito changed jobs and moved to a different company, where he was content with his life, spending his days off happily with Aika.
He was even considering proposing to her and starting a married life together.

One day, there was a major personnel reshuffle at Aika’s company, and he learned that her ex-boyfriend, Yuma Mitaka, had returned and was now working alongside her. Even so, he told himself that Aiika’s relationship with that man was a thing of the past and that he wouldn’t let it bother him. However, he happened to see the two of them walking together in town. When he asked her about it, she told him they were just there for work and that nothing was going on, so Akihito chose to believe her.

After that, they went several days without seeing each other due to their busy work schedules, and even when they did meet occasionally, Akihito began to sense a slight distance between them.

What had been happening between Aika and her ex-boyfriend during that time…?
Those events would gradually change the dynamics of Aika’s relationship with her “boyfriend” and her “ex-boyfriend”

The protagonist, Nakaizumi Yuuji, and his girlfriend, Kiryuu Miori, attends the same university. But one night, Yuuji went to visit Miori but heard a strange voice coming from his girlfriend's room. Feeling uneasy, he peeked inside the room and saw Miori in the arms of another man. Dumbfounded, he went out and wandered on the road. He noticed a car coming, and as he was hit he lost his consciousness. 

When he woke up, he was in his room. He was relieved that it may all have been a dream, but soon noticed that no one can see him and his body was like that of a ghost. Moreover, the world look exactly like it did two years ago. Thinking that he was simply lucid dreaming, he looked around and saw Miori, who he then followed. He then witnessed Miori having sex with her then boyfriend. He woke up soon after and realized that he has indeed been in an accident, but he still kept having dreams of him going back to the past. In those dreams, he always saw Miori with another man. 

He saw one where Miori was cheating on him with her ex-boyfriend, and also saw another one with the man he saw with her on their anniversary night. 

"Is this just a nightmare, or am I really seeing what happened in the past...?"

v35912.originalDescription:
The protagonist, college student Yasutaka Eda, had a bitter memory. When he went to the apartment of his girlfriend, Yumi Shibasawa, he walked in on her embracing a stranger. However, Yumi made no attempt to hide it; she continued to have sex with the man right in front of him, explaining that she wasn’t satisfied with him alone. Their relationship came to an end, and Yumi disappeared from campus. The shock of that incident lingered and he convinced himself he could never have a girlfriend again.

Later, he reunited with Yumi’s younger sister, Mia Shibasawa. He gradually grew attracted to her, and they began dating, but the trauma Yumi had caused Yasutaka lingered, affecting his sex life. However, as Mia stood by Yasutaka’s side, his wounds finally began to heal.

Some time later, Yumi reappeared before Yasutaka. Yasutaka told her that his current girlfriend was her sister, Mia, and Yumi didn’t object. He thought he could put the past behind him and live happily with Mia from then on. However, Fuma Saginuma—the man who had once made love to Yumi right in front of him—began to drag not only Yumi but also Mia, who was supposed to love only Yasutaka, into a world of sexual desire.

Tatsuki and Minami have been married for two years. Their relationship is loving, and they live a happy life together.

Then one day, word arrives that Minami's father has passed away. Minami, who had been raised by her father alone, is devastated - but with Tatsuki at her side, she slowly begins to work through her grief.

Some time later, a man named Shima - an old friend of her late father and the owner of a lending business - pays them a visit.

"Your father left behind a debt. Someone has to pay it."

After much agonizing, the couple agrees to take the debt upon themselves. Their finances were already tight, and now the burden of a parent's debt weighs on them both. Determined to shoulder it all, Tatsuki pushes himself too hard - and his health begins to fail.

Watching her husband waste away before her eyes, Minami is reminded of her father in his final days. And so, she makes a decision.

She accepts Shima's offer: to pay off the debt with her own body...

However, when he returned home for a university break, an elderly man—a benefactor who had looked after Miho after her parents’ death and who served as the community leader—brought up the idea of passing on his status and fortune to the man who would become Miho’s husband. But the method involved an ancient local custom: to test their fertility, Miho would have to sleep with two prospective suitors, and then choose one of them. Kazuya was selected as one of those men. But since this would mean allowing Miho to be with another man she didn’t know, Kazuya naturally objected. Miho, however, didn’t want to cause a conflict by defying the elderly man who had taken such good care of her. So she suggested that she and the other man cover for each other and pretend they had gone through with the custom. Of course, they wouldn’t actually do anything, and in the end, she would choose Kazuya.

The other man who had been chosen was Keiji Natsuki, a senior and the second son of a local construction company, but when they actually talked, he revealed that he didn’t believe in such customs either and had no interest in them, so he agreed to go along with the cover-up.

With a solution in sight, Kazuya returned to the city to attend college.
Later, it seemed their cover story had gone smoothly, and Kazuya breathed a sigh of relief.

However, what was happening to Miho, who had been away at that time—

v15118.originalDescription:
The setting is a present-day Japan in which studies to develop skills and knowledge in magical, theological and scientific disciplines are undertaken with equal importance.

However, not everyone is allowed to freely use magic. An individual's personal qualities are taken into account, and in addition, one must study magic as their specialty. For that reason, magic educational institutions were founded.

At the magic school Takashi and his schoolmates attend, many stories about the "Seven Wonders" of varying veracity are passed from the senior students to the junior, from the old generation to the new.

Takashi and his scholastic companions gradually discover the school's "true mysteries of the Seven Wonders"...



This is the first otome game to have all heroes voiced by voice actresses.

One of its sub-brands, Baldrhead, has been used for several of these action-oriented visual novels. Aside from its visual novels, it was known for creating the Variable Geo fighting game series for PC9800, which was later ported to TurboGrafx-CD, PC, Super Famicom, Sega Saturn and PlayStation.

The brand was discontinued and ceased selling its titles on 31 March 2023.

p336.name: Frontwing
p336.description:
Frontwing is a Japanese game brand that was founded on 7 April 1999, releasing h-anime visual novels. Their first release, Canary ~Kono omoi wo uta ni nosete~ was released in August 2000. Part of the producers, illustrators, and scenario writers of this project have since moved to GROOVER, a subsidiary of Star Link, claiming that they were freelancers not involved with Frontwing.

After the release of The Fruit of Grisaia, translated by Sekai Project in 2014, Frontwing ventured into the overseas market themselves when they established their own fully-fledged localization team in 2015. They officially debuted with The Leisure of Grisaia in 2016. 

On September 10, 2018, Frontwing Lab was established as a subsidiary for anime and game planning, with Yamakawa Ryuuichirou serving as representative director. In March 2019, Frontwing formed a business partnership with Bushiroad, and on April 1, 2021, Bushiroad acquired a majority of Yamakawa’s shares, making Frontwing Lab a consolidated subsidiary.

On September 30, 2024, Frontwing acquired all shares of Frontwing Lab held by Bushiroad, leading to Frontwing Lab’s exit from the Bushiroad group. It was also announced that Frontwing will now join the Good Smile Company group.



English website

p24.name: Key
p24.description:
Key is a Japanese visual novel studio known for making dramatic and plot-oriented titles. It was formed on July 21, 1998, as a brand under the publisher Visual Arts, and is located in Kita, Osaka.

Co-founder Jun Maeda is a prominent figure in the brand, having contributed to the planning, scenario, and music composition in the majority of Key's visual novels. Na-Ga, Key's main artist, mainly worked with background art in earlier games, but with Key's sixth game Little Busters! (2007) was given the position of co-art director with former Key artist Itaru Hinoue. Shinji Orito, Key's main composer and another co-founder, has composed music for the majority of Key's titles.

Key has been an active participant at the Comiket convention since Comiket 57 in 1999, where they sold Kanon-related products; Key's latest appearance at Comiket was at Comiket 99 in 2021. In 2001, Visual Arts created the record label Key Sounds Label to release music albums and singles with music related to Key's visual novels. Between 2007 and 2010, Key produced an Internet radio show called Key Net Radio in regard to the brand.

p21.name: Leaf
p21.description: Leaf is an adult visual novel brand under the publisher AQUAPLUS, and has offices in Yodogawa-ku, Osaka, and Tokyo. It and its competitor Key (to which it is often compared) are two of the most popular and successful dedicated visual novel studios operating today.

p87.description: AQUAPLUS is a Japanese company which specializes primarily in the publishing and distribution of visual novels, including both adult games under their brand Leaf and games for all ages under brand AQUAPLUS. AQUAPLUS has been involved with the production of anime based on Leaf's games. The company is also involved with music, franchised restaurants, and at one point was involved with automobiles.
